The 4″ Encore Turbine Ash Catcher is a compact glass add-on built for people who are tired of dirty water pipes and harsh hits. It’s ideal if you’re running a favorite daily driver and want smoother pulls plus way less gunk in your main piece. At just 4 inches (102mm) tall with a turbine perc, it adds legit filtration without making your setup feel huge or clunky.

This ash catcher is a nice sweet spot: big upgrade in function, small footprint on your table. If you like your glass clean, your hits cooler, and your bong or rig doing less of the dirty work, this is the kind of accessory that earns its keep fast.

Why It Works

  • Smoother, cooler hits — The turbine perc spins your smoke through water, creating a vortex that adds extra diffusion without dragging your pull.
  • Keeps your main piece cleaner — Ash and debris get trapped in the catcher instead of baking into the downstem or base of your bong.
  • No awkward, top-heavy setup — At 4 inches (102mm), it adds function without turning your rig into a skyscraper.
  • Doubles as a mini pre-cooler — The extra water chamber cools things down before smoke even hits your main perc.
  • Dialed-in fit for angled joints — 45° joint angle makes it a natural match for classic beaker and tube-style water pipes.
  • Built from real borosilicate — Heat-resistant glass that can actually hang with daily seshes if you treat it right.
  • Clean look with color accents — Color logo options let you match or contrast your favorite setup without going over the top.

Best For

This ash catcher is made for people who actually use their glass and don’t want to scrub it every other day. If you’re constantly pulling your downstem to rinse out resin and chunks, dropping a turbine catcher in front is a simple fix. It’s also a smart upgrade if you’ve got a favorite piece from your main smoke shop gear lineup and want to stretch its lifespan instead of replacing it.

Because it’s compact, it works especially well for folks who keep their piece on a desk, nightstand, or small coffee table where huge accessories just get in the way or risk getting knocked over.

How to Use It

Using the 4" Encore Turbine Ash Catcher is straightforward: it sits between your bowl and your water pipe and does the dirty work before anything hits your main chamber. Just slide the male joint of the ash catcher into the female joint on your piece, then put your bowl into the joint on the catcher.

Add a little water to cover the slits of the turbine perc, but don’t overfill — you want that spinning action, not splashback. When you pull, smoke or vapor will hit the turbine first, spin through the water in a vortex, and then move on to your main piece already cooled and partially cleaned up. Set the whole setup on a solid surface like a nonstick dab mat if you’re clumsy or working in a crowded space.

Between seshes, you can quickly dump the water from the ash catcher instead of having to rinse your entire bong or rig every time. That’s really where this piece shines — it takes the abuse so your main glass doesn’t have to.

Joint Angle 45°
Perc Style Turbine perc

Fit & Compatibility

This 4" Encore Turbine Ash Catcher is designed for water pipes with a 45° female joint in either 14mm or 18mm size. As long as your piece matches the joint size and angle, it should plug right in and sit naturally without leaning too far forward or back.

If you’re pairing it with other glass or a favorite bowl you already own, just double-check that both the size (14mm vs 18mm) and the angle (45° vs 90°) are correct. A 45° ash catcher on a 90° upright joint will sit weird and can feel unstable — that’s the one thing you really want to avoid.

Cleaning & Care

Since this catches most of your ash and reclaim, regular light cleaning goes a long way. Let it cool down, then empty the water and rinse. For a deeper reset, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry before using again.

If you’re working with sticky concentrates around your setup, pairing it with proper storage and packaging for your material can help keep spills and drips off your glass in the first place.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong or rig?
    If your piece has a 45° female joint in 14mm or 18mm, you’re good. Just match the joint size: 14mm catcher for 14mm joint, 18mm for 18mm. If your joint is a straight 90°, look for a 90° ash catcher instead so it sits level.
  • Is a 4" ash catcher big enough to make a difference?
    Yes — the height isn’t what does the work here, the turbine perc does. That spinning diffusion plus the extra water chamber is plenty to cool and clean up your hit, especially if your main piece already has a perc inside.
  • Do I need a special bowl for this?
    No special bowl is required as long as it matches the joint size on the ash catcher (14mm or 18mm). If you’re building out a full setup from scratch, you can grab bowls or even dab tools that match your joint size so everything plays nice.
  • How much water should I put in it?
    You only need enough water to cover the turbine slits so the smoke can spin and diffuse. Too much water can cause splashback or restrict airflow. Start low, pull a test draw, and adjust by feel.
  • Does this work for both flower and concentrates?
    Yes. It doesn’t care what you’re running through it — flower bowls, bangers, or anything else that fits the joint size. Many people use turbine ash catchers on their flower tubes, but it can absolutely sit in front of a small rig as long as the angle and joint size line up with your setup or silicone bongs and rigs.
  • How fragile is it?
    It’s made from borosilicate glass, which handles heat and normal use well, but it’s still glass. Treat it like the rest of your good pieces: avoid hard knocks, don’t let it tip over on a hard surface, and be careful when taking bowls in and out.
  • What’s the point of a turbine perc vs a basic downstem perc?
    A simple downstem just pushes smoke through a few slits or holes; the turbine is shaped to spin your smoke through the water, which increases contact and cooling without feeling super chuggy. If you’re already into percs and recyclers, think of this as an extra mini stage of function before everything hits your main glass or concentrate jars area on the table.

The 3" 14mm 90° Rainbow Swirl Ash Catcher is a compact glass add-on built for bong lovers who are tired of scrubbing dirty downstems after every bowl. It’s made for people who want smoother, cleaner hits and a rig that actually stays clear longer. At just 3 inches (76mm) with a 14mm male, 90° joint, it adds filtration and color without turning your setup into a clunky science project.

Why You’ll Actually Use This

  • Way less gunk in your bong — Catches ash and debris before it ever touches your main piece, so your water and glass stay cleaner way longer.
  • Smoother, less harsh pulls — Extra filtration cools things down a bit and keeps burnt particles out of the hit.
  • Small but mighty upgrade — Short 3" (76mm) body gives you the benefits of an ash catcher without making your setup front-heavy.
  • Rainbow swirl that actually pops — Colorful glass that stands out on the shelf and makes clear pieces look way less boring.
  • Easy on / easy off — Simple 14mm male, 90° joint slides into most standard bongs that use a 90° 14mm female joint.
  • Faster cleanups — It’s always easier to rinse a small ash catcher than deep-clean your favorite tube every other day.

Best For

This piece is made for daily drivers who love their glass but hate deep-clean days. If you’re running a compact bong or rig with a 14mm female, 90° joint and want just a bit more filtration and a lot less mess, this is the kind of accessory that quietly becomes part of your permanent setup. It’s also a great pick if you’re starting to upgrade your kit beyond basics and want something more fun than plain clear glass before you dive into full silicone bongs and rigs.

How to Use It

Using the Rainbow Swirl Ash Catcher is as simple as adding one more piece to your normal setup. Slide the 14mm male joint of the ash catcher into the 14mm female joint on your bong so it sits at a clean 90° angle, then add your existing bowl piece to the top joint of the catcher (or whichever connection point your current bowl is made for).

When you pull, smoke and ash first travel into the ash catcher, where the debris drops and the smoke gets a quick wash before continuing into your main piece. That means most of the grime gets trapped in this small chamber instead of coating the inside of your bong. If you like to keep your table clean too, park your setup on a nonstick dab mat so any stray ash or water droplets don’t end up on your furniture.

Cleaning is straightforward: let everything cool, remove the ash catcher, empty any leftover water and ash, then soak or rinse with isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and dry before using again. Keeping the catcher clean regularly is what keeps your hits tasting fresh.

Specs

Overall Length 3 inches (76mm)
Joint Size 14mm male
Joint Angle 90°
Material Glass

Fit & Compatibility

This ash catcher is designed to plug directly into any piece with a 14mm female joint at a 90° angle. That’s a pretty standard setup for a lot of modern bongs and smaller rigs. As long as your joint is 14mm female and sits upright at 90° (not a 45° slanted joint), it should play nice.

Because it’s only 3" (76mm), it doesn’t add a ton of weight or length, which is great for smaller water pipes that can get tippy with oversized accessories. If you’re rebuilding your kit from scratch, this pairs well with basic glass tubes and other daily-driver-level smoke shop essentials.

The Basics: Why Ash Catchers Matter

If you’ve ever looked at your bong and thought, “Did it really get this dirty after one night?”, this is the fix. An ash catcher acts like a pre-filter and pre-chamber. Instead of ash blasting straight into your water and sticking to every surface, it collects in this separate piece that you can pop off and clean in a couple minutes.

Function-wise, you’re adding a little extra path and sometimes a touch more water for the smoke to move through. That can tame harsher bowls and keep flavor cleaner over time because you’re not constantly pulling through old resin and spent ash stuck in your main chamber. It’s a small upgrade, but once you run an ash catcher for a while, going back to bare bong feels… messy.

Care & Cleaning Tips

To keep the Rainbow Swirl Ash Catcher looking good and working right, give it a quick rinse every few uses instead of waiting until it’s totally caked. Let it cool, dump out the water and ash, then rinse. For deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry before you put it back into your setup.

If you’re someone who likes to keep all your gear in order, stash your bowls, screens, and lighters together with your ash catcher in a dedicated tray or small storage spot. A simple organizer or smell-proof container from our broader storage and packaging lineup can help keep your kit from turning into a junk drawer.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong?
    If your bong or rig has a 14mm female joint at a 90° angle, this ash catcher should fit right in. If your joint is 45° or a different size (like 18mm), this specific piece won’t be the right match.
  • Does it make my piece tip over?
    Most likely not. At only 3" (76mm), it’s compact and lighter than big percolated catchers, so it usually keeps your setup balanced. Just be mindful with super small or super thin glass pieces.
  • Can I use this with a dab setup?
    This ash catcher is mainly designed for dry herb bowls, but some people do run them in mixed setups if joint sizes and angles line up. If you’re putting together a concentrate rig specifically, you may want to look at dedicated dab tools and accessories built for that kind of use.
  • Is there any special way I should clean the rainbow design?
    No special tricks needed. Treat it like any other glass: let it cool, soak in isopropyl alcohol for a deeper clean, rinse thoroughly with water, and let dry. Avoid scratching it with hard brushes or abrasive pads.
  • Do I need to add water to the ash catcher?
    Some people like to run a little water in their ash catcher, some prefer it dry depending on their piece and pull. Use it the way that gives you the draw you like; just remember extra water means you’ll want to empty and rinse it more often.
  • Will this change how my bong hits?
    Yes, but in a good way for most people. You’re adding a bit more filtration and a small amount of drag. Most folks find it makes the hit feel smoother while keeping the main chamber cleaner, which usually keeps flavor fresher too.
  • What else pairs well with this?
    A steady base (like a tray or pad), some backup bowls, and a good lighter or hemp wick will round out your kit. If you’re expanding your collection, this ash catcher looks especially good next to colorful spoons and other pieces in our silicone pipe selection for a mix of glass and unbreakable gear.

The 5″ 14mm Male 45° Encore Color Showerhead Ash Catcher is a compact glass add-on made for smokers who are tired of scrubbing their main piece after every few bowls. It’s built for 45° 14mm female joints and uses a showerhead perc to trap ash and start filtration before smoke ever touches your bong. If you want smoother hits, less reclaim in your favorite tube, and a little color upgrade at the same time, this is the move.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Keep your main piece way cleaner — the ash and gunk get caught in the ash catcher first, so your bong or rig stays fresh longer.
  • Smoother, less harsh pulls — showerhead perc breaks the smoke into bubbles for a softer hit before it even reaches your main chamber.
  • Perfect for 45° joint bongs — 14mm male joint with a 45° angle drops right into most classic beaker and straight-tube setups.
  • Add some color to your lineup — color accents make it easy to match your favorite piece or give it a loud contrast splash.
  • Easier cleaning routine — it’s way faster to rinse this than to deep-clean a whole tube every few days.
  • Great size for daily drivers — at 5 inches (127mm) tall, it adds function without turning your setup into a wobbly skyscraper.

Best For

This ash catcher is made for people who run their daily driver hard and hate when it starts to look swampy two days later. If you’re rocking a 14mm female, 45° joint water pipe and want cleaner, smoother hits without buying a whole new bong, this piece slides right into your setup. It’s also clutch if you like stacking function with other smoke shop products and slowly building your dream kit instead of swapping full pieces all the time.

How to Use It

Using the Encore Color Showerhead Ash Catcher is simple: treat it like an extra mini-chamber that lives between your bowl and your bong. The 14mm male joint on the ash catcher plugs into your bong’s 14mm female joint, then your bowl (or slide) sits in the joint on the ash catcher itself.

Add a small amount of water so the showerhead perc is just covered, then hit your piece as usual. As you pull, smoke drops into the ash catcher first, where ash, debris, and some of the heavier particles get trapped in the water and extra chamber. By the time the smoke moves into your main piece, it’s already been cooled and pre-filtered.

Set your setup on a sturdy, nonstick surface like a dab mat if you’re the type who occasionally bumps the table mid-sesh — it helps keep drips and reclaim off your furniture and makes cleanup easier.

After a few bowls or when the water starts looking rough, pull the ash catcher off, dump it, and rinse. It’s a lot less stressful to deal with than dragging your entire bong over the sink when you’re three bowls deep and just want things to work.

Joint Angle 45°

Fit & Compatibility

This Encore ash catcher is designed to plug directly into any water pipe with a 14mm female joint set at a 45° angle. That’s the standard angle you’ll see on a lot of beakers and smaller tubes — the joint comes off the neck at a diagonal instead of straight out.

Because it uses a 14mm male connection, it plays nice with most mid-sized glass pieces that already use 14mm hardware. If you’ve got multiple pieces and bowls, this makes it easy to swap the ash catcher around and see which tube it pairs with best. For storing your bowls, slides, and extra parts you’re not using, keeping a small stash of storage & packaging options around can help keep your gear organized instead of rolling around a drawer.

Care & Cleaning

Let the ash catcher cool before cleaning, especially after heavy use. Dump the old water, rinse with warm water, and for heavier buildup, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry before using again. It’s usually easier to clean this often than to wait until it’s fully caked up — that’s also how you keep your main bong looking brand new.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong?
    If your bong has a 14mm female joint set at a 45° angle, you’re good. The ash catcher’s 14mm male joint plugs right into that. If your piece has a 90° joint, or a different joint size, you’d need an adapter or a different style catcher.
  • Can I use this with a rig for concentrates?
    Yes, as long as your rig has a 14mm female, 45° joint and you’re fine with a little extra diffusion. Many dabbers prefer to keep their concentrate rigs a bit simpler, but if you want extra filtration, pair this with your favorite banger and a good carb cap for smoother pulls.
  • How much water should I put in it?
    Just enough to cover the slits or openings on the showerhead perc. Too much water and you risk splashback; too little and you won’t get the full filtration effect. A quick test pull without lighting anything will tell you if it feels right.
  • Will it make my piece tip over?
    On most medium-sized bongs with a stable base, you’ll be fine. This ash catcher is only 5 inches (127mm) tall, so it doesn’t add a ton of leverage. If your piece is super small or has a tiny base, just be mindful of balance and set it on a solid surface like one of our accessories trays or mats.
  • What’s the best way to keep it from getting stained?
    Change the water often and give it a quick rinse right after your sesh whenever you can. For deeper cleans, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and let it dry. Regular light cleanings are way easier than fighting thick resin later.
  • Is a showerhead perc better than other perc styles?
    “Better” depends on what you like. Showerhead percs are a great balance: solid diffusion, easy pull, and not too fragile or overcomplicated. They’re a good match for daily pieces and pair nicely with everything from simple tubes to more complex silicone bongs & rigs if you like customization.
  • Can I travel with this or store it safely?
    It’s glass, so treat it like any other nice piece. When you’re not using it, stash it in a padded spot or in a box or bag alongside your other gear. If you’re organizing a full setup with flower, concentrates, and hardware, pairing this with dedicated glass jars & packaging can help keep everything in one clean, protected place.

The 10" Color Accent Cone Perc Bong is a compact glass water pipe built for smokers who want legit function with some personality. At 10 inches (254mm) tall with a 14mm joint and included bowl, it’s a perfect daily driver for smooth flower hits without hogging your whole table. The cone perc in the center of the chamber breaks up smoke for cooler pulls, while the color accents give it that “I actually care about my glass” look.

Why It Works

  • Smoother, cooler hits — The cone percolator diffuses smoke through water so you’re not getting roasted on every pull.
  • Solid balance on the table — The hourglass-style body keeps the weight centered, so it’s less likely to tip when someone bumps the coffee table.
  • Ready out of the box — Comes with a matching 14mm flower bowl, so all you need is herb and a lighter.
  • Easy to handle — At 10 inches (254mm), it’s tall enough for real diffusion but still comfortable to grab, pass, and clear.
  • Style that actually shows — Color accents on the cone perc and mouthpiece make it stand out in a lineup of plain clear glass.
  • Great as a main piece or backup — Small enough to stash, clean enough function to be your go-to bong.

Best For

This piece is made for flower smokers who want a smooth, filtered hit but don’t need a giant science project sitting on their desk. If you’re running a couple seshes a day and want something that looks good, hits clean, and doesn’t feel fragile every time someone passes it, this bong fits the bill. It also pairs well with a non-stick dab mat under it if you’re tired of water rings and ash on your table.

How to Use It

Using this bong is as straightforward as it gets: add enough water to cover the slits on the cone perc, pack your bowl, and you’re good to go. The cone perc sits low enough that you get proper diffusion without feeling like you’re drinking the bong when you clear it.

The 10" height makes it easy to hold the base with one hand while you manage the bowl with the other, which is especially nice when you’re a few bowls in and just want things to be simple. Set it on a sturdy surface or even on one of our heavier smoke shop accessories stands if you like to keep your glass locked in place between hits.

Cleaning is simple: let the piece cool down fully, dump the old water, and soak or rinse with isopropyl alcohol when it needs a deeper reset. A quick swish and rinse goes a long way, especially if you’re using it with fresh flower stored in proper storage packaging that keeps your buds clean and terp-rich.

The included bowl is perfect if you’re just getting started or want to keep things simple, but you can easily swap it out for something more specialized from our wider range of smoke shop products if you like to customize your setup.

    If they’re 14mm male pieces (bowls, ash catchers, etc.), they should fit just fine. The joint is a standard 14mm, so most common glass accessories will slide right in without adapters.

The 9.5" Color Fume Maria Drain Incycler is a compact, high-function glass incycler for people who want recycler-level smoothness without a huge, fragile tower on the table. It’s built for flower and concentrates alike, with a 14mm joint and a color-matching horn flower bowl that makes it ready to rip right out of the box. Fumed glass, the Maria Drain design, and that internal recycle path give you a piece that looks wild on the shelf and delivers super-washed, flavorful hits when it’s in your hand.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Washed, smoother hits — Incycler design constantly recycles the water around your hit, knocking down harshness before it reaches your lungs.
  • Trippy fume work — Color-fumed glass catches light and slowly shifts character over time as it breaks in, so your piece develops its own look.
  • No splash to the mouth — The internal drain keeps the water moving down where it belongs instead of climbing up the neck when you pull hard.
  • Daily-driver size — At 9.5 inches (241mm), it’s tall enough for solid function but still easy to handle, pass, and stash.
  • Ready-to-pack bowl — Includes a 14mm color-matching horn flower bowl so you don’t have to dig through a drawer for something that fits.
  • Solid glass build — Thick, quality glass made to handle regular seshes instead of feeling like you’re holding a museum piece.

Best For

This incycler is made for people who love smooth, flavor-forward hits and actually pay attention to function, not just hype glass. If you’re the friend who always notices how a piece stacks bubbles and drains, this is your lane. It’s also an awesome upgrade if you’re moving from a basic straight tube into your first recycler-style piece, but don’t want something huge or complicated.

If you like to keep your setup dialed in, park this on a nonstick dab mat so the base and your table both stay clean between rips.

The Basics: How It Hits

An incycler is basically a recycler that keeps the recycling chamber tucked inside the outer body instead of hanging off the side. On this Maria Drain incycler, your hit pulls water up through the perc, circulates it around the inner chamber, and then sends it back down through the drain in the center. That constant loop breaks your hit into lots of tiny bubbles and cools everything down before it gets to you.

Because of the Maria Drain design, water drains quickly and predictably, so you get that "cyclone" function without the annoying chug or random splashback. You’ll notice the hit feels dense and flavorful, but a lot less aggressive on the throat, which is why recycler-style pieces are so popular with both heavy flower smokers and dabbers.

Day to day, you just fill the base so the perc is properly covered, pop in the 14mm bowl or a compatible banger, and let the incycler do the hard work of cooling and filtering the hit for you. Set it next to your favorite dab tools so everything you need is within reach when you’re mid-sesh.

Specifications

Height 9.5 inches (241mm)
Joint Size 14mm
Joint Type 14mm female joint
Included Bowl 14mm color-matching horn flower bowl
Material Fumed glass
Style Maria Drain incycler (bong / water pipe)

Fit, Function & Compatibility

The 14mm female joint plays nice with most standard 14mm male accessories, so it’s easy to swap the included flower bowl for a banger if you want to turn this into a dab rig. That makes it a legit all-in-one: flower on the couch, concentrate sesh on the weekend, same piece, just a quick accessory change.

If you’re already sitting on a stack of 14mm attachments or want to organize them better, pairing this with dedicated storage and packaging for your glass and small parts keeps everything protected and easy to grab.

How to Use It

Using this piece is straightforward. Add water through the mouthpiece or joint until the main perc is covered and the recycler path starts to engage when you pull. Too much water and you’ll feel extra drag; too little and you won’t get that nice recycle action. Once it’s dialed in, you really don’t have to think about it again unless you dump it to clean.

For flower, use the included horn bowl. For concentrates, swap to a 14mm banger or compatible nail. The incycler function shines with both — the constant movement of water helps keep hits flavorful while still being gentle, especially if you’re taking multiple pulls in a row. Between seshes, empty the water and let the piece air dry so it doesn’t get that stale-res water funk.

If you’re the type who keeps multiple strains or batches around, stash them in heavy-bottom glass jars so your flower or concentrates stay fresh and you’re not loading a premium incycler with dried-out product.

Cleaning & Care

Fumed glass rewards good cleaning habits because clear, clean glass really shows off the color changes over time. Let the piece cool before you clean it, then empty the water and rinse out loose residue. For a deeper clean, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry completely before you use it again. Avoid banging it on hard sinks or counters — it’s built tough for glass, but it’s still glass.

FAQ

  • Is this better for flower or dabs?
    It genuinely does well with both. Out of the box, it’s set up for flower with the included 14mm horn bowl. If you prefer concentrates, just add a 14mm male banger and you’ve essentially got a compact dab rig with recycler-style function. A lot of people use it as their main "do-everything" piece.
  • Will my existing 14mm accessories fit?
    Yes, if you have 14mm male accessories — bowls, bangers, or nails — they should fit right into the 14mm female joint on this incycler. Just make sure you’re matching male to female and sticking with 14mm only; 10mm or 18mm parts won’t work without adapters.
  • How hard is it to clean an incycler compared to a regular bong?
    It’s slightly more involved than a straight tube because there are internal paths, but still very manageable. The key is not letting resin build up forever. Rinse regularly, and when it needs a reset, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse well, and let it dry. You don’t need special tools or complicated steps.
  • Does the incycler design actually make hits smoother, or is it just for looks?
    It’s definitely not just for looks. The recycle action keeps water moving around your hit, which increases contact with the bubbles and helps pull out heat and some harshness. It also tends to keep flavor more consistent over longer pulls, which is why dabbers especially like recycler-style pieces.
  • Is 9.5 inches big enough to be a main daily driver?
    Absolutely. 9.5 inches (241mm) is a sweet spot for function and control. It’s tall enough for good cooling and recycling but compact enough that you won’t feel like you’re handling something fragile every time you pass it around. Many people prefer this size over huge towers as their everyday piece.
  • Can I travel with this piece?
    You can move it around or take it to a friend’s place, but treat it like any nice glass — wrap it, pad it, and keep it in a safe spot in the car. For more rugged on-the-go options, a lot of people grab unbreakable pieces from our silicone bongs and rigs collection and leave the fumed glass at home.
  • What else do I need to get the most out of this incycler?
    For flower, you’re basically set with just the incycler and a lighter. For concentrates, add a quality 14mm banger and a carb cap. You might also want a few basic accessories like cleaning plugs, cotton swabs, or travel-safe storage to keep the piece and your gear in good shape over time.

If you’re building out a full sesh station, you can also explore our broader lineup of smoke shop products to round out grinders, papers, and other daily-driver essentials that pair well with a piece like this.

What does “fumed” glass actually mean?

Fumed glass is made by bonding thin layers of metal (usually silver or gold) into the glass during the blowing process. As resin builds up and the piece sees heat and use, the colors deepen and shift, so over time your bong slowly takes on a more vibrant, custom look.

How do I clean it without ruining the fume?

If you’re upgrading from a plain beaker or straight tube, you’ll notice the difference fast.

If you’re mostly into dabs, check out rigs, bangers, and dab tools designed specifically for concentrates.

  • How fragile is the joint and base?

    The bridged joint adds extra glass support where joints usually take the most abuse, which helps cut down on accidental snaps when you’re changing bowls or bumping the table. The base is wide and flat for stability, but it’s still glass — treat it with the usual care, and maybe don’t pass it over concrete floors if you’re three bowls deep.

  • What do I need besides the bong to get started?

    Out of the box you’ll have the bong and matching 14mm bowl. All you really need on top of that is your flower, a lighter, and a safe place to set it down. If you like to stay organized, you can stash your herb, tools, and extras together using smell-resistant options from our storage & packaging collection so everything for your sesh lives in one place.

The 16″ Black Sheep Inline Ratchet Straight is a full-size glass bong built for smokers who want heavy diffusion, big flavor, and those long, milky pulls. At 16 inches (406mm) tall with both an inline perc and a ratchet perc, it’s made for people who actually care about function, not just looks. If you like a tall, ice-loaded tower that cools things way down before it ever hits your lungs, this is your kind of daily driver.

This piece hits that sweet spot between showpiece and workhorse: thick glass, smart perc stack, and a clean, straight-tube silhouette that’s easy to live with and easy to clean. Matching color accents and bowl tie the whole look together so it actually feels like a thought-out setup, not a random glass grab.

Why It Works

  • Smoother, cleaner hits — Inline perc plus ratchet perc break your smoke into tons of tiny bubbles for serious diffusion before it ever reaches the neck.
  • Stays cool on heavy pulls — 16-inch (406mm) height and an ice pinch give your smoke plenty of travel and contact with ice so you can rip harder without getting cooked.
  • Stable on the table — Footed straight-tube base gives you a wide, grounded footprint so it’s less likely to tip when someone bumps the coffee table.
  • Built to last — Bridged joint reinforces the stress point where most bongs crack, so this piece can actually keep up with daily seshes.
  • Dialed-in aesthetics — Color accents, matching decals, and a coordinated flower bowl make it look like a custom setup right out of the box.
  • Easy airflow, big clouds — The straight design and open percs keep drag low, so big rips don’t feel like you’re trying to sip a milkshake through a coffee straw.

Best For

This bong is made for people who like a real sit-down sesh — think living room, coffee table, and a couple of friends passing it around. If you’re the person in the crew who owns the “good glass,” this is absolutely that piece. It’s also ideal if you’ve outgrown tiny travel pipes and want something with legit cooling and filtration, but still want to keep everything in one clean, vertical footprint instead of some wild, hard-to-clean sculptural rig.

If you’re pairing this with other gear, it plays especially well as the centerpiece in a bigger setup alongside your favorite smoke shop accessories like ashtrays, lighters, and storage.

How to Use It

Using the 16″ Black Sheep Inline Ratchet Straight is straightforward once you’ve got your water level dialed. Fill the tube slowly so that the inline perc is just submerged and the ratchet perc is getting consistent bubble action when you pull — too little water and you lose diffusion, too much and you’ll get splashback.

Drop your flower into the matching color bowl, seat it in the joint, and pull steadily so the percs can do their thing. If you like your clouds extra cold, feed a couple of ice cubes down through the mouthpiece until they sit on the ice pinch; they’ll stay suspended high in the neck so they cool the smoke without messing with your water level. Setting this piece on a reliable dab mat is a smart move so you’re not worrying about water marks or resin on the table when things get laid back.

When you’re done, let any remaining water cool, then carefully pour it out and give the tube a quick rinse so it’s not building up grime between seshes. Keeping on top of that light maintenance makes your deeper cleans way easier later.

Specifications

Height 16 inches (406mm)
Material Glass
Design Straight tube with footed base
Percolation Inline perc + ratchet perc
Cooling Feature Ice pinch in neck
Accents Color accents with matching decals
Bowl Color-matching flower bowl included

Cleaning & Care

Let the piece cool down first, then empty the water and wipe or rinse out any loose residue. For deeper cleans, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry completely before the next use. A quick rinse after each sesh keeps your perc stack from getting gunked up and makes those deeper cleans a lot less work.

Fit & Function Notes

This is a tall piece, so check your storage spot or cabinet height — at 16 inches (406mm) it wants a bit of vertical space. The straight-tube profile makes it easier to slide into a corner or onto a shelf than wide, beaker-style bases, and that footed base still keeps it stable when it’s on the table.

If you ever rotate in a different slide or accessory, just make sure you’re matching the joint size and style on this bong. Pairing it with a sturdy case or placing it near your storage and packaging setup can also help keep it safe when it’s not in rotation.

FAQ

  • Q: Is 16 inches too tall for everyday use?
    A: If you’re used to little 8–10 inch bongs, this will feel like a step up, but that’s kind of the point. The extra height and the two percs give you noticeably cooler, smoother hits. As long as you’ve got the shelf or table space, it’s great as a daily driver.
  • Q: How much water should I put in it?
    A: Add water until the inline perc is fully submerged and the ratchet perc is getting good bubble action when you pull. You don’t need to flood the tube — just enough to keep both percs working without splashing into the mouthpiece.
  • Q: Can I use this bong with concentrates if I swap the bowl?
    A: Yes, if you grab a compatible banger or nail that matches the joint, you can absolutely use this as a dab rig. When you do that, it pairs nicely with proper dab tools so you’re not improvising every time you want a dab.
  • Q: How hard is it to clean the inline and ratchet percs?
    A: For routine cleans, a soak in isopropyl alcohol and a good rinse will get into the perc slits and holes just fine. Because it’s a straight tube, you don’t have a lot of weird bends or chambers, which keeps cleaning simple compared to more complex recycler-style rigs.
  • Q: Will it feel draggy with two percs?
    A: The inline and ratchet percs on this piece are designed to diffuse without turning your pull into a workout. With the right water level, you get smooth resistance and dense clouds instead of that suffocating, plugged-up feeling.
  • Q: What should I store it with when it’s not in use?
    A: A padded spot away from edges is your best friend, especially if you’re sharing space with roommates or pets. Keeping your flower or concentrates in proper concentrate jars and glass containers nearby also helps keep your whole station organized.
  • Q: How does this compare to smaller or single-perc bongs?
    A: Smaller or single-perc pieces are more compact, but you’ll notice hotter, harsher hits when you pack them the same way. The 16″ Black Sheep gives you dual percs plus ice capability, so it’s noticeably smoother and better for longer seshes where you’re taking multiple rips back-to-back. If you like that “big tube” feel with real function, this is the upgrade.

Pair It With

If you’re building out a full station, this bong slots in nicely next to your silicone bongs and rigs for when you want unbreakable options, and it plays well with the rest of your glass-heavy setup. Add a mat, a tray, and a couple of organizers and you’ve got a clean, dialed-in corner that’s ready whenever you are.

The wrap and rake fuming throws shifting colors and depth under different light, so it looks as good empty on the shelf as it does in the middle of a sesh.

Why You’ll Actually Love This Beaker

  • Serious table presence — The wrap and rake fume work gives you layered color and shine that changes with angle and lighting, so it never looks flat or boring.

Best For

This piece is made for smokers who want one main bong that does it all: daily use, group seshes, and looking good on the shelf in between. If you’re upgrading from a small straight tube or something cheap and thin, this 16″ beaker will feel like a real step up in both function and presence. It also slots in nicely if you’re building out a full smoke shop products style home setup and want a solid glass anchor piece.

How to Use It

Using this beaker is straightforward: add enough water to cover the downstream slits and give the base a quick swirl so everything settles evenly. Pack your 14mm bowl with ground flower, set your pace, and clear the chamber in a way that matches the size of this piece—big hits are easy here, so you can take it slow if you want.

For comfort, use your off hand to stabilize the beaker by the base or neck, especially when you’re passing it around. Setting it on a cushioned surface like a dab mat or pad adds a little extra protection for the base and keeps sticky water rings off your table.

Cleaning is simple: let the glass cool if it’s been used heavily, then rinse out the old water. For light maintenance, a quick rinse and shake with fresh water keeps things from building up. When it needs a real reset, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and let it dry before you put it back into rotation.

Care Tips

To keep the fume work looking sharp, avoid super abrasive scrubbers directly on the colored sections. Let it cool before cleaning, dump old water regularly, and wipe or rinse after heavier use so buildup doesn’t have a chance to bake on. For deeper cleans, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with warm water, and let it air dry completely before you pack the bowl again.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my existing bowl or slide?

    As long as your bowl is a 14mm male, it will fit this beaker’s 14mm female joint. If your current stuff is 18mm, you’ll need either a new bowl or a simple adapter—handy if you also keep smaller silicone bongs and rigs around and want everything to share the same parts.

  • Is a 16″ beaker too big for everyday use?

    Not at all—16 inches is a sweet spot for people who like full, cooled hits. It’s tall enough to stack smoke and keep it comfortable, but still manageable to pick up, clear, and stash on a shelf or in a cabinet when you’re done.

  • How do I keep the fume colors from fading or looking dull?

    The color itself doesn’t really “fade,” but buildup can make it look muted. Regular rinses and occasional alcohol soaks keep the fume work bright. Avoid harsh physical scrubbing on the design and let the soaking do most of the work instead.

  • Can I use this with concentrates?

    You can, as long as you swap the bowl for a 14mm male banger or nail. If you go that route, you’ll probably want a carb cap and a solid dabber—both easy upgrades you can grab from our dab tools and accessories lineup to round out your setup.

  • Is it travel friendly?

    It’s more of a stay-at-home tank than a travel piece. You can move it with a padded bag or hard case, but for tossing in a backpack or quick trips, most people prefer something smaller or a compact option like one of our silicone pipes that won’t stress you out if it takes a knock.

  • How much water should I use?

    Fill just enough to cover the diffusion at the end of the downstem—too little and it won’t function right, too much and you risk splash. You can fine-tune the level in small pours until it feels perfect for your pull style.

  • What should I pair this with to build a full setup?

    Most people like to add a dedicated grinder, a couple of 14mm bowls, and something to store their flower or concentrates—heavy-bottom concentrate jars or glass containers keep your material fresh and look clean next to this beaker on the shelf.

The 11″ Monark Color Fume Taurus Bong is a high-end glass incycler built for people who actually care about function as much as looks. At 11 inches (280mm), it’s compact enough for the coffee table but stacked with serious diffusion thanks to a slit puck perc and Taurus recycler design. If you’re the friend who always brings the “good glass” to the sesh, this is that piece.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The slit puck perc stacks bubbles hard, taking the edge off hot smoke before it climbs the incycler path.
  • Less splashback, more flavor — Taurus incycler design keeps water moving in a loop without sending it up to your lips.
  • Built to survive real-life use — A bridged joint reinforces the weakest point on most bongs, so one bad bump doesn’t end your favorite piece.
  • Dialed-in size for daily use — 11 inches (280mm) gives you good volume and function without turning into a clumsy tower.
  • Heady look without going full art-piece — Color fume work and a clean sandblast logo give it that custom vibe without getting too wild to pass around.
  • Ready out of the box — Comes with a matching 14mm flower bowl, so you’re not hunting for spare parts before the first sesh.

Best For

This Taurus Bong is made for daily smokers and glass heads who want recycler-level function without a super complex, hard-to-clean piece. If you like your flower rips milky but not harsh, and you want something nice enough to leave out as your main daily driver, this fits the bill. It also suits people who baby their glass but still live in houses where things occasionally get knocked over — that bridged joint is clutch.

How to Use It

Fill the base with enough water to cover the slit puck perc, but not so high that it rushes up the drain tube when you pull. The puck perc is doing the first round of work here, chopping your inhale into a ton of tiny bubbles for smoother, cooler hits.

As you draw, smoke and water travel up into the Taurus incycler section, then drain back down into the base in a loop. That constant circulation gives you extra cooling and diffusion without beating up your flavor. Set it on a solid surface or a soft dab mat so you’re not stressing the base every time you set it down.

For cleaning, let the piece cool off completely, empty the water, then rinse. For deeper cleans, add a bit of isopropyl alcohol, plug the openings, give it a gentle shake, then rinse well with warm water and let it dry before the next use.

The Basics & Build

The Taurus layout is a style of incycler where the uptakes and drain are built into the inner chamber, so water stays moving in a controlled loop as you clear the piece. That means smoother function, less chug, and better control when you clear the chamber. It’s a smart choice if you like recycler function but don’t want multiple exposed arms and tubes waiting to get snapped.

The color fume work on this Monark piece gives you that shifting, layered look that changes under different lighting. Over time, as the glass gets a bit of use, the fume tones usually deepen, so it actually looks better after it’s been part of your rotation for a while. If you’re already building a little lineup of favorites, this sits nicely next to more rugged gear like silicone bongs and rigs as your “nice glass” option.

Fit & Compatibility

The Monark Taurus Bong runs a standard 14mm female joint, so it plays nice with most 14mm male bowls, ash catchers, and dry herb attachments. If you like to keep your water pipes spotless, you can add a 14mm male ash catcher or pre-cooler between your bowl and the joint to catch resin before it hits the main chamber. Just keep in mind: extra glass means extra weight on the joint, so that bridged reinforcement is doing real work here, not just looking cool.

Stick to 14mm male accessories and you’re good. If you eventually want to dab on it, you can swap the bowl for a 14mm male banger and run it as a crossover piece, though a dedicated rig plus this as your flower champ is usually the move. For on-the-go or throw-in-a-bag setups, consider backing this up with something from our more rugged smoke shop products so you’re not hauling your nice Monark everywhere.

FAQ

  • Q: What size bowl or accessory will fit this bong?

    A: This piece has a 14mm female joint, so any 14mm male bowl, banger, or ash catcher will fit. If you’re upgrading the bowl later, just make sure you’re grabbing 14mm, not 10mm or 18mm.

  • Q: Is the 11" size big enough for group seshes?

    A: Yes, 11 inches (280mm) is a sweet spot for passing around — plenty of volume and diffusion without being so tall that it’s awkward to corner on a couch. For bigger circles or party nights, you can always keep a second piece or some backup silicone pipes in the mix.

  • Q: How do I clean the incycler section?

    A: Treat it like any quality glass piece: let it cool, dump the old water, then rinse. For deeper cleans, a bit of isopropyl alcohol and a gentle shake will help break down residue in the perc and incycler path. Rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry before using again.

  • Q: Will the color fume fade or change?

    A: Fume work doesn’t really “fade” under normal use — if anything, it tends to develop more character over time as the piece gets some mileage. Regular cleaning keeps the colors looking sharp instead of muted by residue. If you’re keeping a whole display of glass, pairing this with some clean glass jars and packaging on the shelf makes everything look extra dialed.

  • Q: Is this better for flower or concentrates?

    A: Out of the box, it’s set up for flower with the included 14mm bowl. You can absolutely throw a 14mm banger on there for dabs, but most people prefer this as their main flower bong and run a smaller rig for concentrates. If you’re a heavy dabber, look at dedicated rigs or nectar collectors for more dialed-in concentrate sessions.

  • Q: Is the bridged joint really that important?

    A: On recycler-style and incycler pieces, the joint area takes a lot of stress, especially if you’re running heavier bowls or attachments. The bridged joint on this Monark reinforces that spot, so a small bump is less likely to turn into a crack or full snap. It’s one of those details you really appreciate the first time your piece survives a clumsy set-down.

  • Q: How should I store it when I’m not using it?

    A: Empty the water, give it a quick rinse, and let it dry before putting it away. Storing it upright on a stable surface is best. If you’re keeping it packed away between uses, you can box it up along with your bowls, tools, and other gear in a dedicated storage and packaging setup so you’re not digging through random drawers for pieces.

The 6″ Color Swirl Glass Bubbler is a compact handheld water piece built for smokers who want smoother hits without committing to a full-sized bong. At 6 inches (152mm), it’s small enough to travel, but big enough to cool things down and show off that swirling colorwork while you sesh. If you like your glass to pull clean, hit comfortably, and still look good on the coffee table, this little bubbler earns its spot.

Each piece mixes function with heady vibes: a built-in water chamber for basic filtration, a comfortable mouthpiece, and bold color swirls that make every bubbler a bit unique.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Smoother, less harsh hits — The built-in water chamber cools and filters your smoke before it hits your lungs.
  • Pocketable daily driver — 6 inches (152mm) gives you real function in a size that’s easy to stash, pack, or pass.
  • Color swirl that actually pops — The vibrant linework turns a simple bubbler into a legit display piece when it’s not in your hand.
  • Comfortable in the hand — The classic bubbler shape sits naturally in your grip so you’re not fumbling mid-sesh.
  • Great upgrade from a dry spoon — If you’re used to a regular hand pipe, the added water makes a noticeable difference in smoothness.
  • Durable glass for real-world use — Thick glass helps it stand up to everyday handling when you’re careful but not that careful.

Best For

This 6″ Color Swirl Glass Bubbler is made for smokers who want water filtration without lugging around a big, fragile tube. It’s perfect as a couch-side daily driver, a backup piece in your rotation, or a colorful companion when you’re heading out and don’t want to risk your favorite large rig. If you already run a bigger setup but want something smaller to pair with your travel gear or unbreakable silicone pipes, this bubbler fills that gap nicely.

How to Use It

Using this bubbler is pretty straightforward. Add a small amount of water into the chamber from the mouthpiece or carb side, then tilt the piece so the downstem dips into the water. You want the bottom of the downstem submerged, but not so full that it splashes toward the mouthpiece when you pull.

From there, pack your bowl with ground flower, hold it comfortably with your thumb near the carb (if present), and draw through the mouthpiece while the smoke bubbles through the water. The water knocks down some heat and harshness so the hit feels smoother compared to a dry spoon. Set it on a flat surface or a soft dab mat between hits so you’re not risking a drop when the coffee table gets crowded.

For cleaning, let it cool completely, empty the water, then rinse. For deeper cleans, a soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a fresh water rinse gets it back to clear and ready to go.

Specifications

Type Handheld glass bubbler
Length 6 inches (152mm)
Material Glass
Design Color swirl linework
Colors Multiple colors available (assorted)

Fit, Feel & Style

At 6 inches (152mm), this piece hits a nice middle ground: big enough for comfortable pulls, small enough to tuck away when you’re done. It’s the kind of bubbler you can keep by the window, on the nightstand, or next to your rolling tray without it taking over your whole setup. If you already run a bigger rig for concentrates, this makes a great flower companion next to your main silicone bongs & rigs.

The color swirl glasswork means no two pieces look exactly the same. Expect bright, trippy linework that stands out in a collection but still feels like a true daily driver, not just art you’re scared to touch.

Care & Cleaning Tips

To keep flavor and airflow on point, swap the water regularly and don’t let it sit with old water between seshes. When you notice buildup around the bowl or inside the chamber, a quick rinse usually buys you time, but a soak with isopropyl alcohol and a thorough rinse with warm water will get it back to almost-new.

If you’re cleaning multiple pieces or packaging up flower and concentrates at the same time, it’s handy to have your gear organized with a few dedicated storage & packaging options so tools, cleaners, and glass don’t end up all over the place.

FAQ

  • Is this good for beginners?
    Yes. A 6″ bubbler is actually a great first piece if you want smoother hits than a dry pipe but aren’t ready for a big bong. It’s simple to use, easy to fill, and the water does some of the heavy lifting on cooling.
  • How much water should I put in?
    Add just enough water to submerge the tip of the downstem when the piece is upright. If you’re getting splashback in your mouth, you’ve added a bit too much—pour some out and test again.
  • Can I travel with this bubbler?
    Yes, as long as you empty the water and pack it safely. Wrap it in a soft cloth or bubble wrap and tuck it into a padded bag or case so it’s not bouncing around with keys and lighters. If you want something even more impact-resistant for on-the-go, check out our tougher smoke shop products.
  • Is every color swirl pattern the same?
    No. These pieces come in assorted colorways, so swirl patterns and color combos will vary. That’s part of the fun—yours will have its own look while still matching the general style you see here.
  • How do I keep the glass from getting cloudy?
    Change the water often, don’t let it sit for days, and give it an occasional alcohol soak when you notice a film forming inside. Rinse thoroughly and let it dry before using again. If you’re handling concentrates nearby, working over parchment or parchment papers helps keep sticky residue off your glass in the first place.
  • Can I use this bubbler for concentrates?
    This piece is really designed for flower. While some people improvise, you’ll have a better experience using proper concentrate gear like rigs, bangers, and dedicated dab tools if you’re working with dabs.
  • What else pairs well with this bubbler?
    Besides a lighter and some ground flower, it pairs nicely with basic organization and storage gear—especially if you like to keep a few strains or prep ahead. Storing your material in proper glass jars & packaging helps keep things fresh between seshes and looks clean next to your new bubbler.

If you want a small, water-filtered piece that actually feels fun to use and easy to live with, the 6″ Color Swirl Glass Bubbler is a solid pick. Smooth pulls, bright colorwork, and a compact size that doesn’t demand a whole shelf—just rinse it, refill it, and it’s ready whenever you are.

At 6.5 inches (165mm), it rides that sweet spot between portable and powerful, cooling your smoke through water while still feeling solid in the hand. Clear glass and colorful linework let you watch the bubbles stack as you pull, so you actually see the filtration doing its thing.

Why You’ll Like It

  • Smoother hits than a dry pipe — Built-in water chamber cools and filters your smoke so your throat isn’t getting roasted every time you take a pull.
  • Easy to carry, easy to stash — 6.5 inches (165mm) is small enough for backpacks and drawers, but big enough that it doesn’t feel fragile or toy-sized.
  • See your function — Clear glass lets you watch the bubbles and water level, so you can dial in exactly how you like it instead of guessing.
  • Comfortable everyday piece — The curved bubbler shape gives you a natural grip and angle, ideal for a quick solo sesh or passing around the couch.
  • Colorful and noticeable — Artful color lines turn it from “just another piece” into something you actually want to leave out on the table.
  • Low-maintenance cleaning — Simple glass design means no hidden percs or crazy corners collecting gunk, so cleanup stays straightforward.

Best for

This bubbler is made for smokers who like the smoothness of a water pipe but don’t want a giant glass tower living on their coffee table. If you’re mostly doing personal bowls, quick after-work hits, or low-key hangs, this makes a perfect daily driver. It also pairs really well with a simple dab mat if you like keeping ash and water drips off your desk or nightstand.

How to Use It

Using this piece is as straightforward as it looks. Add a small amount of clean water into the bubbler’s chamber—just enough to cover the end of the downstem inside. Too much water and you’ll get splashback, too little and you lose the bubbling effect.

Once the water level feels right, pack your ground herb into the bowl and use the carb (if present) like you would on a standard hand pipe. The smoke pulls through the water, bubbles up, and comes out noticeably cooler and less harsh than a dry spoon. Set it down carefully between hits; a soft surface like a padded tray or even a silicone piece from our accessories collection helps keep your glass safer when you’re a few bowls in.

When you’re done, dump the used water instead of letting it sit. That alone does a lot of work in keeping the piece from smelling funky between seshes.

Let the bubbler cool fully before you try to clean it. For quick refreshes, swap the water and rinse with warm water to knock loose light residue. For a deeper clean, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry completely before using again.

If you’re storing the bubbler long-term or tossing it in a bag with other gear, consider keeping it empty and pairing it with some protective packaging or a padded case. You can find options in our broader storage and packaging collection if you want to baby your glass a bit.

Fit & Compatibility

This 6.5" Glass Bubbler is a standalone piece—no extra downstems or complicated joints to match, which makes life easier when you just want something that works. It’s primarily designed for dry herb, so think of it more like an upgraded, water-cooled hand pipe than a full-on dab rig.

If your setup leans more concentrate-heavy, you might want to keep this as your dedicated flower piece and use separate gear like nectar collectors or rigs for dabs so you’re not constantly deep-cleaning between different materials.

  • How much water should I put in this bubbler?
    Just enough to cover the end of the internal downstem is usually the sweet spot. You’ll know it’s right when you get good bubbling without water splashing up toward your mouth.
  • Is this better than a regular hand pipe?
    “Better” depends on what you like, but if you want cooler, smoother hits, the water filtration is a big upgrade over a standard spoon. If you’re used to dry pipes and your throat’s been feeling cooked, this style of bubbler can help a lot.
  • Can I use this for dabs?
    It’s mainly built for flower. You could technically rig something up, but you’ll get a much better experience using a proper rig with a banger or one of our dedicated dab tools and dabbers alongside a rig that’s meant for concentrates.
  • Will this fit in a small bag or stash spot?
    At 6.5 inches (165mm), it’s compact enough for most backpacks, larger purses, or basic stash boxes. If you need something even more pocketable or unbreakable, check out our flexible silicone bongs & rigs for true throw-it-in-the-bag-and-go energy.
  • How do I keep it from getting gross inside?
    Dump old water after each sesh and do a warm water rinse regularly. When you notice buildup or a smell that lingers, give it a soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well, and you’re back in business.
  • Is the glass thick enough for daily use?
    It’s designed as a daily driver, but it’s still glass—treat it with normal respect and don’t knock it off hard surfaces. Using it over a soft work area or general smoke shop gear like trays and pads helps avoid those heartbreaking drops.
  • Does it come in a specific color?
    Colors vary by batch and availability, so you’ll get a unique piece with colored linework instead of a totally plain clear bubbler. If you care a lot about color coordination, it pairs nicely with our colored glass jars for matching your stash and your piece.

The rocket-inspired body and shimmering finish give you smooth, water-filtered hits in a piece that actually looks as fun as it rips.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The bubbler chamber filters and cools your smoke before it hits your lungs.
  • Cosmic look on the coffee table — Iridescent glass shifts color in the light, so it always catches your eye.
  • Comfortable, handheld size — 6.5 inches (165mm) is big enough for real function but small enough to stash away quickly.
  • Art piece that actually gets used — Sculpted rocket design gives you a themed piece that isn’t just for show.
  • Glass feel you know and love — Classic glass construction for clean flavor and easy visual check on water and resin levels.

Best For

This bubbler is made for herb lovers who want water filtration without committing to a full-size bong. If you like the idea of a piece that doubles as decor, this rocket design fits right in with other display-worthy gear and plays nicely with your existing smoke shop products setup.

How to Use It

Think of this like a mini water pipe built for dry herb. Add a small amount of water to the base so the downstem area is covered, then load the bowl with ground flower and use it the same way you’d use a standard bubbler. The water does the heavy lifting on cooling so the hit feels less harsh than a dry pipe of the same size.

For smoother sessions and less mess, park your rocket bubbler on a nonstick surface like a dab mat or pad while you’re packing and clearing it. When it’s time to clean, just let the piece cool, dump the water, and do a quick rinse; for buildup, a short soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a thorough rinse and dry keeps the glass looking fresh.

The Basics & Feel in Hand

The sculpted rocket shape gives you natural grip points so you’re not white-knuckling a slippery cylinder, especially when you’re a few bowls in. The iridescent finish shifts between colors depending on lighting and angle, which makes the contours of the rocket body pop even more.

This kind of bubbler is a nice middle ground between a spoon pipe and a full water pipe: you still get that quick, casual feel of a hand pipe, but with extra comfort from the water filtration. If you already love compact rigs or silicone bongs & rigs, this glass rocket is an easy add to your rotation when you’re in a “treat yourself” mood.

Specifications

Product Type Glass bubbler
Height 6.5 inches (165mm)
Material Glass
Design Sculpted rocket body
Finish Iridescent, multiple colors available

Fit & Compatibility

This piece is designed as a standalone bubbler for dry herb, so you don’t have to worry about matching joint sizes or finding the right attachments. It’s compact enough to live on a small tray or shelf and fits easily into most organizers and cases meant for storage & packaging of small glass. If you like to keep your setup minimal, this can absolutely be your one and only water-filtered piece.

Care & Cleaning Tips

To keep the iridescent finish shining, avoid abrasive scrubbers on the outside; a soft cloth works best there. Inside, let the bubbler cool, dump any used water, then rinse with warm water. For deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry fully before the next sesh so you get clean flavor every time.

FAQ

  • Is this better than a regular hand pipe?

    If you find dry pipes a bit harsh, this bubbler is a nice upgrade because the water helps cool and filter the smoke. Compared to a straight spoon, the hits feel smoother and more forgiving on the throat, but you still get that quick, casual feel without dragging out a big bong and all the extras like dab tools or accessories.

  • Can I use concentrates in this rocket bubbler?

    It’s really meant for dry herb, so that’s where it shines. If you’re mainly into concentrates, you’ll probably be happier with dedicated rigs or nectar collectors instead, since they’re built around bangers and dab-style airflow.

  • How fragile is the piece?

    It’s made from glass, so it’s sturdy enough for regular use but not something you want to toss in a backpack without protection. Treat it like any other nice glass bubbler: set it down gently, avoid hard impacts, and give it a safe parking spot on your table—ideally on a soft surface like a mat or padded tray.

  • Does the iridescent finish fade over time?

    As long as you clean it with normal glass-friendly methods and skip harsh abrasives on the outside, the iridescent look holds up. Most of the wear you’ll see over time is just from resin buildup inside, which comes off easily with isopropyl alcohol, like you’d use on other glass or concentrate jars.

  • How much water should I put in it?

    Use just enough water to cover the bottom of the downstem area so you get bubbles without splashback. You can tweak the water level a bit until it feels right for your pull strength, but you don’t need to fill it very high for it to function well.

  • Is it easy to clean around all the sculpted details?

    Inside, it cleans like most bubblers—add a bit of alcohol, plug the openings, and gently shake, then rinse well. The sculpted rocket details are mostly on the outside, so they don’t trap much resin; if any spots are stubborn, you can use soft swabs or pipe cleaners like you would with other detailed accessories.

  • Will this fit in a standard stash box or case?

    At 6.5 inches (165mm), it fits in most medium-sized stash boxes and padded cases designed for bubblers or small rigs. Just make sure you’ve got enough height clearance and a bit of padding so the mouthpiece and base aren’t knocking into anything when you move it around.

The 6″ Two-Tone Donut Glass Bubbler is a compact glass bubbler for flower lovers who want smoother, cooler hits without hauling around a full-size bong. It’s built for people who care as much about the look of their piece as the function, with a standout donut-shaped chamber that really pops on a coffee table. At 6 inches (152mm), it’s small enough to be a daily carry but still has enough water volume for genuinely comfortable pulls.

Key Benefits

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The donut chamber forces smoke to travel farther and interact with more water, helping mellow out harshness before it hits your lungs.
  • Art-piece vibes — Two-tone color work and unique swirls mean no two bubblers look exactly the same, so your piece doesn’t feel mass-produced.
  • Still pocketable — At 6 inches (152mm), it’s big enough to function like a real bubbler but small enough to tuck into a bag for a park sesh or a friend’s place.
  • Easy, familiar workflow — If you’ve used a spoon or Sherlock before, the transition to this bubbler is basically instant: just add a little water and you’re set.
  • Less splashback — The donut design and upright profile help keep water down in the chamber so you’re not drinking your bong water mid-hit.
  • Thick glass feel — Made from quality glass with a solid hand feel, so it doesn’t feel fragile every time you set it down.

Best For

This bubbler is made for people who want a smoother alternative to dry hand pipes but don’t have the space (or interest) for a big tube. It shines as a daily driver for solo flower heads, a coffee-table piece for small apartments, or a compact upgrade if you’re coming from basic spoons. If you’ve already got a big water pipe or silicone bongs & rigs, this is a perfect “grab-and-go” option that still feels special.

The Basics

Function-wise, this is a classic handheld bubbler with a twist: the body has a donut-shaped chamber. Smoke is drawn from the bowl, down into the water, then pulled around that donut space before reaching the mouthpiece. That extra path and surface area is what helps knock the edge off hotter hits.

Because it’s one solid piece of glass, there are no moving parts or connections to worry about. Just a bowl, a water chamber, and a mouthpiece all fused into one smooth profile — simple, quick, and reliable when you’re already a couple bowls in and just want things to work.

How to Use It

Start by adding a small amount of water through the mouthpiece or bowl area — you only need enough to cover the end of the internal downstem. Give it a quick pull to make sure you’re getting gentle bubbling without splashing into your mouth. Once the water level feels right, you’re good to load up.

Grind or break up your flower, pack the bowl to your preferred density, then use it like any other bubbler or pipe: pull through the mouthpiece while you heat the bowl and let the water and donut chamber do the smoothing for you. It pairs nicely with a clean work zone — dropping it on a soft dab mat or pad helps protect the glass when you set it down between hits.

For cleaning, let the piece cool fully, then empty any leftover water. A quick rinse and wipe usually keeps day-to-day buildup in check. When it needs a deeper reset, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry before your next sesh.

This is a standalone bubbler — the bowl is built in, so you’re not swapping out slides or joints like a bong. That makes it super grab-and-go, but also means it’s not about modular add-ons. It plays best with good flower prep (a decent break-up or grind) and a lighter touch on packing so the airflow can do its thing.

If you like keeping all your gear organized, this piece fits right in with smaller tabletop setups alongside trays, lighters, and a couple of simple accessories like storage or basic tools.

  • Unique two-tone color pattern (varies by piece)

FAQ

  • How much water should I put in this bubbler?
    Just enough to cover the end of the internal downstem is usually ideal. Too much and you’ll get splashback; too little and you won’t get that smooth bubbling. Add a little, test the pull, and adjust until it feels right for you.
  • Is the color exactly the same as the photos?
    No — that’s part of the fun. The two-tone swirls and patterns vary from piece to piece, so your bubbler will have the same style but its own unique look. Think of the photos as the general vibe, not an exact clone.
  • Can I use this with concentrate or is it just for flower?
    This piece is designed as a flower bubbler with a built-in bowl. If you mostly dab, you’ll probably be happier with a dedicated rig or nectar collector that’s built around concentrates from the start.
  • What’s the best way to keep it clean?
    Dump the water after each sesh so it doesn’t get funky, then rinse with warm water. When buildup starts to show, soak the piece in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry. No fancy tools needed.
  • Is this fragile, or can it handle daily use?
    It’s still glass, so you don’t want to chuck it across the room, but it’s built for regular use. Treat it like any other nice glass piece: set it down gently, don’t drop it in the sink, and avoid super hard surfaces. If you’re rough on gear, you might want a backup in durable silicone pipes for travel or camping.
  • Does this replace a full-size bong?
    It can, depending on what you’re after. You’ll get smoother hits than a dry hand pipe, with way less bulk than a tall tube. Heavy hitters might still keep a full-size bong at home, while using this bubbler as their smaller daily driver or couch piece.
  • What else should I grab with this?
    Most people like to pair it with a decent grinder and some basic storage so their flower stays fresh between bowls. A small stash jar from our storage & packaging collection keeps your herb ready to go and helps the flavor stay on point.

If you want a piece that hits like a bubbler, carries like a hand pipe, and still looks like something you’d proudly leave out on the table, the 6″ Two-Tone Donut Glass Bubbler checks all the boxes.

If you like pieces that both hit well and look good on a shelf, this checks both boxes.

The Basics

This is a classic hammer-style bubbler with a fixed bowl and built-in water chamber. You get that familiar dry-pipe feel in your hand, but with the added perk of water cooling and a little bit of chug. The fumed glass slowly develops character over time as it sees more use, so the more you sesh with it, the more the colors and accents can pop against the mushroom implosion work.

Think of it as the middle ground between a spoon and a small water pipe: more filtration than a hand pipe, way more portable than a bong. Set it on a dab pad or mat when you’re not hitting it so you’re not risking sticky spots or accidental roll-offs.

How to Use It

Start by adding a small amount of water into the bubbler’s chamber from the mouthpiece or bowl end, just enough so the downstem area is covered when it’s in its normal upright position. You’re aiming for a light bubble, not a heavy splash, so you can hear and feel the percs working without catching water where it doesn’t belong.

Once the water level feels right, load your bowl with ground herb, get into your usual sesh rhythm, and let the water handle the cooling and basic filtration. If you like to keep your setup dialed, pairing this with a simple ash-catching routine and storing your herb in proper glass jars & packaging will keep the flavor and function on point.

Between bowls, just park the bubbler somewhere stable. A protective surface like a non-slip tray or accessory mat helps keep glass from knocking into hard tabletops when people reach for lighters and grinders.

Cleaning & Care

Let the bubbler cool down, then empty any old water and give it a warm rinse to loosen surface residue. Keeping it clean not only looks better, it also keeps those fumed colors and the mushroom implosion design shining through.

FAQ

  • Is this bubbler better than a regular hand pipe for smoother hits?
    Yes — the built-in water chamber cools the smoke and takes some harshness out compared to a dry spoon or chillum. If you like the feel of a pipe but want less bite on your throat, this is a good move before jumping to larger bongs or rigs.
  • How portable is the 7″ Fume Glass Bubbler?
    It’s very portable for a water piece. At 7 inches (177.8mm), it fits easily in a padded pouch or small bag, but it’s still glass, so treat it with the same care you’d give any heady piece. Many people use it as their “house piece” that can still travel to friends’ places when needed.
  • Can I use this for concentrates?
    This bubbler is designed primarily for dry herb. Some people like to keep herbs and dabs separate, and will use dedicated nectar collectors or rigs for concentrates. If you mainly dab, a rig built around bangers and carb caps might serve you better.
  • Does the mushroom implosion design change how it hits?
    Function-wise, the mushroom implosion is all about style. The smooth, cooled hit comes from the water doing its job in the chamber. The design just makes it way more fun to look at while you’re passing it around.
  • What’s the best way to keep it from getting super dirty?
    The easiest trick is to swap the water regularly and give it a quick rinse every few uses so buildup doesn’t get ahead of you. Storing your flower properly in airtight storage and packaging can also help keep flavor clean, so you’re not compensating with massive bowls and heavy residue.
  • Is this a good first water piece?
    Definitely. If you’re coming from small spoons or one-hitters, this bubbler is a gentle step up: simple to use, not overloaded with percs, and easy to understand. It gives you a feel for water filtration before you decide whether you want something bigger or more complex down the line.
  • How often should I change the water?
    There’s no strict rule, but changing it frequently is the move if you care about taste and cleanliness. Many people swap water every sesh or whenever it starts to look cloudy, especially if they’re using other gear like dab tools and accessories around the same station and want everything to stay fresh.

Slide the 14mm male joint of the bowl into the 14mm female joint on your water pipe until it seats firmly, then pack with ground herb and use your piece as you normally would.
