The 2″ 14mm Element Color and Fume Flower Bowl is a handcrafted glass slide made in Washington by Element Glass Art, built for people who actually care what their bowl looks like on the table. It’s a compact, 2-inch (50.8mm) tall flower bowl with a 14mm male joint that drops right into most modern water pipes. You’re buying this for the fume work, the color, and the feel in-hand — not some mass-produced replacement piece.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Instant upgrade to your setup — Swapping this in makes even a basic tube look like a custom piece thanks to the color and fume work.
  • Plays nice with most of your glass — Standard 14mm joint size means it fits the majority of modern bongs and rigs without any adapters.
  • Made to be passed around — Solid, USA-made construction from Element Glass Art holds up better than cheap import bowls when life (or roommates) get clumsy.
  • Each one has its own personality — Hand-fumed and colored, so no two bowls look exactly the same.
  • Easy reclaim and clean-up — Simple glass geometry means less resin traps and a faster soak when it’s time to freshen things up.
  • Perfect size for real seshes — The flower bowl is sized for shared bowls or a few solid personal snaps without constantly reloading.

Best For

This bowl is made for people who are picky about their glass but still want something they can actually use every day. If your daily driver’s joint is 14mm and you’ve been settling for the stock bowl it came with, this is a clean upgrade. It also fits right in with collectors who like to rotate bowls to match their mood or piece, especially if you already keep a dedicated dab pad or mat on the coffee table and treat your glass like art.

How to Use It

Pop your old slide out, drop this 2″ Element bowl into any 14mm female joint, and you’re basically set. The joint is shaped to seat firmly, so it’ll feel snug when you press it in, but still pull out smoothly when you clear the chamber. Load your flower, sesh as usual, and enjoy the way the fume work pops under a bit of light.

When you’re done, let the bowl cool down before you touch or clean it. If you like to keep your station organized, setting it down on a nonstick surface or next to your favorite smoking accessories helps avoid little resin rings on the table.

The Basics

This is a standard flower bowl — not a complicated multi-part piece — which is part of the appeal. The 2-inch (50.8mm) height gives you enough glass to grip when you’re pulling the bowl without putting your fingers too close to the hot end. Being made by Element Glass Art in the USA also means tighter QC than bulk import glass, so joints line up, seals feel right, and the bowl doesn’t wobble in the downstem.

The fume and color work aren’t just for show; as the piece builds a bit of use, you’ll notice the look evolve over time, with the fuming backing up against the resin and making the patterns and colors stand out even more.

Use Dry flower bowl

Fit & Compatibility

This bowl is designed for any water pipe or rig with a 14mm female joint. No adapters, no weird sizing — just plug and play. If your current piece came with a 14mm slide, this will drop right in. If your setup is 10mm or 18mm, you’d need an adapter (not included) or a different bowl size. It’s a flower bowl, so keep it paired with your standard water pipes rather than specialty pieces like silicone bongs and rigs that use other joint sizes or styles.

Care & Cleaning Tips

Let the bowl cool down completely before cleaning or handling for extended periods. For light maintenance, tap out the ash and gently wipe or poke loose any leftover material. For a deeper clean, soak the cooled bowl in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and dry before using again. Keeping up on quick cleans will help the color and fume work stay bright instead of getting completely muted under resin.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong or rig?
    If your piece has a 14mm female joint, this bowl will fit. That’s the standard size on a lot of modern water pipes and many smaller rigs. If you’re not sure, compare the existing bowl size or ask your shop what joint size your piece uses.
  • Is this for flower or concentrates?
    This is a traditional flower bowl, meant for dry herb. If you’re into concentrates too, pair it with a separate banger or one of our dedicated dab tools and dabbers instead of trying to use this for dabs.
  • What does “fume” mean on this bowl?
    Fume refers to a glassblowing technique where metals are vaporized and layered into the glass, giving that shifty, color-changing effect. Over time, as the bowl gets a bit of use, the fume work tends to pop even more against the background.
  • How fragile is it compared to cheaper bowls?
    It’s still glass, so treat it like glass, but USA-made pieces from Element Glass Art are generally thicker and better finished than a lot of budget slides. That means fewer sketchy thin spots and a more secure joint fit. For totally unbreakable options, you might want to keep a backup from our general smoke shop products lineup.
  • How do I keep the bowl from clogging?
    Use a consistent grind that’s not too fine, don’t overpack the hole, and give it a quick clean-out between bowls. When the airflow starts to feel restricted or you see buildup in the bottom, that’s your sign to do a quick soak and rinse. Storing your flower properly in good glass jars and packaging can also help it burn more evenly and leave less gunk behind.
  • Does each bowl look exactly the same?
    No — that’s the fun part. Because they’re hand-fumed and colored, expect variation from piece to piece. You’re getting the same general style and size, but the exact swirl, tone, and detail will be unique.
  • Any tips for keeping the colors looking good long term?
    Don’t let resin cake up forever. Regular quick cleans let the fume and colors stay visible instead of getting buried. If you’re swapping between pieces a lot or packing up your gear, consider stashing it in padded storage with the rest of your storage and packaging so it’s not rolling around loose in a bag.

The 2.5" Aluminum Bolt Grinder is a 5-piece herb grinder built for heavy rollers and home-base smokers who want smooth, consistent grind and maximum kief catch. At 2.5 inches (63.5mm) across, it hits that sweet spot between pocketable and big enough to prep multiple bowls or cones in one go. The lightning bolt cutouts aren't just a vibe—they give you real grip when you're grinding sticky flower.

Why You'll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Grinds enough for the whole sesh — 2.5 inch (63.5mm) diameter gives you plenty of surface area to prep multiple bowls or a few fat joints at once.
  • Smoother pulls, better burn — Consistent grind from the aluminum teeth means your flower packs evenly and doesn't clog up your piece.
  • Save every last crystal — 5-piece design with a dedicated kief chamber and scoop keeps all that good stuff from going to waste.
  • Built to be dropped — Solid aluminum body can handle getting tossed in a backpack, dropped on the coffee table, and used daily without falling apart.
  • Easy to twist, even sticky — The bold lightning bolt design doubles as a natural grip so you're not fighting the lid with resin on your hands.
  • Dialed-in for home setups — Large enough to be your main grinder, but compact enough to stash away when company comes over.

Best For

This grinder is made for people who grind a few times a day and don't want to baby their gear. If you're rolling multiple joints or packing bowls for the crew, the 2.5" Aluminum Bolt Grinder has enough capacity to keep up without feeling bulky. It also hits that sweet spot for anyone who has upgraded to a solid daily driver pipe or rig and wants their prep tools to feel just as dialed as their smoke shop gear.

The Basics: How to Use It

Pop the top section off and load your herb into the toothy grinding chamber, then set the lid back on and twist it back and forth until everything feels smooth and resistance drops. Ground material will fall through the holes into the middle chamber, ready for packing or rolling.

Below that, the fine screen lets only the smallest trichomes drop into the bottom kief compartment over time. When you're ready for a booster, crack open that last piece and use the integrated scoop to top a bowl, crown a joint, or stash some for a special occasion. If you like keeping your prep area spotless, parking this on a dab mat helps catch any stray crumbs.

When things start to feel sticky, you can unscrew the sections, tap out loose material, and give it a quick wipe so it keeps spinning smoothly. No need to overcomplicate it—this is a workhorse grinder meant to be used, not babied.

Specifications

Category Herb grinder
Material Aluminum
Diameter 2.5 inches (63.5mm)
Construction 5-piece

Fit & Everyday Use

At 2.5 inches (63.5mm), this grinder is big enough to live on your coffee table as a mainstay, but still compact enough to toss into a bag or stash box without taking over the whole space. It pairs naturally with anything from small hand pipes to larger pieces, and works especially well if you like to pre-grind a bit and keep it ready in jars. If you're the type who keeps different strains on deck, matching each one with its own grinder and a set of glass concentrate jars or stash jars keeps everything organized and fresh.

Care & Cleaning

Let any stuck material dry out a bit first, then gently tap the grinder over a surface to knock loose crumbs from the teeth and screens. For deeper refreshes, wipe metal surfaces with a little isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry fully before grinding again so everything spins smoothly. If you're the “super clean station” type, pairing this with some dedicated storage from our storage & packaging lineup keeps smells and residue under control.

FAQ

  • Is 2.5" too big to carry around?
    No, 2.5 inches (63.5mm) is very manageable for bags and backpacks. It's a bit large for tight jeans pockets but perfect for anyone who keeps their setup in a small case, stash box, or backpack.
  • How many bowls can I grind at once?
    It depends on your bowl size, but the 2.5" chamber easily handles enough herb for several bowls or a couple of packed cones in one grind. If you like to prep ahead, you can grind a full chamber and transfer it to jars or even pre-rolls stored in joint tubes.
  • Can I use this for really sticky, fresh flower?
    Yes, the aluminum teeth and the extra grip from the bolt design help a lot with stickier material. If it starts to feel gummed up over time, a quick wipe-down and dry-off will get it moving smoothly again.
  • Will the teeth dull or break easily?
    The aluminum build is designed for regular daily use. As long as you're only grinding plant material and not seeds, stems, or anything extra hard, the teeth should hold up for the long run and stay sharp enough for a fluffy grind.
  • How do I keep the kief screen from clogging?
    Every so often, empty the middle chamber, then gently tap or brush the screen from the underside to knock loose any buildup. If it gets really caked, a light isopropyl alcohol wipe followed by a full dry will bring it back. Some people like to tap the screen over a sheet of parchment paper so they can collect anything that falls through.
  • Is this grinder good for a first "real" setup?
    Definitely. If you're upgrading from a cheap plastic grinder or a tiny travel piece, the 5-piece Bolt Grinder feels like a serious step up. Pair it with a solid piece from our silicone bongs & rigs lineup and you've got a solid, durable home base that's hard to break.
  • What's the benefit of 5 pieces vs 3 pieces?
    A 5-piece setup gives you an extra level of separation and kief collection. You get a main grinding chamber, a ground herb catch, a screen, and a dedicated kief chamber below that. Over time, that bottom layer builds up a nice stash that you can scoop out and sprinkle over bowls, or save for those “end-of-the-week” reward seshes. If you like fine-tuning your setup, you can also combine this with other prep tools from our accessories collection.

Key benefits

  • Catch and save every crystal — Multi-layer design with a kief chamber and scoop means your pollen doesn’t just get lost in the teeth.

    Yes — it’s designed as a daily driver. The aluminum body holds up well to regular grinding, pocket carry, and being tossed on the table next to your papers or joint tubes without feeling delicate.

    It does. The 2.5″ Notched Aluminum Grinder is a five-piece setup with a main grinding chamber, a middle storage layer, and a bottom kief catcher separated by a fine screen, plus a scoop to collect what builds up down there.
  3. Can I use this for small amounts or is it only for big grinds?
    You can do both. The 2.5 inch (63.5mm) size gives you room for bigger loads when you’re grinding for a few heads, but it still works just fine with a single bowl’s worth if you’re keeping things light.
  4. How do I clean the grinder?
    Start by emptying all the chambers and brushing out the teeth and screen. For stubborn buildup, remove the metal sections and soak them briefly in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse with water and let everything dry fully before putting it back together.
  5. Will the aluminum affect the taste of my herb?
    No, the aluminum is there for strength and precision machining. Once your herb is ground, it’s not sitting in there long — you’re popping it right into your piece, papers, or a storage option like our reusable storage & packaging containers if you’re getting things ready ahead of time.
  6. How does this compare to a basic 2-piece grinder?
    A 2-piece is fine if you just want something super simple, but this five-piece gives you way more control and payoff. You get a dedicated kief catcher, a screen to separate fine material, and easier access to your ground herb without it getting packed into the teeth.

At just 4 inches (101.6mm), it disappears into a pocket or bag but still gives you a proper bowl and comfy grip. The fumed glass slowly shifts tones as you use it, so the more you sesh, the more it becomes your own.

Why You’ll Reach For This Pipe

  • Pocket-sized, not toy-sized — 4 inches (101.6mm) is short enough to stash, long enough to stay away from the heat.
  • Color that evolves with you — fumed glass reacts to use and buildup, creating that classic color-changing effect over time.
  • Simple, reliable function — classic spoon shape with a side carb and roomy bowl means no learning curve, just easy seshes.
  • Comfortable everyday grip — rounded body and mouthpiece sit naturally in your hand, whether you’re out walking or chilling on the couch.
  • Looks good on the table — the fume work and flower-style color accents make it feel more like a piece of glass art than a throwaway pipe.

Best For

This pipe is made for people who want a true daily driver that doesn’t feel cheap or fragile. If you’re the type who keeps a trusty spoon next to your grinder and only reaches for bigger glass on special occasions, this is the pocket piece that earns that spot. It also pairs nicely with other low-profile smoke shop essentials if you’re building out a simple, compact kit.

The Basics: How to Use & Care For It

The 4″ Fume Glass Hand Pipe keeps things classic: a bowl on one end, a side carb, and a straight shot to the mouthpiece. Load your material into the bowl, use the carb the way you’re used to with standard spoons, and you’re good to go. The short length makes it quick and low-fuss, perfect for solo snaps or passing between a couple friends.

Because it’s fumed glass, you’ll notice the color shift more as a bit of buildup develops inside. If you like the deep, rich tones, you can let that ride for a while. When you’re ready for a reset, let the pipe cool, then wipe off the loose residue. For a deeper clean, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with water, and let it dry fully before using again. Keeping a clean pipe next to your storage and packaging setup makes it way easier to taste what you’re actually smoking.

It’s also a good size for people who like a one-handed grip—thumb on the carb, fingers around the neck, no weird angles. If you already run a silicone rig or bigger water piece at home, this is the glass spoon that covers all your on-the-go or “quick bowl before bed” situations without taking up much space next to your silicone bongs and rigs.

FAQ

  • Does the color really change as I use it?

    Yes. The fumed glass is what gives it that color-shifting look—over time, as heat and residue build up inside, the tones deepen and shift. If you fully deep-clean it, you’ll see more of the original lighter tones again, so you can kind of “reset” the look when you want.

    It’s a standard glass hand pipe, so it’s tough enough for regular use but not something you want to drop on concrete. If you’re extra rough on gear, you might keep a backup from our more rugged silicone pipes lineup.

  • What’s the bowl size like?

    The bowl is sized for normal use—big enough for a few solid hits, not a micro bowl. It’s a good middle ground for solo seshes or sharing with one friend without constantly reloading.

  • Is it hard to keep clean with the fume design?

    Cleaning it is the same as any other glass spoon. Let it cool, tap out the ash, wipe what you can, and for a deeper reset, give it an isopropyl alcohol soak, then rinse and dry.     The design is “fume with color flower,” which means every piece follows that style but exact colors and patterns can vary by batch. That’s part of the charm—you’re getting a unique little piece of glass art, not a cookie-cutter clone.

If you like to rotate gear, you can keep your flower fresh in proper glass jars and let this pipe be your quick grab-and-go option.

  • How does it compare to more complex glass pieces?

    This is a straightforward, no-perc hand pipe—no water, no moving parts, just classic spoon function. If you’re chasing ultra-smooth, cooled hits with percs and recyclers, that’s a different lane. This one’s for people who want something simple, portable, and good-looking that works every time you pick it up, right alongside your other hand pipes.

For quick touchups, a simple wipe-down is usually enough. Running this routine alongside cleaning your other smoke shop products keeps your whole kit fresh.

column2: LINDA BIGGS FAIRY HAND PIPE IN ROLLING CASE BOX SET
column3:
The LINDA BIGGS FAIRY HAND PIPE IN ROLLING CASE BOX SET is a fantasy-inspired glass hand pipe and travel kit for folks who want their smoke gear to double as actual art. It’s built for collectors and fairy-core fans who like a smooth, simple hand pipe but still want something stunning on the coffee table. A 6 inch (152mm) borosilicate glass pipe rides safely in a matching rolling tray metal box, so you can keep your whole setup together and protected.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Art you can actually use — Linda Biggs’ colorful fairy artwork turns a regular hand pipe into a display piece you’ll actually leave out instead of hiding in a drawer.
  • Travel-ready without stress — The fitted metal rolling case protects your glass from bumps in your bag or backpack, so you’re not babying it every time you head out.
  • Easy to keep organized — Box doubles as a stash station so your lighter, papers, and pipe aren’t scattered across your table or car.
  • Comfortable daily driver — About 6 inches (152mm) gives you enough length to keep heat away from your face while still being easy to palm.
  • Gift-ready right out of the box — The matching artwork, metal case, and included sticker feel like a complete set, not an afterthought.
  • Borosilicate durability — Built from borosilicate glass, so it handles normal temp changes and everyday use better than cheap soft glass.

Best For

This set is made for people who want their hand pipe to say something about them—art collectors, fairy and fantasy fans, and anyone who’s bored of plain clear glass. It’s also a solid pick if you’re looking for a "nice" pipe to keep in rotation alongside your more low-key smoke shop staples.

If you’re the friend who always has the sesh kit ready to go, the rolling case makes this perfect as your grab-and-go home base. Toss it in a bag, glovebox, or backpack and everything stays together.

How to Use It

The pipe itself works like any classic glass hand pipe: load your bowl, use the carb, and let the length and shape do their thing to cool the hit a bit before it gets to you. The slightly longer 6 inch (152mm) profile helps keep your face away from heat and ash while still feeling compact in hand.

When you’re done, let the piece cool, then nestle it back into the rolling tray metal box. You can also use the box as a mini rolling or packing station—build everything in the tray area so stray crumbs, ash, and flower stay contained instead of all over your dab mat or table.

The Linda Biggs sticker can go on the case, a stash box, a laptop, or wherever you want your fairy theme to live. The whole idea is that your kit feels fun and personal, not generic.

Specifications

Category Glass Hand Pipe + Rolling Case Box Set
Artist Linda Biggs (Fairy Artwork)
Pipe Material Borosilicate Glass
Pipe Length 6 inches (152mm)
Box Dimensions 7 x 4.5 x 2 inches (178 x 114 x 51mm)
Price $54.99

What’s in the Box

  • Linda Biggs fairy-themed glass hand pipe (6 inches / 152mm)
  • Matching rolling tray metal box (7 x 4.5 x 2 inches / 178 x 114 x 51mm)
  • Linda Biggs sticker

Care & Cleaning

Let the pipe cool first, then tap or gently dump out any ash. For routine upkeep, wipe off loose residue and keep the mouthpiece and bowl clear. When it needs a reset, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with warm water, and let it dry fully before your next use. The metal box can be wiped out with a cloth or paper towel if it picks up dust or crumbs from your storage and packaging stash.

Pair It With

Because this set is all about keeping your kit neat and portable, it pairs nicely with small stash upgrades. Heavy-bottom glass concentrate jars or flower jars keep everything fresh inside the rolling box without smells leaking everywhere. If you also enjoy concentrates, this makes a great "flower side" to run alongside your rigs and other hardware.

FAQ

  • Is this pipe more of a collector’s piece or an everyday pipe?
    You can absolutely treat it as a daily driver—the borosilicate glass and 6 inch (152mm) length are practical for regular use. The Linda Biggs fairy artwork just means it looks a lot better than the average hand pipe in your drawer, so it also works as a display piece with your other art-forward bongs and rigs.
  • How sturdy is the rolling tray metal box for travel?
    The metal box is designed to handle normal bumps in a bag, backpack, or glovebox. It’s there to protect the glass from minor impacts and keep everything together, and it also doubles as a mini rolling tray so mess stays inside the case, not all over your car or couch.
  • Will the 6 inch (152mm) pipe fit comfortably in smaller hands?
    Yes. The length gives you a good grip without feeling oversized, so it works well for small to medium hands. It’s a nice middle ground between tiny pocket spoons and big, bulky pieces you’d usually leave at home.
  • How should I store it when I’m not using it?
    Keep the pipe in the metal box with any lighters or extras you like to travel with. If you’re keeping flower or concentrate in the same kit, consider sealing them in jars or mylar bags inside the box so odors stay controlled and your artwork and glass stay clean.
  • Is this set a good gift for someone new to smoking?
    Yes, as long as they’re in a legal market and of age, this makes a great "first nice piece"—simple to use, easy to store, and cool enough that it won’t feel like a starter pipe they’ll immediately upgrade from. The included sticker and artwork give it that extra gift feel without needing any extras.
  • Does the artwork fade or peel off?
    The fairy design is part of the printed artwork on the case and the glass, so normal handling and cleaning won’t make it vanish. Just avoid harsh abrasives on the printed areas of the box; a basic wipe-down is all you need, same way you’d treat other printed smoking accessories.
  • Can I fit other items in the rolling tray box besides the pipe?
    Yes, there’s room for small essentials like a lighter, papers, and maybe a small jar or tube, depending on how you pack it. Think of it as a compact kit box—enough for a tidy travel setup, not a full-blown home stash. If you need more room, you can still use it as the centerpiece inside a bigger bag or case.

column2: 5″ WIG WAG DICHRO PIPE W/ OPAL
column3:
The 5″ Wig Wag Dichro Pipe w/ Opal is a heady glass hand pipe built for people who care just as much about art as they do about function. At 5 inches (127mm), it’s that perfect in-between size: big enough to show off the linework and dichro, small enough to still be a true pocket piece. This is the kind of pipe you keep on the coffee table, not in a drawer.

Why You’ll Reach For It

  • Looks like a mini gallery piece — Bold wig wag sections and shimmering dichro glass catch light from every angle, so it pops whether you’re under LEDs or sunlight.
  • That opal flex — The embedded opal cab adds depth and sparkle, the kind of detail that makes people pick it up and say “okay, this is nice.”
  • Comfortable 5″ (127mm) form factor — Long enough to keep heat away from your face, short enough to toss in a bag or case without babying it.
  • Horn-style grip — The sculpted horn makes it easy to hold and pass around without feeling like you’re about to drop your favorite piece.
  • Heady without being fragile — Thick, quality glass gives it a solid hand-feel, so it’s not some museum-only piece you’re scared to actually smoke out of.
  • Every piece feels unique — Wig wag and dichro patterns vary, so you’re not ending up with the same boring spoon as everyone else.

Best For

This pipe is made for people who like a little flex in their daily driver. If you’re the friend who brings the “nice glass” to the sesh, or you want one pipe that can live next to your dab mat and still look good next to your rig, this fits right in. It’s also a great pick for collectors who want something heady without committing to a full-size tube.

How to Use & Care For It

Pack your favorite dry herb into the bowl, use the carb as you normally would, and let the pipe do its thing—this one’s all about a smooth, straightforward experience with a bit of flair. The 5″ (127mm) length helps cool things down a bit before it hits, and the horn gives you a natural spot for your fingers, so it feels secure even when you’re a few bowls deep.

When you’re done, tap out the bowl gently and let the pipe cool before wiping away loose residue. For deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry completely before your next sesh. If you like to rotate glass, this makes a great “nice but still practical” option alongside more rugged pieces from our smoke shop products lineup.

The Basics

This is a dry hand pipe—no water, no moving parts, no learning curve. Load, use, tap out, repeat. The real magic here is the glasswork: wig wag (that trippy stacked linework) plus dichro (that glittery, color-shifting effect in the glass) plus the opal accent. If you already run a rig or two, this is the kind of hand pipe that feels at home next to more serious glass, not like an afterthought.

Because of the horn and thicker glass, it also sits nicely on a flat surface without rolling around, which is underrated when you’re juggling jars, grinders, and maybe a couple concentrate jars on your table.

Specifications

Category Hand pipe (dry)
Length 5 inches (127mm)
Material Glass
Design Features Wig wag pattern, dichro sections, opal accent, horn-style grip

Fit & Style Notes

This piece is sized right in that sweet spot—bigger than a one-hitter, smaller than a clunky home-only pipe. It fits easily in most padded pouches or cases, and the horn gives you an easy grab point when you’re reaching into a bag. If you like pairing your glass with matching accessories, it sits nicely in a tray setup alongside other accessories like lighters, tools, and storage.

FAQ

  • Is the opal in this pipe real?

    Yes, the pipe features a real opal cab encased in the glass. It won’t rub off or fall out—it’s trapped in there for good and adds that extra bit of depth and sparkle when the light hits it.

  • How big is the bowl on this piece?

    It has a comfortable, standard-sized bowl—big enough for shared bowls, but not so huge that you’re wasting herb when you’re solo. If you like regular spoons, this will feel very familiar, just with a lot nicer glasswork.

  • Is it okay as a daily driver, or is this more of a “special occasion” pipe?

    You can absolutely daily this piece. It’s thick, solid glass built to be used, not just stared at. If you want something cheaper and completely worry-free for taking outside or travel, you might also keep a backup from our silicone pipes around, but this one holds up fine as your main at-home pipe.

  • How do I keep the wig wag and dichro looking clean?

    Let the pipe cool, then wipe off loose residue regularly so buildup doesn’t stain. For a deeper refresh, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well, and dry. Keeping it reasonably clean makes the colors and dichro really pop under light.

  • Does this work with any attachments or water?

    This is a straight dry hand pipe with no added attachments or water chambers—it’s meant to be simple and ready to go on its own. If you want something that runs through water, check out our silicone bongs & rigs for more filtration-heavy setups.

  • Are all the colors and patterns the same?

    No, that’s part of the fun. Wig wag sections, color combos, and how the dichro and opal sit can vary from piece to piece, so yours will have its own personality even if the overall shape and size match the listing.

  • What should I store it in so it doesn’t get scratched or broken?

    A padded pouch, case, or even a small lined box works great if you’re tossing it in a bag. If you’re keeping it at home, a dedicated spot near your grinder, papers, or storage & packaging setup is ideal so it’s not rolling around with keys or other hard stuff.

column3:
The ELEMENTS 1 1/4 Classic Papers 25BX is a full box of classic rice rolling papers built for people who care about clean flavor and consistent burns. Designed for meticulous rollers and daily smokers, each sheet is ultra-thin, slow-burning, and made to leave virtually zero ash. With 50 leaves per pack and 25 packs per box, this setup is all about stocking your stash with papers you actually like using.

Why You’ll Love These Papers

  • Cleaner-tasting rolls — Pure rice paper with no pulp or hemp means the flavor you’re getting is from your herb, not your paper.
  • Even, dependable burn — The signature Criss-Cross watermark helps prevent runs, canoeing, and weird hot spots along the side.
  • Less ash, more flavor — Designed to produce almost zero ash, so you’re not constantly tapping out or dealing with a messy tray.
  • Slow, chill sessions — Ultra-thin, slow-burning sheets give you more time with each roll instead of racing against an overactive cherry.
  • Bulk box for real smokers — 50 leaves per pack and 25 packs per box means 1,250 papers ready to go, so you’re not hitting the corner shop every week.
  • Great for precise, tight rolls — The thin, crispy rice paper is perfect if you like to roll slim, efficient joints instead of fat, wasteful ones.

Best For

This 25-pack box is made for people who roll often and care about how their papers actually burn. If you’re the friend everyone asks to roll, or you’re running through packs every few days, having a dedicated box like this just makes sense. It also pairs nicely with the rest of a dialed-in smoking station, especially if you’re already rocking durable gear from our broader smoke shop products lineup.

How to Use Them (and Get the Most Out of Each Roll)

Elements 1 1/4 Classics are straightforward: grab a sheet, load it up, and roll to your preferred style. The rice paper is thin but sturdy enough for practiced hands, so it really shines if you already have your technique locked in.

Because they’re ultra-slow burning, they pair nicely with a steady-paced sesh where you’re passing around a piece and actually enjoying the taste. Laying everything out on a solid surface like a good dab mat or pad helps keep stray crumbs and ash from taking over your table.

You’ll notice the Criss-Cross watermark as a faint pattern in the paper. That pattern is what helps keep the burn line moving evenly instead of letting one side race ahead. As long as your roll is reasonably even, the paper does a lot of the work for you.

Specifications

Packs per box 25
Leaves per pack 50
Total leaves per box 1,250
Paper type Classic rice paper
Size 1 1/4 (standard 1 1/4 dimensions)

Fit, Feel & Rolling Style

1 1/4 size is the go-to for a lot of everyday smokers: big enough for a solid group roll, but not so oversized that you’re wasting herb. If you’re used to king size papers, these will feel a bit shorter and more compact, which many people prefer for solo seshes.

The rice paper has that light, almost glassy feel compared to thicker wood or hemp papers. Once you get used to it, it’s hard to go back because the flavor is so clean. Keeping your material evenly broken down helps them shine, so pairing them with a reliable grinder from our accessories section is a smart move.

Care & Storage Tips

Store the box somewhere dry and out of direct sunlight to keep the papers crisp and easy to work with. Humidity can make any rolling paper feel soft or wrinkly over time, so keeping the packs closed between rolls goes a long way. If you’re splitting packs with friends, just make sure the remaining papers stay in their sleeve to protect the edges.

FAQ

  • Are these papers bleached or flavored?
    No. ELEMENTS 1 1/4 Classics are unflavored rice papers. They’re designed to burn clean and neutral so your herb flavor comes through as clearly as possible.
  • Do they run or canoe easily?
    Not if your roll is reasonably even. The Criss-Cross watermark helps the ember track straight across the paper, which really cuts down on runs compared to cheap, unmarked sheets.
  • Is this box good for casual smokers, or is it overkill?
    If you only roll occasionally, 1,250 papers is a lot, but they’ll still last a long time if stored properly. For daily smokers or people who roll for the crew, a full box is actually super convenient and usually more cost-effective than buying single packs. If you’re pairing with long-term flower storage, check out our airtight glass jars & packaging to keep your stash fresh while you work through the box.
  • Can I use these with filters or tips?
    Yes, they work great with crutches or pre-made tips. The 1 1/4 length leaves enough room for a filter and a decent amount of herb without turning the roll into a log. If you like to keep your rolls clean on the ends, stash your tips and tools in one spot using our broader storage & packaging options.
  • How do these compare to hemp papers?
    Hemp papers usually have a more noticeable taste and slightly thicker feel. Rice papers like these are thinner, lighter, and more neutral on flavor, with less ash. If you prefer a more “barely there” paper, rice is the move.
  • Will these work for mixing concentrates into my rolls?
    Yes, as long as you don’t overload the paper with heavy or sticky material. Keep your rolls reasonably balanced so the burn stays even. If you’re rolling with hash or rosin often, it’s worth keeping those concentrates stored in proper concentrate jars so they’re easy to work with when you’re rolling.
  • Do I need any special gear to roll with these?
    No special tools needed, but a solid grinder, a clean surface, and maybe a rolling tray or pad make the ritual smoother. If you ever switch things up from papers, these also live nicely next to your silicone pipes or other pieces so everything’s ready for whatever kind of sesh you’re in the mood for.

The ELEMENTS 1 1/4 Classic Papers 300s (20/box) are ultra-thin rice rolling papers built for heavy rollers, shops, and anyone who cares more about flavor than paper. Pure rice with that classic Elements Criss-Cross watermark means clean, slow, almost ash-free burns. At 1 1/4 size (about 76mm x 40mm), they hit the sweet spot for everyday personals without wasting flower.

Why These Papers Hit Different

  • Clean flavor, almost no ash — Pure pressed rice paper burns down to a faint white line so you taste your flower, not the paper.
  • Fewer runs, less babysitting — Elements' Criss-Cross watermark helps the paper burn evenly, so you’re not chasing runs mid-sesh.
  • Perfect everyday size — 1 1/4 format at 76mm x 40mm gives you a comfortable personal roll without turning it into a marathon.
  • Bulk-friendly for real smokers — 300 leaves per pack and 20 packs per box keep frequent rollers and busy shops stocked for a while.
  • Minimal ingredient list — No pulp, no hemp, no chalky nonsense—just rice paper and a thin natural gum line.
  • Rolls tight or fluffy — Thin paper is flexible enough for cone-style, straight, or anything in between without fighting you.

Best For

These ELEMENTS 1 1/4 Classics are made for people who roll a lot and actually care how their joints burn. If you’re running through multiple rolls a day, stocking a crew, or grabbing a box for your shop counter, this 300-count format keeps you from constantly re-upping. They’re also solid for anyone switching from thicker papers and wanting a smoother, cleaner-tasting upgrade to pair with their favorite smoke shop products.

The Basics: How These Papers Work

Each sheet is an ultra-thin strip of rice paper with a light Criss-Cross watermark printed across the surface. That pattern isn’t just for looks—it controls how the paper burns so your joint stays even instead of canoing down one side. The gum line is a narrow strip along one edge designed to seal with just a quick lick and press.

The 1 1/4 size gives you enough room to roll a proper joint without needing origami skills. You can go with a looser, fluffier cone or a tighter cylinder—these papers are thin and pliable, so they wrap around your grind easily. Set your pack on a small dab mat or tray to keep your rolling area clean and organized.

How to Use Them (Without Overthinking It)

Pull a sheet from the 300-pack stack and decide if you want a crease or a straight sheet—these come flat so you can choose. Add your ground flower and shape it the way you like; the thin rice paper hugs the material as you tuck and roll. Once everything feels tight and even, seal along the gum line and you’re good to go.

If you’re rolling for a group or doing a bunch back-to-back, it helps to keep your material prepped and staged in something cleaner than a baggie—think small glass concentrate jars or similar containers so your flower stays fresh while you roll through the box.

Specifications

Paper Type Classic Elements rice rolling paper
Size 1 1/4 – 76mm x 40mm (approx. 3.0 x 1.6 inches)
Leaf Count (per pack) 300 leaves
Pack Count (per box) 20 packs
Case Count 30 boxes per case (wholesale level)

Fit, Feel & Rolling Style

Because these are ultra-thin rice papers, they feel lighter and a bit more delicate than thick wood-pulp papers—but that’s what gives you the clean smoke. Once you get used to them, you’ll notice you need less paper overlap and your joints feel smoother and more streamlined in the hand.

They work great with hand rolling or basic rollers; if you’re using any kind of roller, just make sure it’s sized for 1 1/4 papers and you’re set. For folks who like to tuck in a cardboard tip or filter, there’s enough width to add one without making things bulky—especially if you keep your material evenly ground, which you can dial in with your go-to grinder or other rolling accessories.

Care & Storage

Even though they’re just papers, how you store them matters. Keep the box somewhere dry and cool so humidity doesn’t warp or curl the leaves. Try not to leave packs stuffed in sweaty pockets or in direct sun—rice papers can pick up moisture or get too crisp if they’re abused.

If you’re only cracking one pack at a time, leave the others sealed in the display box or stash them with your other long-term storage and packaging so they stay fresh for months.

FAQ

  • Are these papers bleached or flavored?
    No flavors, no dyes, no pulp. These are classic unflavored rice papers designed to stay as neutral as possible so your flower does the talking.
  • Will these fit in my 1 1/4 rolling machine?
    Yes. Any rolling machine made for standard 1 1/4 papers will play nice with these, as long as it’s in decent shape and not gummed up with old resin or crumbs.
  • Do they come with tips or filters?
    No, this box is strictly papers. If you like using crutches, you can rip your own from card or grab separate tips along with other smoke shop staples to round out your kit.
  • Are rice papers harder to roll than regular papers?
    They can feel different at first because they’re thinner and smoother, but most people adjust quickly. Once you get the hang of them, they actually make it easier to roll clean, tight joints that don’t feel bulky.
  • Do these burn slower than thicker papers?
    The combo of rice paper and the Criss-Cross watermark helps them burn slow and even without a ton of ash. Your grind, pack, and roll all play a part, but these are definitely on the “slow burn” side of the spectrum.
  • Can I use these with mixes or herbal blends?
    Yes. Whether you’re rolling straight flower or mixing in other legal herbs, the neutral rice paper won’t overpower the flavor of what you’re packing.
  • What’s the benefit of getting the 300s instead of regular packs?
    You get way more sheets per pack, which is perfect if you roll daily or run through papers fast. It also cuts down on how often you’re buying more, which is nice when you’d rather be stocking up on rigs, silicone bongs, and the fun stuff instead of constantly hunting for another pack of papers.

The Zig-Zag Glass Ashtray – Classic is a thick-glass, tabletop ashtray made for joint rollers and blunt lovers who appreciate the old-school Zig-Zag vibe as much as a clean ash spot. It’s solid enough to be a daily driver and pretty enough to leave out, with a roughly 5 inch (127mm) diameter that’s roomy without hogging the table.

Why You’ll Actually Use This

  • Feels solid in the hand — Thick glass construction gives it nice weight so it doesn’t slide or tip when you tap off ash.
  • Keeps your rolls off the table — Three indented rests hold your joints or blunts instead of having them burn on random edges.
  • Printed to last — Artwork and logos are embedded beneath the surface, so you’re not scratching off the design after a few cleans.
  • Classic Zig-Zag story on display — The iconic branding and history printed on the bottom make it a low-key collector piece, not just a catch-all for ash.
  • Easy wipe-down between seshes — Smooth glass surface means ash and resin don’t cling like they do to cheap plastic or wood.

Best for

This one’s made for people who roll their own and want their ashtray to look as good as the rest of their glass. If your coffee table already has a couple of pieces, a grinder, and maybe a silicone pipe or two, this is the centerpiece that ties the whole setup together without feeling like clutter. It also fits nicely into a more curated bar-cart or smoke shop essentials style display if you like your gear to look intentional, not random.

How to use it

Day to day, it works exactly how you want an ashtray to work: park it on your table, drop a cone or roll into one of the three grooves, and tap your ash into the deep glass bowl. The indents are spaced so you can rest multiple joints or blunts at once, which is clutch during group seshes when there’s more than one thing burning.

Because it’s glass, it handles heat from cherry tips without getting cooked or warped. You can keep it right next to your grinder, papers, and lighter, or set it on a small dab mat if you like to keep your surfaces extra protected from stray ash and tiny burns.

Cleaning is simple: let everything cool, dump the ash, and wipe it out. When it’s starting to look a little stained from resin or tar, a short soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a rinse and dry will bring the clarity right back so that Zig-Zag artwork pops again.

Specifications

Product Zig-Zag Glass Ashtray – Classic
Material Thick glass
Diameter Approximately 5 inches (127mm)
Resting Grooves 3 indented rests for joints/blunts
Design Classic Zig-Zag imagery embedded under glass with story printed on bottom

Where it fits in your setup

The Classic glass Zig-Zag tray plays nice with any rolling station: tuck it beside your favorite pack of papers, or park it next to a stack of rolling papers so guests know exactly what’s up when they sit down. The 5 inch (127mm) footprint fits on most small side tables, window ledges, or desks without feeling oversized.

If you keep a little stash corner with jars, lighters, and tools, this ashtray slides right in visually with glass or ceramic pieces. It also pairs well with storage like jars, mylar, or joint tubes, especially if you like everything to match your brand/theme when you’re rolling for friends or clients and stashing finished product in storage and packaging that actually looks professional.

FAQ

  • Is the artwork going to scratch or fade?
    The imagery is embedded beneath the glass surface, so normal use, wiping, and tapping ash won’t wear it off. You’re not dealing with a cheap surface sticker here.
  • How big is it really? Will it hog my table?
    It’s about 5 inches (127mm) across, which is big enough to comfortably catch ash and hold a few smokes without taking over your coffee table or rolling tray. It’s a good balance between compact and functional.
  • Can it handle hot ash and cherry tips?
    Yes, it’s thick glass made for real smoking, not just decoration. It’s designed to handle hot ash and the occasional dropped cherry without cracking under normal use.
  • What’s the best way to clean this ashtray?
    Let it cool down, dump out the loose ash, and wipe it with a paper towel or cloth. For a deeper clean, soak it briefly in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, then dry. That’s usually enough to cut through tar and keep the glass crystal clear for the Zig-Zag design.
  • Will this look okay with my other glass and accessories?
    The clear, thick glass and classic Zig-Zag branding match well with most bongs, rigs, and classy glass jars. If you’ve already got a lineup of glass storage, like heavy-bottom jars or display pieces, this ashtray slides right in visually with your other glass packaging and jars.
  • Is this just for joints and blunts, or can I use it with anything?
    You can use it with whatever you’re burning — pre-rolls, cones, blunts, or even as a catch-all for spent tips and matches. The three rests are perfect for shaped rolls, but the bowl itself works like a standard ashtray for pretty much anything you’re ashing.
  • Does it work with other Zig-Zag or rolling accessories?
    Absolutely. It’s right at home in any rolling kit with papers, cones, filters, and a grinder. A lot of people set it up next to their favorite papers on a small tray and keep their finished rolls stored in airtight joint tubes so there’s always something ready to rest in the ashtray.

The VIBES Wide Tips Box – Kraft is a bulk box of wide rolling tips built for people who roll all the time and hate running out of filter material. These are for daily rollers and crew seshes where consistency matters more than improvising with torn-up business cards. With 50 booklets in the box and a sturdy kraft feel, you get clean, stable rolls for the long haul.

Each sheet is cut wide to give your joints more support and smoother airflow, so the end stays open and your herbs stay out of your mouth. If you like your rolls to look and hit the same every time, this box turns “Do I have tips?” into a non-issue for months.

Why It Works

  • Smoother pulls every time — Wide tips keep the end of your roll open and shaped, so airflow stays consistent all the way down.
  • No more herb in your teeth — The tip acts as a barrier, keeping loose bits of flower from making it to your mouth.
  • — The extra width gives more structure at the base, which helps your joint pack evenly and burn more predictably.
  • Bulk box for real smokers — 50 booklets in one box means you’re stocked for parties, road trips, and those “one more?” nights.
  • Easy to fold and shape — The kraft sheets are firm enough to hold form but still flexible enough for W’s, spirals, or whatever style you like.
  • Less waste, more function — Purpose-made tips beat tearing cardboard, so your rolls look cleaner and feel better in hand.

Best For

The VIBES Wide Tips Box – Kraft is made for people who roll multiple times a day and want their joints to feel like they came from someone who knows what they’re doing. It’s also clutch for anyone keeping a stash spot or travel kit dialed in alongside other everyday smoke shop essentials.

If you’re the one rolling for the group, this box keeps you prepared without needing to grab another pack every week. Toss a booklet in your bag, leave a few at home, and keep the rest in your main setup for backup.

How to Use It

Pop open a booklet, tear off a single sheet, and fold it into the tip style you like—simple accordion folds, a tight spiral, or a combo of both. Then you drop that tip at the end of your paper before you start forming your roll, so it becomes the base everything packs around.

Building off a good tip makes the rest of the roll a lot easier, especially when you’re working over a dab mat or tray and don’t want crumbs everywhere. Because the tips are wide, you get more control over how open or tight the mouthpiece feels.

After you’re done, you’ll notice the tip keeps your joint from collapsing at the end and gives you something solid to hold, which is especially nice during longer seshes when things usually get soft and messy.

Product VIBES Wide Tips Box – Kraft
Type Rolling tips (wide)
Booklets per Box 50
Sheets per Booklet 50
Total Sheets 250

Fit & Compatibility

These wide tips are designed to play nice with most standard rolling papers and wraps, from shorter personal rolls to longer, party-sized creations. If you keep a rotation of papers around, they’ll sit right next to your favorite storage and packaging gear without needing any special sizes.

The wider format gives you some flexibility—roll them tight for smaller papers or leave them a bit looser and open if you like bigger rolls. Either way, they’re meant to work with what you already smoke.

Care & Storage

Since these are kraft paper tips, there’s no real “cleaning” needed—just keep the box dry and away from spills. Store it somewhere cool and out of direct sunlight, the same way you’d treat your glass jars and packaging so everything stays crisp and ready to roll.

FAQ

  • Are these tips pre-rolled or flat sheets?
    They’re flat sheets in booklet form. You tear off a sheet and fold or roll it into the tip shape you like, which gives you more control over how open or tight the mouthpiece feels.
  • Will these work with king size or just standard papers?
    These wide tips work with both standard and king size papers. For bigger rolls, just leave the tip a bit more open; for smaller papers, roll the tip tighter. They’re a good all-around choice if you switch paper sizes often.
  • Do they change the flavor of my herb?
    No, the kraft tips are just there for structure and airflow. They’re neutral, so your flavor comes from your flower and papers, not the filter. If you’re picky about taste, pair them with clean-burning papers and stash your herbs in proper glass jars to keep terps happy.
  • How many rolls can I realistically get from one box?
    You get 250 individual tip sheets. So, if you use one tip per joint, that’s 250 rolls. If you’re rolling multiple times a day or passing a lot with friends, this box still lasts way longer than single packs.
  • Can I use these with cones or just hand-rolled joints?
    They’re mainly meant for hand-rolled joints, but you can shape them and slide them into empty cones if you like a more solid mouthpiece. Just fold and roll them to a tighter size that fits the cone opening.
  • Are these better than tearing cardboard from a pack?
    Functionally, yes. These are cut to a consistent width and thickness, so your tips feel the same every time and don’t get soggy or collapse as easily. Plus, they look cleaner when you’re rolling on a proper surface like one of our rolling accessories.
  • What’s the difference between wide tips and regular tips?
    Wide tips give you more material to work with, which means more support at the end of your roll and a bigger range of sizes you can shape. Regular tips are narrower and can feel a bit flimsy on larger rolls, while wide tips hold up better on both small personals and longer party joints.

If you’re tired of scavenging for scraps to use as filters and want your rolls to feel dialed in every single time, the VIBES Wide Tips Box – Kraft is a simple upgrade that makes a big difference in day-to-day rolling. Keep a box on hand along with your favorite smoke shop deals, and you’re set for a lot of very easy, very consistent seshes.

What You Get Out of These

  • Cleaner, more controlled pulls — The firm tip keeps the end open and shaped so you’re not fighting for airflow or dealing with scooby snacks.
  • Faster rolls, less fuss — Pre-rolled means you skip the “fold, roll, re-roll” filter dance and just build your cone and fill.
  • Consistent structure every time — Each tip is the same size, so your rolls feel and function the same from sesh to sesh.

Best For

The Cali Pre-Rolled Tips are made for people who roll often and want a filter that behaves the same every single time. If you’re the designated roller for the crew, or you like your cones to look clean enough to post, these will feel like a serious upgrade over ripping cardboard off random packaging.

They’re also clutch for anyone building a compact on-the-go kit alongside their favorite smoke shop essentials, so rolling on a park bench or in the backseat still feels dialed in.

How to Use Them

Drop one of these pre-rolled tips at the end of your paper where you want the mouthpiece, then build your cone around it like you normally would. The pre-shaped cylinder gives you something solid to roll against, so even quick, one-handed rolls come out looking clean.

Because the tips are already formed, they hold their shape while you pack and finish your roll, which makes them especially nice when you’re loading up on a tray or dab mat and don’t want tiny bits of cardboard unraveling on you.

After your sesh, you can just ash and tap out the end like any other finished roll; the tip stays intact, doing its job right up to the last pull.

If you’re stocking up for a full rolling station with papers, grinders, and storage, they play especially well alongside proper storage and packaging so your flower and tips are always ready to go when you are.

Care & Handling

These are single-use tips — once they’ve done their job in a roll, just discard them. If a tip picks up dust or pocket lint before you use it, a quick wipe or brush-off is all you need. Keep the pack closed and stored dry so the paper stays crisp and holds its shape.

For people who like to pre-roll in batches, set them up in your papers, fill, and then stash the finished pieces in airtight glass jars and packaging to keep everything fresh until you’re ready to burn.

Why These Over Regular Cardboard?

Sure, you can rip a flap off a pack and roll your own makeshift tip, but pre-rolled filters like these stay tighter, look cleaner, and give you more reliable airflow. With these Cali Tips you’re not guessing how big to roll or dealing with loose spirals that collapse halfway through the cone.

For anyone who loves the ritual of rolling but wants fewer variables to fight with, upgrading the filter is one of those small tweaks that makes every roll feel more pro, especially if your papers and accessories are already dialed in with good rolling accessories.

    They’re optimized for VIBES 44mm standard and 53mm fatty papers, but you can use them with other papers in a similar width range. Just know the sizing and proportions will be most dialed when you stick with the intended VIBES formats.

    These are meant as single-use tips. Technically you could try to reuse one, but after a full roll it’ll be discolored, softer, and not as clean, so most people just use a fresh tip every time.
  • Will these change how my roll tastes?

  • How should I store extra tips?
    Keep them in the original pack or a small case, away from moisture. If you like a full travel kit, you can tuck them next to your grinder and lighter in your bag or pair them with your joint tubes so you’ve always got fresh filters ready when you’re rolling on the go.
  • Are these better than folding my own filters?

  • How many rolls can I get out of one pack?
    Each pack has 20 pre-rolled tips, so you’re set for 20 filtered rolls. If you’re the friend who always ends up rolling for everyone, grabbing a few packs at a time keeps you stocked for plenty of seshes.

The VIBES Ultra Thin Pre-Rolled Fatty Cones are oversized, pre-rolled cones built for smokers who like big joints without a ton of paper in the way. Designed for people who’d rather pack and spark than sit and roll, these cones use ultra-thin VIBES paper and a fat 18mm opening so you can load up fast and still get that smooth, clean-tasting burn VIBES is known for.

Each cone is finished with an 8mm tip that balances easy airflow with just enough resistance, so your fatty draws smooth instead of feeling like you’re pulling through a straw.

Why you’ll actually use these

  • Less rolling, more smoking — Pre-rolled design with a wide 18mm opening means you just grind, pack, and go instead of fighting with loose papers.
  • Big joints, less paper taste — Ultra-thin VIBES paper keeps the focus on your flower, not on that dry paper flavor halfway through the sesh.
  • Smooth, open draw — 8mm tip is wide enough to move serious airflow but still shaped to keep things comfortable to hold and hit.
  • Slow, even burn — Ultra-thin stock is engineered to burn consistently so your fatty doesn’t canoe on one side while the other barely lights.
  • Perfect for sharing — Fatty size makes these ideal for passing around at a kickback, festival, or any sesh where one little pinner just won’t do it.
  • Minimal mess — The stiff cone body helps keep ground herb from spilling everywhere while you’re packing.

Best for

These Ultra Thin Pre-Rolled Fatty Cones are made for smokers who already know they like a heavy pour—bigger joints, longer burns, and full-flavor flower. They shine when you’re rolling up for a group sesh, or if you’re the type who would rather pack one solid fatty than roll three separate joints. If you’re building out a full kit, they pair nicely with a clean surface like a dab mat so your grind stays where you want it.

They’re also a smart pick for anyone who’s decent at grinding but still hates the actual rolling part. Cones are forgiving, and VIBES ultra-thin paper keeps the experience tasting way closer to glass than old-school thick papers.

How to use them

Using these cones is straightforward: fill from the wide 18mm opening, lightly tap or tamp to settle your herb, then twist the tip of the paper at the top to lock everything in. Because they’re ultra-thin, go gentle when you’re packing—firm, not aggressive—so you keep airflow and don’t crush the cone.

For a smoother prep routine, stage your ground flower on something nonstick or easy to clean, or keep it in proper glass jars so it doesn’t overdry before you even get to pack a cone. Once you’re finished with your smoke, just let the cone cool off and toss the ash and crutch responsibly.

Cleanup is basically nothing—no scraping, no wiping down gear—just make sure you’re not ashing on anything that melts or stains, the same way you’d treat any joint or cone.

Opening Diameter 18mm (0.71 inches)
Filter / Tip Diameter 8mm (0.31 inches)

Fit & Compatibility

Because of the 18mm opening, these cones work best with a medium to large amount of ground flower—think “fat joint,” not a tiny personal. They’re easy to pack by hand, but also play well with most generic cone loaders and packing tools. If you’re the type to keep multiple pieces in rotation—bowls, rigs, and cones—these live nicely alongside more durable silicone pipes for when you don’t feel like rolling at all.

They’re regular-paper sized at the tip, so they feel familiar in the hand even though they’re built to hold a lot more herb than a standard skinny cone.

What you get

This listing is for VIBES Ultra Thin Pre-Rolled Fatty Cones from What You Need, priced as a bulk pack at $75.99. Exact cone count and pack breakdown follow the vendor configuration, but you’re getting a full box built for people who burn through cones regularly—perfect for stocking a home stash, a busy smoke circle, or a shared spot where everyone always “forgets” to bring papers.

FAQ

  • How big are these compared to regular cones?
    These are “fatty” style cones with an 18mm opening, so they’re noticeably wider than your standard slim or 1 1/4 cone. They’re made for bigger joints and longer burns, not quick personals.
  • Will these fit in my cone loader or packing tool?
    Most universal cone loaders can handle fatty cones, but it depends on your specific tool. If your loader can take wider cones or king-size formats, it’ll usually play fine with this 18mm size. Otherwise, packing by hand works just as well.
  • Are the Ultra Thin papers going to rip while I pack?
    They’re thinner than average for taste and burn quality, but still sturdy enough for normal packing as long as you don’t overjam or stab at them with something sharp. Fill gradually and use something smooth (like a small packing tool) and you’ll be good.
  • Do these come with filters already installed?
    Yes, each cone has an 8mm tip already in place, so you don’t need to roll or insert your own crutch. Just pack the cone, twist the top, and you’re ready.
  • What’s the difference between these and regular VIBES papers?
    Regular papers are flat sheets you still have to roll yourself, while these are pre-formed cones that save you the effort and keep the shape consistent every time. If you like the VIBES paper feel and flavor but hate rolling, these are the easy-mode version.
  • How should I store the cones so they don’t get crushed?
    Keep them in their original box or slip a few into a hard-sided tube or case when you’re on the go. If you’re building out a full travel kit, you can toss them alongside other smoking accessories so everything stays organized.
  • Are these good for mixing concentrates with flower?
    If you like to blend in a little hash or rosin with your flower, the extra capacity on these fatties gives you more room to work. Just keep any stickier material staged on nonstick surfaces like PTFE or non-stick paper until you’re ready to load so you don’t waste anything.

If you’re building out a full kit, these cones pair nicely with a durable travel setup, especially if you’re into smoke shop essentials that can take a beating and still work.

That big 18mm mouth makes it easy to scoop or funnel flower into the cone without tearing the paper or smashing the tip. Take your time on the pack so your joint stays even from top to bottom and you’re not dealing with runs halfway through the sesh.

Set your cone on a dab mat or rolling tray while you fill, so you can catch any extra material and pour it right back in. It’s a little thing, but it keeps the table clean and your stash where it belongs.

If you like prepping ahead, you can pre-pack a few cones, then stash them in smell-tight containers or alongside other pre-rolls and accessories in your main storage and packaging setup so they’re ready when friends pull up.

They’ll sit nicely in the mouthpiece end of a lot of silicone bongs and rigs that are designed to accept pre-rolls, but expect to use them mainly as classic hand-held joints.

If you’re traveling or tossing them into a bag, it’s a good call to keep them in a joint tube or case from our broader joint tube lineup so you’re not pulling out a bent or crushed cone when it’s finally time to spark up.

FAQ

  • How big are these compared to regular cones?
    They’re noticeably chunkier than a standard slim cone. The 18mm opening gives you a wide mouth to load and a bigger overall joint profile, so they’re better for party-sized rolls than solo micro-seshes.
  • Will these fit in my pre-roll holder or joint tube?
    Most holders built for king-size joints can handle these, but because they’re “Fatty” cones, you’ll want to use a roomy tube or one designed specifically for bigger rolls. If you need better storage options, check the different sizes in our glass jar packaging collections for at-home stashing.
  • Do the Blancos change the taste of my flower?
    They’re designed to be clean and neutral so you mainly taste your strain. The Blanco option gives you that classic white look with a smooth burn, and the Ultra-Thin style leans even lighter on paper flavor if you’re really chasing terps.
  • Are these good for beginners?

The VIBES Rice Papers Box – King Size Slim is a full-box upgrade for people who actually roll through packs, not just once a month. These are ultra-thin rice rolling papers built for smokers who want a clean, slow burn and to really taste their flower, not the paper. King Size Slim gives you enough length for sharable cones while still feeling sleek in the hand.

Why It Works

  • More flavor, less paper – Rice paper is thin and neutral, so you taste your flower instead of harsh paper smoke.
  • Long, even burns – The King Size Slim format and rice material are all about a slower, more consistent burn so you’re not constantly re-lighting.
  • Stock up once – Full box means you’re covered for a long stretch of seshes, ideal if you roll daily or share with friends.
  • Built for clean rolls – Slim width makes it easier to shape tight, even joints instead of fat, floppy ones.
  • Better use of your flower – With a slow-burning paper, more of your material actually gets enjoyed instead of turning to ash too fast.

Best For

This box is made for heavy rollers, people who always end up being “the one who rolls,” and anyone who prefers longer joints without going full novelty cannon. If you’ve already got your stash dialed in and a favorite smoke shop setup at home, this just plugs right into your routine and keeps you stocked.

The Basics: What You’re Getting

You’re not grabbing a single booklet here – you’re grabbing a full box of VIBES King Size Slim rice papers. That means consistent feel, consistent burn, and the same quality every time you reach for a fresh sheet. Rice papers are naturally slow-burning and light, which is why a lot of flavor-focused smokers gravitate toward them when they want a smoother, more delicate smoke.

King Size Slim is the sweet spot size: long enough to pack a real sesh, but not so wide that it feels awkward to roll or hold. If your usual complaint is that 1 1/4 papers burn out too quick or don’t hold enough, this format is usually the upgrade.

How to Use Them

Use these like any other rolling paper, just know they shine most when your material is evenly broken down and not too chunky. A consistent grind helps the rice paper burn slowly from tip to crutch, instead of canoeing or going out on you. Rolling them tight-but-not-packed-solid usually hits the sweet spot for airflow and even burn.

If you like to keep your area tidy and avoid crumbs all over the table, lay everything out on a dab mat or tray so your papers and flower stay exactly where you want them. That also helps keep moisture or dust off the papers when you’re rolling a few in a row.

Once rolled and burned down, just ash as usual and tap out the remaining end. If you’re rolling extras ahead of time, tuck them somewhere dry and out of direct light so the papers don’t soften or wrinkle.

Specifications

Category Rolling papers
Material Rice paper
Size King Size Slim
Format Full box of papers
Brand VIBES

Care & Storage Tips

Keep the box closed when you’re not pulling a paper so they stay flat and crisp. Store somewhere cool and dry – no bathrooms, no pockets that get sweaty – and away from direct sunlight so the papers don’t warp or weaken. If you’re traveling, toss a few packs into a smell-proof pouch with your storage and packaging gear instead of carrying the whole box.

FAQ

  • How big are King Size Slim papers compared to regular papers?

    King Size Slim papers are longer than standard 1 1/4 papers but slimmer in width, so you get a longer joint without a super wide roll. If you like sharing or want a slower burn, this size usually feels just right.

  • Will these work with my existing rolling machine?

    Most rolling machines that say they fit King Size or King Size Slim papers will play nice with these. Check your roller’s size rating – if it’s built for king-size, you’re good to go. If not, you can always hand-roll and use a small tool or tip to help pack and shape the joint.

  • Do rice papers really change the taste?

    Rice papers are usually lighter and more neutral than standard wood-pulp papers. That means less “paper taste” and more of your strain’s natural flavor coming through, which is why they’re popular with flavor chasers and people who like terpy flower.

  • Are these papers thick or ultra-thin?

    VIBES rice papers lean toward the thin side, which helps with slow burning and a cleaner taste. They still have enough structure that they’re not impossible to roll, even if you’re not a pro.

  • Do they run or canoe more than other papers?

    When rolled evenly and packed consistently, rice papers burn smooth and straight. Most canoeing comes from uneven grind, loose spots, or damp material. Pairing these with an even grind and a decent smoking setup helps everything burn the way it should.

  • Can I use these for pre-rolling a bunch at once?

    Yes, this box is perfect if you like to roll up several at a time for the week or for a party. Just stash the finished joints in a cool, dry place – a jar, a case, or joint tubes – so they don’t get crushed or dried out.

  • What’s the best way to keep the papers from getting bent or wrinkled?

    Leave them in their original packs inside the box until you’re ready to use them. If you’re on the move, slide a single booklet into the same pocket or pouch where you keep your stash jars and basics so it stays flat and protected.

The VIBES Blanco Booklets Fatty 33 – 50 Display Box is a bulk box of premium rolling papers made for heavy rollers, party hosts, and shops that go through stacks of papers fast. Each “Fatty” paper is a 53mm double-wide, giving you extra room to pack thick, even rolls without fighting the paper. Built from VIBES’ newest Blanco wood pulp blend, these burn smooth and consistent so your herb—not the paper—does the talking.

What You Get Out of It

  • Room for real fatties — 53mm double-wide papers give you the space to roll thick, slow-burning joints without splitting or overstuffing.
  • Burns smooth from tip to roach — The Blanco wood pulp blend is tuned for even combustion so you’re not fighting runs or canoeing halfway through the sesh.
  • Clean flavor, no weird aftertaste — Minimal paper taste lets your flower’s terps shine instead of getting covered up by harsh pulp or additives.
  • Stays sealed when it counts — Natural Arabic gum strip grabs and holds, so your roll doesn’t start unwrapping mid-pass.
  • Display-ready for shops — 33 booklets with 50 leaves each come in a tidy display box that’s ready to drop right on the counter.
  • Perfect for “pass it around” joints — Designed for crowd-pleasers when you’d rather roll one good fatty than babysit five skinny ones.

Best For

This display box is made for people who roll a lot: shops, sesh hosts, and those friends who somehow end up doing all the rolling. If your coffee table already stays stocked with grinders, lighters, and a few backup smoke shop essentials, this is the kind of bulk paper setup that actually makes sense.

They’re especially good if you like classic hand-rolled joints but want them thicker than standard singles—think party cones, donut joints, and “everyone gets a real hit” house rolls.

The Basics: How These Papers Work

VIBES Blanco Fatty papers are all about balancing size with control. The 53mm double-wide format gives you more surface area than a regular paper, but not so much that your roll turns into a blimp. Once you get used to the width, it’s easy to shape clean cylinders or those old-school baseball bat joints without wasting flower or paper.

The Blanco blend itself is a refined wood pulp paper. That means it feels familiar in the hand—like a classic paper—but it’s engineered to burn slower and more evenly than the cheap gas station stuff. The result is a joint that stays lit, doesn’t flare up randomly, and doesn’t drown your strain’s flavor in papery harshness.

Every leaf carries a strip of natural Arabic gum. That gum is what locks everything in once you finish your tuck, so you’re not chasing open seams when the joint warms up. Pair a fresh roll with a stable surface like a dab mat and it’s way easier to keep your papers flat and your flower where it belongs while you’re working.

How to Use Them (Rolling Tips, Not a How-To Smoke Guide)

These are still just papers, so if you’ve rolled before, you’re already 90% of the way there—the difference is learning how to use the extra width to your advantage. Fatty-sized papers shine when you want an even pack across a longer, thicker roll rather than trying to stuff a standard paper until it gives up.

A few real-world tips:

  • Use a crutch or filter tip to give the wider paper a solid base to roll around.
  • Distribute your herb in a consistent line and let the extra width help you shape a rounder joint instead of a flat one.
  • Take your time on the tuck—there’s more paper to manage, but that also means more forgiveness if your technique isn’t perfect yet.

If you’re pre-rolling to stash for later, drop your finished joints into smell-tight storage—heavy-bottom glass or dedicated storage and packaging options keep them protected and ready to grab.

These are standard, flat rolling papers—no tips, no cones, no gimmicks. They work with whatever rolling style you already have: hand rolls, rollers, or using a tray and straight edge to shape your joints. Because they’re double-wide, they’re better for fatter joints than tight little pinners.

If you’re stocking a shop, the 33-count display box is ready to sit on your counter next to lighters, grinders, and other accessories so customers can grab a pack without thinking about it.

Care & Storage

Keep the booklets dry and out of direct sunlight so the gum doesn’t dry out prematurely. Close the display box or tuck it on a shelf when not in use to keep dust and pocket lint off the papers. For personal stashes, a small jar or bag can help your open booklet survive backpacks and glove compartments.

FAQs

  • What does “Fatty 53mm double-wide” actually mean?
    It means each paper is wider than a standard single, giving you more space to pack and shape thicker joints. The 53mm width helps you roll “fatty” style joints without having to stack or overlap multiple papers.
  • Is the Blanco blend really different from other VIBES papers?
    Yes. Blanco is a specific wood pulp blend tuned for a smoother, more neutral burn. Compared to some other blends, you’ll notice less paper taste and a more even, consistent burn line that lets your strain’s flavor come through.
  • Are these good for everyday solo use, or more for parties?
    You can absolutely use them solo if you like bigger joints, but most people grab the Fatty size when they’re rolling for groups or want something that can make a few laps around the room. If you usually smoke smaller amounts, a thinner or shorter paper may feel more practical.
  • Will these work in my rolling machine?
    If your rolling machine is designed for wider papers or “1¼ and up” styles, they usually play nice. If it’s a very small or narrow machine, these may be too wide. Worst case, you can always go back to hand rolling and use a tray like an unbreakable silicone rig mat to keep everything contained while you practice.
  • Do they run or canoe easily?
    The Blanco blend is built to resist uneven burning when your pack and roll are dialed in. Most running or canoeing comes from uneven herb distribution or rolling too loose/tight in spots—once those are sorted, these papers hold up really well.
  • Can I use these to roll blunts or only joints?
    These are traditional rolling papers, not tobacco wraps, so they’re meant for joint-style rolls. If you like the feel of blunts but want less wrap taste, rolling a chunky joint in these and pairing it with good glass storage for your flower is a solid middle ground.
  • How should I store the display box in a shop or at home?
    Keep the display somewhere dry and out of direct sun so the gum stays fresh and the papers don’t warp. For shops, a counter or shelf near other paper goods makes it easy for customers to find. At home, just avoid damp spots and you’re good.
