If you want consistent rolls without fighting with papers, tips, and crutches every time, this box has you covered for a long while.

Why You’ll Actually Use These

  • Stretch your sesh — Rice paper burns slower than hemp, so your king-size cones hang around instead of disappearing in five minutes.
  • Let the terps shine — Thin, clean-burning rice paper keeps the flavor focused on your flower, not the paper.
  • Zero rolling skills required — Pre-rolled with tips, so you just grind, pack, and go.
  • Party-ready quantity — 30 coffins with 3 cones each (90 total) means you’ve got more than enough for pregame, afters, and everything in between.
  • Consistent every time — Same size, same pack, same burn, so you’re not playing “which one runs today?”
  • Less paper, more flower — King size capacity fits roughly 1 gram without stuffing in a dense log.

Best For

These VIBES king size rice cones are made for people who like to post up for a proper smoke, not just sneak a couple quick hits. If your ideal sesh is passing one around the circle, talking for 20 minutes, and it’s still burning smooth, this is your lane. They’re also clutch for anyone who hates hand-rolling but still wants that classic cone experience instead of switching to pipes or rigs from the usual smoke shop products lineup.

How to Use Them

Think of these as “rolling papers on easy mode.” Each cone is already shaped, tipped, and ready to be filled. All you really handle is the grind and the pack. Because they’re rice paper, they’re a bit thinner than a lot of standard papers, which is part of why the burn is so clean and slow.

For best results, use a consistent grind so your flower packs evenly and the cone burns without canoes. A good grinder makes a huge difference here, and it’s worth keeping your loading area tidy with something simple like a dab pad or tray so material doesn’t end up everywhere.

Once packed to the level you like (around a gram is their sweet spot), you’re ready to go. If you’re prepping for a group, you can knock out several cones in a row and stash them safely until it’s time to spark up.

Rice papers like a cool, dry, stable environment. Keep the coffins inside the main box when you’re not using them, and avoid leaving them out somewhere humid or in direct sun. FAQ

  • How much can each VIBES King Size rice cone hold?
    Each king size cone is designed to hold roughly 1 gram of ground flower comfortably. You can pack a little less if you want shorter seshes, but 1 gram is where they really feel balanced in terms of airflow and burn.
  • Do these burn slower than regular hemp cones?
    Yes. Rice paper is thinner and tends to burn slower and cleaner than a lot of hemp papers, which is why people reach for these when they want to stretch a smoke and really taste their flower. If you’re used to standard cones, you’ll notice the difference in how long these hang around.
  • Are the cones already tipped, or do I need to add filters?
    They come pre-rolled with tips built in, so you don’t need separate filter papers or crutches. Just load them up. If you’re packing several at once, a small funnel or packing tool from your usual accessories setup can make the job even faster.
  • How should I store the extra cones so they don’t get crushed?
    Keep them in their original coffins inside the box, and store the box somewhere dry, away from heavy stuff that could flatten it. If you like to carry a few with you, move one coffin (with its 3 cones) into a bag or case so you’re not hauling the whole box. For rolled and filled cones, a small jar or tube works great; plenty of people repurpose empty glass jars for this.
  • Is rice paper more fragile than other papers?
    Rice papers are usually thinner, so you’ll want to treat them with a bit more care than thick, chalky papers. Handle from the tip end when loading, don’t over-cram the top, and they’ll hold up fine. The pre-rolled shape helps a lot — the tricky folding work is already done.
  • Will these work if my flower is a little sticky?
    Yes, as long as your grind is even. Very sticky flower can clump, which affects how evenly the cone burns, so a solid grind is key. If you’re dealing with especially resinous material, keep your grinder and tools clean between packs, similar to how you’d maintain gear when working with rosin or hash on parchment paper.
  • How do I keep the burn even and avoid canoeing?
    Most of that comes down to packing. Aim for a firm but not rock-hard fill from tip to top so airflow stays consistent. Avoid big chunks or stems that can poke the paper. When you’re packing a bunch in a row for a session, using a clean loading area like you would when setting up nectar collectors and other gear helps you see and remove any odd pieces before they go into the cone.

The SMALL MAGNETIC ROLLING TRAY is a compact metal rolling tray with a snap-on magnetic lid, built for people who hate crumbs on the couch and herbs in the carpet. It’s sized right for solo rolls and travel, but still gives you a real workspace at 7 inches x 5 inches (178mm x 127mm). Toss your papers, tips, and herb inside, click the lid shut, and everything stays put until the next sesh.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Way less mess — Raised edges and a smooth metal surface keep everything on the tray instead of in your lap.
  • Lock it and go — Magnetic lid snaps into place so your papers, tips, and herb don’t go flying in your bag.
  • Pocket-sized but real — 7 x 5 inches (178 x 127mm) is small enough to travel but big enough to roll comfortably.
  • Protects your herb — Closed tray shields from pocket lint, crumbs, and random bag gunk between rolls.
  • Matches your vibe — Full-color prints mean you can pick something loud, low-key, or just straight-up funny.
  • Multi-use surface — Also works as a tiny parts tray for tips, tools, and lighter when you’re posted up at home.

Best For

This tray is made for people who are always rolling in random spots — cars, parks, smoke spots, borrowed couches — and are tired of losing herb into the void. It’s also clutch if you like to keep a dedicated, contained kit in a backpack or drawer instead of having papers and grinders floating loose with your other smoke shop gear.

If you’re the “everything has its place” type, this gives you a defined mini work zone so your sesh stays organized, even when your brain doesn’t.

How to Use It

Pop the magnetic lid off to reveal your rolling surface. Use the tray like your usual flat spot: grind onto the metal, shape and fill your paper, and tap any strays back toward the center using the curved edges as a funnel. The smooth finish makes it easy to collect every last bit instead of watching it disappear into the couch cushions.

When you’re done, stash your papers, tips, and anything small and flat you like to keep with your kit, then drop the magnetic lid back into place. It’ll hold tight enough to ride in a bag or pocket, especially if you keep it flat on top of a dab pad or other soft surface at home so you’re not banging it around.

For cleaning, just tap out any loose crumbs, then wipe it down with a damp cloth or a little isopropyl on a towel if it’s picked up resin from your fingers. Dry it off and it’s ready to go again.

Specifications

Feature Details
Dimensions 7 inches x 5 inches (178mm x 127mm)
Material Metal tray with full-color printed design
Form Factor Small, portable rolling tray
Lid Type Magnetic, removable
Design Options Multiple graphic prints

Fit & Everyday Use

This SMALL MAGNETIC ROLLING TRAY is sized to slide into most backpacks, side bags, and even bigger jacket pockets, so it’s easy to keep with your daily driver gear. It plays nice with compact grinders, short packs of papers, and crutches, turning into a self-contained kit instead of a handful of loose items. At home, it tucks neatly into a drawer or can live next to your favorite silicone bongs & rigs as your go-to rolling station.

If you like to keep different strains or rolls organized, you can pair it with labeled glass jars & packaging so each tray session has everything you need within reach.

What You Get

  • 1 x Small Metal Rolling Tray (7 x 5 inches / 178 x 127mm)
  • 1 x Matching Magnetic Lid (full-color print)

FAQ

  • How big is this tray really — is it too small to roll on?
    It’s 7 inches x 5 inches (178mm x 127mm), which is perfect for single joints, blunts, or small prep sessions. You get enough room for a grinder, a paper, and a small pile of herb, but it’s not a huge coffee-table tray. If you want something strictly for home use, you might pair this with a larger surface and keep the small tray for travel or as your “kit” with papers and tips.
  • Will the magnetic lid stay on in a backpack?
    Yes, the magnets are strong enough for normal daily carry in a bag or pocket, as long as you’re not trying to use it as a hard-shell case for heavy items. Think of it as a secure cover that keeps papers, tips, and small items from spilling, not a fully crush-proof box. For extra peace of mind, you can store pre-rolls in separate joint tubes and keep those inside your bag alongside the tray.
  • Can I use this for concentrates too?
    You can definitely use it as a clean surface for tools, caps, and jars while you dab, but it’s not nonstick, so don’t put bare concentrates directly on the metal. If you’re handling sticky stuff, use parchment or a liner, or switch to dedicated concentrate jars and nonstick surfaces so you don’t waste anything.
  • Will the design scratch or fade?
    The full-color print is made to handle normal use: scooping herb, sliding a grinder, and general rolling. Like any printed metal, if you scrape it with sharp tools or keys, it can scratch over time. Treat it like you would a favorite tin — it’ll pick up character, but it’s not going to wipe off from regular rolling.
  • How do I clean it without ruining the magnets or design?
    Tap out any loose crumbs, then wipe with a damp cloth or mild cleaner. For stickier spots, a little isopropyl alcohol on a cloth works fine; just dry it well before snapping the lid back on. No soaking, no dishwasher — that’s overkill and can be rough on both magnets and print.
  • Will this fit my grinder, papers, and lighter all together?
    Most slim 1 1/4 or king-size paper packs, tips, and a small to medium grinder will fit comfortably on or inside the tray. If you’re running a huge grinder or a full kit with multiple extras, this works best as your main flat surface, while the rest can live in a bigger bag or with your other storage & packaging solutions.
  • Is this better for travel or to leave at home?
    Honestly, both. It’s designed to be travel-friendly, but a lot of people end up making it their everyday home station too because it keeps everything contained and easy to put away. You can keep it next to your other rolling accessories, snap the lid on when you’re done, and your coffee table instantly looks clean again.

The 2" Clear Spinner Carb Cap is a glass carb cap built for dabbers who want smoother, more efficient dabs from their flat-top bangers. It’s ideal if you’re already into pearls or pills and want real spin, not just a glorified plug. At about 2 inches (51mm) across with a top-hat profile, it gives you easy grip and responsive airflow so you can keep temps low and flavor high.

Why It Works

  • Better use of your concentrates — Spinner-style airflow channels push air around the dish so your oil doesn’t just sit and burn in one hot spot.
  • Real terp pearl spin — When paired with pearls, the directional airflow helps them whirl, spreading heat and oil more evenly across the banger floor.
  • Low-temp friendly — By capping the banger and controlling airflow, you can ride those lower temps longer instead of feeling rushed.
  • Easy to handle when you’re cooked — The top-hat shape gives you a solid grip so you’re not fumbling around a hot banger during a heavy sesh.
  • See everything that’s happening — Clear glass lets you monitor melt, puddles, and pearl action instead of guessing.
  • Simple, no-gimmick design — One solid piece of glass that just works with most flat-top bangers in a daily driver setup.

Best For

This cap is made for dabbers who are running flat-top bangers as their main daily driver and want more control over airflow without overcomplicating their setup. It’s especially nice if you’re already using a small rig or compact setup and want tighter, more flavorful pulls without upgrading your whole piece — just add this and a clean banger and you’re in business. If you’re building out a full dab station, pair it with a solid dab mat so sticky tools and caps stay where they’re supposed to.

How to Use It

Once your banger is hot and you’ve dropped in your concentrate, set the 2" Clear Spinner Carb Cap over the top of your flat-top banger. As you draw, the angled airflow in the cap pulls air in a way that makes your puddle move and, if you’re using pearls, gets them spinning.

You don’t have to overthink it — just keep the cap centered and let the airflow do the work. If your pearls aren’t moving, a slightly stronger pull or a small adjustment in how you’re holding the cap usually gets them going. A good dab tool helps you load neatly so the puddle sits right where the airflow can hit it best.

After your sesh, let the cap cool on a safe surface (not on the hot banger) so you’re not dealing with super-heated glass. A quick wipe while it’s still slightly warm will help keep reclaim from building up.

Specifications

Product Type Spinner carb cap
Material Glass
Diameter 2 inches (51mm)
Color Clear
Design Top-hat style with spinner airflow

Fit & Compatibility

This 2" Clear Spinner Carb Cap is designed for flat-top bangers — that wide, even top gives the cap room to sit comfortably and seal well. Most medium-sized flat-top quartz bangers will work, as long as the diameter isn’t way smaller than the cap. If your setup leans more compact or you run micro bangers, just double-check that the 2-inch (51mm) size won’t completely dwarf the top of your banger.

It plays especially nice with directional-friendly bangers and setups where you’re already running pearls or small inserts. If you’re still putting your kit together, you can round things out with some simple dab accessories like stands or holders to keep hot caps off your table.

Care & Cleaning

Let the carb cap cool fully before cleaning. Once it’s safe to touch, wipe off any loose residue. For a deeper clean, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and dry completely before your next sesh. Regular quick wipes will keep it from getting cloudy with reclaim buildup.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my banger?
    It’s made for flat-top bangers and works best with standard medium sizes. If your banger has a flat rim and isn’t tiny, you’re likely good. Just make sure the 2" (51mm) cap won’t completely cover way past the edges of a very small banger.
  • Does it actually spin terp pearls?
    Yes — that’s the whole point of the spinner-style airflow. With a proper flat-top banger, normal draw, and pearls that aren’t oversized, you’ll see them start to spin around the dish instead of just sitting there.
  • Can I use this on angled (45°) rigs?
    You can, as long as the banger itself is a flat-top style. The angle of the joint doesn’t really matter; what matters is that the top of the banger is flat and the cap can sit on it without sliding off. If you prefer more compact setups, a small rig from our silicone bongs & rigs section can be a good, durable match.
  • Is the glass thick enough for daily use?
    It’s built as a daily-driver style carb cap — solid enough for regular seshes if you treat it like glass. It’ll handle normal heat from a banger, but like any glass piece, drops to a hard floor are another story.
  • How do I clean off heavy reclaim buildup?
    If it’s really crusted, let it soak in isopropyl alcohol until the reclaim loosens, then rinse and dry. Doing a quick wipe after each sesh keeps it from ever getting to that "why is this so sticky?" stage. Stash it on a clean surface or even next to your storage and packaging setup so it’s not picking up extra dust and grime.
  • Is this better than a basic bubble cap?
    They do different jobs. A basic bubble cap is great for simple directional control, but a spinner cap like this is purpose-built to move air in a way that spins pearls and keeps your puddle moving. If you’re into low-temp dabs and want to squeeze more performance out of your banger, upgrading to a spinner is a noticeable step up.
  • Can I travel with this or toss it in my kit?
    You can, just remember it’s glass. Keeping it in a padded pouch or alongside your other protected gear — like jars or containers from our concentrate jars lineup — goes a long way toward not opening your bag to find a pile of broken glass.

Dial In Your Dab Setup

The 2" Clear Spinner Carb Cap is a small upgrade that makes a big difference if you’re chasing flavor and efficiency from your concentrates. Pair it with a clean flat-top banger, some pearls if you like the spin, and a solid rig from our broader smoke shop products collection, and you’ve got a reliable daily setup that just works when you’re a few dabs deep and don’t want to think about it.

The 2" Clear Heavywall Ball Carb Cap is a glass carb cap built for dabbers who actually care about airflow and flavor, not just clouds. Its thick, heavywall construction feels solid in the hand and shrugs off regular heat cycles, while the rounded ball design lets you steer airflow across your puddle so you’re not leaving oil stuck on the edges of your banger.

If you’re the type who likes to finish a dab clean with smooth, controlled pulls instead of hot, wasteful blasts, this cap earns its spot as a daily driver. The 2-inch (about 51mm) size gives you enough grip to spin and angle it comfortably without getting your fingers cooked over the bucket.

Key Benefits

  • Get more from every dab — The ball shape lets you direct airflow across your oil for more complete vaporization and less waste stuck on the sides.
  • Solid, heavy feel in the hand — Thick heavywall glass means it doesn’t feel flimsy, and holds up well to normal heat cycles and everyday seshes.
  • Smoother, tastier pulls — Restricting and redirecting airflow helps keep temps in a sweeter spot, so terps pop instead of getting roasted.
  • Easy to spin and control — Rounded body makes it simple to tilt, spin, or park it on top of the banger without awkward fumbling when you’re mid-dab.
  • Simple, clear glass look — Clean, transparent design matches pretty much any rig setup and lets you see exactly what your puddle is doing.
  • Plays nice with common setups — Designed for use with most standard quartz bangers, so you can drop it into your current lineup without redoing your whole rig.

Best For

This ball carb cap is made for dabbers who already have a consistent setup and want to tighten up their airflow game without overcomplicating things. If you’re running a simple rig with a bucket banger and want more control over how your puddle moves, this is a nice upgrade from the random cap that came with your first kit. It also pairs well with unbreakable daily drivers like our silicone bongs & rigs if you like a low-stress, toss-it-in-the-bag type setup.

How to Use It

Once your banger is at the temp you like and you’ve dropped in your concentrate, set the ball carb cap on top of the bucket. From there, you can lightly spin or tilt it to change where the air hits your puddle and how fast it moves. Small angle changes can make a big difference in how evenly the oil spreads out and vaporizes.

If you like to keep your sesh station clean, park your cap on a dab mat when it’s not in use so you’re not gluing it to the table with stray reclaim. The smooth glass surface also makes it easy to wipe between dabs if you get a little splash back.

For people who bounce between different rigs or bangers, this style carb cap is a good "one and done" option that works with a lot of setups. Just make sure your banger has a flat or slightly beveled top so the cap can sit and seal properly.

Specifications

Spec Details
Type Ball-style carb cap
Material Clear heavywall glass
Diameter (overall height) 2 inches (approx. 51mm)
Color Clear

Fit & Compatibility

This 2" Clear Heavywall Ball Carb Cap is built to play nicely with most common quartz bucket bangers. As long as your banger top is flat or beveled and not oversized, you’ll get a solid seal and easy control over airflow. It’s especially at home on standard-sized buckets that you’d typically pair with your go-to dab tools and pearls.

Because it’s clear glass and not an oddly shaped novelty piece, it looks right at home on almost any rig — from small recyclers to chunky daily drivers. Just treat it like any other glass accessory: avoid hard drops and don’t force it against your banger if things are stuck or too hot.

Care & Cleaning

Let the carb cap cool down fully before you even think about cleaning it. Once it’s at room temp, you can wipe off light residue with a swab. For a deeper reset, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and dry completely before your next sesh. If you keep your other glass and glass jars & packaging clean, adding this to the routine is painless.

Why Heavywall Glass Matters

Heavywall glass isn’t just a marketing term here — the extra thickness gives this carb cap more thermal stability and better durability than skinny, cheap caps. That means it’s less likely to feel sketchy when you’re moving it around over a hot banger, and you’re not babying it every time you set it down.

That added mass also helps maintain a more consistent environment over the top of your banger. Instead of air rushing in from all sides and spiking temps up and down, you get a more controlled mix, which is exactly what you want if you’re trying to really taste your concentrates instead of just blasting through them. It’s a small upgrade that you’ll notice after a couple seshes, especially if you’ve been using thin glass caps before.

Pair It With

This ball carb cap plugs right into most dab setups, but it really shines when you build a simple, efficient station around it. Match it with proper storage like heavy-bottom concentrate jars so your extracts stay clean and easy to scoop, and keep your work area dialed so you’re not chasing sticky glass around your coffee table.

If you’re upgrading your whole kit, it also plays well with other smoke shop products from Oil Slick — think tools, rigs, and accessories that are built to survive regular use without turning into a headache after a month.

FAQ

  • Will this carb cap fit my banger?
    It’s designed to work with most standard quartz bucket bangers that have a flat or slightly beveled top. As long as your banger isn’t oversized and the opening isn’t tiny, you should get a solid seal and good airflow control. If you’re grabbing new glass anyway, it’s easy to pair this with rigs from our silicone pipes collection for a durable travel setup.
  • How big is the carb cap exactly?
    The cap measures about 2 inches (51mm) overall. That size gives you enough room to grip and spin it comfortably without hanging your fingers over the hot zone above the banger.
  • Is the glass really that thick?
    Yes, this is a true heavywall glass piece. It’s noticeably thicker than budget caps, which helps with durability and heat handling. That said, it’s still glass — avoid drops onto hard surfaces so you’re not explaining a shattered cap to your roommate.
  • How do I clean off reclaim and residue?
    Let the cap cool completely so you’re not shocking hot glass. Wipe off light buildup with a cotton swab, and for heavy grime, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse with warm water and dry. Keeping your concentrates in clean, sealed storage & packaging also helps cut down on sticky messes.
  • Does this work with terp pearls or other inserts?
    Yes. The directional-style control you get from a ball cap plays nicely with pearls and similar inserts, since you can adjust airflow to help them spin and move your puddle around the bottom of the banger.
  • Is this better than a flat-style carb cap?
    Different style, different feel. Flat caps mostly just restrict air; this ball cap lets you actually steer and direct airflow. If you like to fine-tune your hits and get more from each dab, the ball shape is usually an upgrade over basic flat caps.
  • Can I use this with every rig I own?
    As long as the rig has a compatible banger on it, you’re good. If you run multiple setups, you might find this becomes your "one cap to rule them all" since it works across a wide range of gear and plays well with most carb caps-style setups you already know.

The 2″ Spiral Binky Carb Cap is a glass carb cap built for dabbers who want real airflow control and a little personality on the rig. It’s made for people who are tired of wasting concentrates to thin, wispy vapor and want more flavor from every pull. At just 2 inches (51mm), it’s compact, easy to handle, and shaped to sit comfortably on most standard quartz bangers.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Cap

  • Better vapor from the same amount of concentrate — The spiral binky shape focuses airflow so your puddle actually vaporizes instead of just burning off.
  • Less waste, more flavor — By helping retain heat in the banger, this cap lets your dab keep cooking smoothly, so you’re not leaving a bunch of oil stuck to the walls.
  • Comfortable, easy grip — The pacifier-style “binky” pull gives you something solid to hold and twist, even when your fingers are a little slick.
  • Add some color to the table — The vibrant spiral design stands out in a lineup of plain clear glass and makes it easy to spot mid-sesh.
  • Plays nice with most rigs — Sized and shaped to work with most standard quartz bangers, so you don’t have to rebuild your whole setup around one accessory.
  • Built to be a daily driver — Durable glass construction holds up to regular heating and cooling when treated with basic care.

Best For

This cap is made for dabbers who actually care about how their rig functions, not just how it looks. If you’re running a small to medium-sized rig or recycler as your daily driver and want tighter airflow and better flavor without messing with complicated spinner setups, this fits the bill. It’s also a fun upgrade if you already have a basic cap and want something with more character to match your favorite silicone bongs & rigs.

How to Use It

Once your banger is hot and you’ve dropped in your concentrate, just set the Spiral Binky Carb Cap over the top to restrict and direct airflow. From there, you can gently twist or tilt the cap to move the puddle around and help it vaporize evenly, instead of pooling in one spot.

Because of the compact 2″ (51mm) size, it’s easy to maneuver with one hand while you stabilize your rig with the other. Setting your rig down on a solid dab mat helps keep your station clean while you cap and spin.

When the sesh is over, let the cap fully cool before touching any residue. A quick wipe after use helps keep the colors looking crisp and the airflow nice and open.

Specifications

Product Type Carb cap
Material Glass
Length 2 inches (51mm)
Design Spiral binky (pacifier-style pull)
Colors Multiple color options available

Fit & Compatibility

The 2″ Spiral Binky Carb Cap is designed for most standard quartz bangers with a typical bucket opening. If you’re running a very oversized bucket, a super tiny micro banger, or a specialty shape (like some terp slurpers and blender-style nails), this style may not seal as tightly as a purpose-built cap.

For classic flat-top buckets and standard daily-driver rigs, it’s a plug-and-play upgrade with no learning curve. Pair it with clean, well-made bangers and stash your concentrates in solid concentrate jars so you’re actually giving this cap something tasty to work with.

Let the carb cap cool completely before cleaning or handling any sticky spots. Wipe off light residue with a cotton swab or cloth. For deeper cleans, soak the cap in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and dry fully before you put it back into rotation.

Pair it with a solid flat-top banger and your favorite dab tools, and you’ll notice smoother, more efficient dabs without changing the rest of your setup.

Between hits, you can park the cap on a stand, lay it on a heat-safe surface, or keep it next to your rig on a nonstick pad. If you’re already using heavy-bottom concentrate jars for your extracts, this cap fits right into that “buy it once, use it forever” mindset—simple, durable glass that just works.

Specifications

Category Carb Cap
Material Borosilicate glass
Height 2 inches (50.8mm)
Design Two-tone spade cap with internal bubble trap
Color Multiple two-tone color options (varies by piece)

Fit & Compatibility

This carb cap is designed as a general fit option for standard flat-top bangers—especially medium-size ones that most dabbers use for daily rigs. Because it’s glass and not a tight cork-style plug, it sits on top and lets you manually control the seal and angle rather than locking into one fixed position.

If you’re running a full silicone setup, this cap still plays nicely with glass bangers that drop into silicone bongs and rigs, giving you the heat resistance of glass where it matters and the durability of silicone everywhere else.

Cleaning & Care

Let the carb cap cool completely before touching it for cleanup. Once it’s safe to handle, wipe off any visible residue with a cloth or cotton swab. For a deeper clean, soak the cap in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry fully before the next sesh.

FAQ

  • Will this carb cap fit my banger?
    It’s made to work with most standard flat-top bangers in that medium “everyday” size range. Because it sits on top instead of plugging in, you get a little flexibility—if your banger isn’t tiny or oversized, this cap should do the job.
  • Is this directional or just a regular cap?
    This is more of a standard bubble-style cap with a bubble trap design in the glass. You get control by tilting, rocking, and lifting the cap to change airflow, rather than having built-in spinning channels like a dedicated directional or spinner cap.
  • What’s the point of the bubble trap design?
    Bubble trap refers to the glasswork style—little “trapped” air bubbles inside the colored glass. Functionally, you get a bit more texture and grip plus a thicker feel in the hand, and visually it just looks way better than plain clear glass.
  • Is the borosilicate glass durable enough for daily dabs?
    Yes. Borosilicate is the same kind of glass used for quality rigs and lab glass. Treat it like any other glass accessory—don’t drop it on tile—and it’ll handle regular heat and cooldown cycles just fine. If you want to keep the rest of your setup tough too, pairing it with unbreakable silicone pieces is a smart move.
  • How do I keep it from getting sticky and crusty?
    Try not to drag the cap directly through puddles of concentrate, and give it a quick wipe after your sesh while any residue is still soft. When it does build up, a short soak in isopropyl alcohol brings it back to clean glass.
  • Does the two-tone color affect performance at all?
    No—color is purely aesthetic. The two-tone and bubble trap work are all done in borosilicate, so it performs just like clear glass, it just looks way better on the table.
  • What else do I need to use with this carb cap?
    You’ll want a rig, a flat-top banger, and a good dab tool at minimum. If you’re dialing in a full dabbing station, adding things like PTFE or parchment for handling concentrates and stash-ready storage and packaging makes the whole setup smoother and way less messy.

The 1.5″ Wigwag Top Hat Spinner Cap is a borosilicate glass carb cap built for dabbers who want real spin and real style, not just another clear cap. That wide 1.5 inch (38mm) top hat profile gives you solid coverage on most flat-top bangers, while the spinner channels keep pearls moving and vapor thick. If you like dialing in airflow and watching your terps tornado instead of puddle, this is the move.

Why It Works

  • Better terp action — Spinner-style airflow keeps your pearls whipping around the dish instead of sitting in a hot spot.
  • Smoother, denser pulls — The top hat shape helps seal the banger so more vapor goes to your lungs, not into the room.
  • Easy to handle when you’re baked — That tall, flared top gives you something solid to grab and twist without fumbling.
  • Actually looks sick on the rig — Multi-color wigwag pattern means this doesn’t disappear into your glass pile; it becomes part of the setup.
  • Simple to keep clean — One-piece glass construction with no weird corners, so residue wipes off fast.
  • Plays nice with daily drivers — Designed for most standard flat-top bangers, so you don’t have to rebuild your whole kit.

Best For

This top hat spinner cap is made for dabbers who run beads/pearls and actually care about how their rig functions and looks. If you’re already running a compact rig or even one of our tougher silicone bongs & rigs as your daily driver, this adds the airflow control and color pop that cheap caps just don’t have.

How to Use It

Set up your rig like you normally would, then drop in your pearls if you use them. Once your banger is up to temp and ready, place the Wigwag Top Hat Spinner Cap over the top of your flat-top banger. The wide 1.5 inch (38mm) diameter helps it sit comfortably and gives you full coverage for efficient vaporization.

As you pull, gently rotate or tilt the cap with your fingers to change how the air moves through the spinner channels. That’s what gets your pearls spinning and keeps the concentrate moving across the hot surface instead of burning in one spot. If you’re working over a sticky surface, set your rig on a solid dab pad or mat so the cap has a clean place to land between hits.

When you’re done and everything has cooled down, wipe off any leftover residue from the bottom of the cap. If it’s been through a few heavy seshes, a quick soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and dry will bring the glass right back.

Specifications

Product Type Glass carb cap (spinner style)
Material Borosilicate glass
Design Multi-color wigwag top hat with clear spinner section
Diameter 1.5 inches (38mm)
Compatibility Most standard flat-top bangers

Fit & Compatibility

This cap is built with a broad 1.5 inch (38mm) top hat, which works best on standard flat-top quartz bangers in the common medium size range. It’s not a tiny MTL cap and it’s not meant for micro/nano bangers or odd-shaped thermal buckets. If your banger has a clean, flat rim and isn’t oversized, this will likely give you a solid, controllable seal.

If you like to swap caps between rigs, this makes a great “house cap” that can bounce from one setup to another without a fight. For dialed-in storage between seshes, you can park it alongside your jars and other gear in a dedicated spot with your storage & packaging supplies so it doesn’t roll off the table.

What You Get

  • 1 × 1.5″ Wigwag Top Hat Spinner Carb Cap (borosilicate glass)
  • Unique wigwag color pattern (each piece is slightly different)

FAQ

  • Will this fit my banger?
    It’s designed to work with most standard flat-top quartz bangers. As long as your banger has a flat rim and isn’t an oversized bucket or micro head, this 1.5 inch (38mm) top hat should sit and spin nicely.
  • Does it work with pearls/terp beads?
    Yes — that’s where the spinner design really shines. The airflow channels are made to keep pearls moving, so if you already stash a few sizes in your dab tools kit, this cap will help you get more out of them.
  • Can I choose the wigwag colors?
    Colors and exact wigwag patterns vary from piece to piece. Each cap is a little different, so you’re getting a one-of-a-kind combo rather than a factory-cloned look.
  • How do I clean the spinner cap?
    Let it cool all the way down, then wipe off any residue from the underside. For a deeper clean, soak it briefly in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and dry completely before your next sesh.
  • Is this real borosilicate glass?
    Yes. It’s made from borosilicate glass, which is the standard for quality glass dab accessories because it handles heat changes better than soft glass. Still, treat it like glass — don’t drop it on tile or crank it with metal tools.
  • Will it work on a mini rig?
    As long as your mini rig has a normal-size flat-top banger, you’re good. The cap doesn’t care how big the rig is, just what the banger rim looks like. For super compact setups or travel pieces like some nectar collectors, you’ll want something made specifically for those instead.
  • What’s the difference between this and a regular bubble cap?
    Bubble caps are great for tilting and basic airflow control, but they don’t always keep pearls spinning as aggressively. This spinner-style top hat cap is built to actively move air in a way that pushes your pearls around the dish, which helps spread concentrate across more surface area and can give you smoother, fuller pulls.
  • What else do I need to use this?
    You’ll want a flat-top banger, a rig, and optionally some pearls to really take advantage of the spinner function. If you’re still building out your station, grabbing a stable accessory setup like stands or organizers can help keep everything together and off the floor when you’re a few dabs in.

The 8” Facet Decal Rig is a compact glass dab rig built for concentrate lovers who want real function with some personality on the shelf. At 8 inches (203mm), it’s small enough to be a daily driver but big enough to stay stable and hit comfortably. The faceted marble detail and colorful decal make it a piece you actually want to leave out, and the 14mm 90-degree banger means you’re ready to sesh right out of the box.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Rig

  • Daily-driver size — 8 inches (203mm) tall keeps the rig compact without sacrificing comfort or function.
  • Cleaner, smoother pulls — the upright 90° joint and simple internal pathway help stack bubbles and preserve flavor.
  • Stays put on the table — a footed base adds real-world stability when you’re passing it around or three dabs deep.
  • Looks as good as it rips — faceted marble accent and bold decal give you more than just another clear tube.
  • Plug-and-play setup — includes a 14mm 90° banger so you can go from box to dab without hunting for extra parts.
  • Easy to stash, easy to clean — shorter profile slips into cabinets and bags, and the straightforward design is simple to rinse and soak.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want a small, reliable piece that doesn’t look generic. If you’re running a few flavorful dabs a day and want something that’s easy to grab, easy to clean, and nicer than the basic shop special, the 8” Facet Decal Rig fits that lane perfectly. It’s also a solid choice if you’re upgrading from a nectar straw into a "real" rig but don’t want something huge or fragile.

If you’re building out a compact station around this rig, throwing it on a good dab mat keeps your table clean and gives the footed base even more grip.

How to Use It

The 8” Facet Decal Rig is designed to be straightforward, even if this is your first dedicated dab piece. The 14mm female joint accepts the included 14mm 90° banger, or any other standard 14mm banger you like, so you can swap styles as you figure out what you prefer. Just add a bit of water to the chamber, attach your banger, and you’re ready to go with your usual routine.

For cleaner function and less mess, park this rig on a non-slip accessory or tray so reclaim doesn’t end up bonding with your coffee table. A directional carb cap pairs nicely with the included banger if you want to really spin puddles and chase full flavor from your concentrates.

When the sesh is over, let everything cool down before you move or clean it. For regular maintenance, a quick rinse with warm water goes a long way. For deeper cleans, soak the rig and banger in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let them dry completely before your next round.

Specifications

Product Type Glass dab rig / oil rig
Height 8 inches (203mm)
Material Glass
Joint Size 14mm female
Joint Angle 90 degrees
Included 14mm 90-degree glass banger

Fit & Compatibility

The 8” Facet Decal Rig uses a standard 14mm female joint at a 90° angle, so it plays nice with most 14mm quartz bangers, terp slurpers, and similar nails built for 90° setups. If you’re already running other 14mm rigs, you can usually swap your favorite banger straight over to this one. Just make sure any accessories you add—like reclaim catchers or dropdowns—are also 14mm and 90° so everything sits level and functions properly.

To keep your concentrates fresh between dabs, it pairs well with proper storage like heavy-bottom concentrate jars, especially if you’re picky about flavor and terps.

What You Get in the Box

  • 1 × 8” Facet Decal Glass Dab Rig
  • 1 × 14mm 90° glass banger

Tips for Getting the Most Out of It

  • Dial in the water level — too much water and you’ll get splash, too little and the hit will feel harsh; aim for just enough to cover the perc area.
  • Use a carb cap — a simple bubble or directional cap helps move air and oil around for better vaporization and fuller flavor.
  • Rotate between bangers — if you dab a lot, having a backup 14mm banger lets one soak while you keep the sesh going.
  • Keep the outside clean — wipe off fingerprints and reclaim so the decal and faceted marble actually show instead of looking cloudy.
  • Travel smart — if you’re throwing this in a bag, wrap it in a towel or padded case and remove the banger so you’re not explaining broken glass to your roommate later.

If you like tougher, travel-ready gear for the road or the campsite, you might also want to add one of our nearly indestructible silicone bongs & rigs to your lineup so this glass piece can stay safe at home.

FAQ

  • Does the rig really come with a banger, or do I need to buy one separately?
    It does come with a 14mm 90° banger in the box, so you’re ready to go right away. If you like experimenting, you can always upgrade to a different style of 14mm banger later, but you don’t need to buy anything extra to start.
  • Will this fit my existing 14mm accessories?
    If your accessories are 14mm and designed for a 90° joint, they should fit. That includes 14mm reclaim catchers, dropdowns, and other 14mm 90° attachments. Just double-check the joint size before you force anything—glass-on-glass doesn’t forgive.
  • Is this rig good for beginners, or is it more for experienced dabbers?
    It works well for both. Beginners will appreciate the manageable 8-inch height and simple design, while experienced dabbers get a compact, stylish rig that still rips. If you’re coming from simple nectar collectors and want more water filtration, this is a natural next step.
  • How do I clean the rig and banger?
    Let everything cool down completely, then remove the banger. You can rinse with warm water for light buildup. For a deeper clean, soak both the rig and banger in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and allow them to dry before using again.
  • Can I use this with flower, or is it only for concentrates?
    This piece is set up as a dab rig, especially with the included banger. If you grab a 14mm bowl made for flower, you can technically use it, but the small size and design are really optimized for concentrates, not big flower snaps.
  • Is 8 inches too small? I don’t want harsh hits.
    An 8-inch rig is actually ideal for concentrates—shorter vapor path keeps flavor strong without needing a huge chamber. As long as you keep the water level right and don’t overfill, you’ll get smooth, flavorful pulls instead of harsh, dry hits.
  • What else do I need to complete my setup?
    Besides the rig and included banger, most dabbers add a carb cap, a good dab tool, and something to rest everything on. A proper dab tool makes handling sticky concentrates way easier, and a mat or tray keeps your surfaces from getting wrecked.
  • Is this rig durable enough for daily use?
    It’s built from glass and designed to be a daily driver, but it’s still glass—treat it with basic care. The footed base helps prevent easy tip-overs, and as long as you’re not knocking it off countertops or sinks, it can absolutely handle regular use.

If you’re stocking up a full station around this rig—pads, storage, and packaging for your concentrates—check out our broader line of storage & packaging to keep every slab, jar, and gram organized and protected.

The 6.5" Cactus Rig is a compact glass dab rig built for concentrate lovers who want real function without giving up personality. At just 6.5 inches (165mm) tall, it’s an easy daily driver that still rips, with a 14mm 90° joint and included banger so you’re dialed in right out of the box. The sculpted cactus body isn’t just for looks either—it gives you something solid to hold while the grid perc handles smooth, flavorful diffusion inside.

Why It Works

  • Smoother pulls, less harshness — The internal grid perc breaks your vapor into smaller bubbles so your hits come through cooler and easier on the throat.
  • Stays upright, even on crowded tables — A solid, footed base keeps the rig stable, so you’re not stressing every time someone bumps the coffee table.
  • Ready to sesh out of the box — Comes with a matching 14mm 90° banger, so you don’t have to hunt for a nail that fits.
  • Comfortable, natural grip — The cactus sculpt gives your hand an easy place to land while you pass and pull, instead of clutching a slippery tube.
  • Great flavor in a small footprint — The 6.5 inch (165mm) height keeps vapor path short enough for flavor, long enough for comfort.
  • Looks as good on the shelf as it hits on the table — The colorful cactus design doubles as décor when it’s not in rotation.

Best For

This cactus rig is made for dabbers who like their setups fun, photogenic, and functional. If your sesh table already has a couple of character pieces and you want a small rig that still hits smooth, this fits right in. It also pairs nicely with durable smoke shop accessories if you’re building out a full station.

How to Use It

Drop your 14mm banger into the 90° joint, add water until the grid perc is just covered, and you’re basically set. From there, you’re just heating the banger, letting it cool a bit, and pulling through the angled mouthpiece while vapor moves down into the grid perc and up through the cactus body.

Because of the compact size, a little water goes a long way—too much and you risk splash, so start low and dial it in. Setting your rig on a nonstick dab mat will help catch any drips and keep sticky tools off the table.

When you’re done, let everything cool before moving or cleaning. For quick daily upkeep, a rinse and a light shake with warm water usually keeps things from building up too fast.

Specifications

Height 6.5 inches (165mm)
Joint Size 14mm
Joint Angle 90°
Material Glass
Perc Style Grid perc
Included Accessory 14mm 90° banger

Fit & Compatibility

The 6.5" Cactus Rig uses a standard 14mm female joint at a 90° angle, so it plays nice with most 14mm male bangers, terp slurpers, and nails you already have. The included banger gets you started, but you can easily swap in other 14mm options if you want to experiment with different styles. If you’re matching this to other pieces or packaging, you can stash your favorite concentrates in heavy-bottom concentrate jars to keep everything organized and ready to go.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig and banger cool completely before cleaning—hot glass and cold liquid don’t mix. For quick refreshes, warm water rinses help keep reclaim from building up. For a deeper clean, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let it dry fully before the next use. The simple grid perc design makes it easier to clean than multi-chamber rigs with tight corners.

FAQ

  • Does this rig come with everything I need to start?
    Yes, the 6.5" Cactus Rig ships with a 14mm 90° banger included, so you’ve got the core setup covered. You may still want a carb cap and dab tool to round out your kit, and you can find those in our dedicated dab tools collection.
  • Will this fit my other nails or bangers?
    As long as they’re 14mm male and designed for a 90° joint, they should fit this rig just fine. If you’re upgrading to a more specialized banger or terp slurper, just double-check that 14mm sizing and 90° angle.
  • How hard is it to clean the grid perc?
    The grid perc is relatively straightforward compared to more complex recyclers or multi-perc rigs. A soak in isopropyl alcohol, followed by a good rinse, usually clears the slits and holes. Keeping your rig on a clean surface and using proper handling tools can also cut down on buildup—especially if you’re working around rosin or hash from your rosin extraction setup.
  • Is this more of a travel rig or a stay-at-home piece?
    It’s compact enough to be travel-friendly if you pack it carefully, but it’s glass, so treat it like any other nice rig. Many people use this as a home daily driver because the size is easy to handle and it doesn’t dominate the table.
  • Is the cactus shape just for looks or does it change the hit?
    The cactus shape is mostly aesthetic, but the sculpted body gives you more to grip and a slightly different internal airflow path compared to a straight tube. The real workhorse for smoothing your vapor is still the grid perc at the bottom.
  • What kind of concentrates work best with this rig?
    This rig works well with most common concentrates—wax, shatter, rosin, sauce, and so on. Just make sure you’re storing them properly so they stay clean and tasty; packaging in airtight storage containers helps keep terps where they belong.
  • Do I need any special accessories for this, or will my current setup work?
    If you already dab, your current tools will likely work fine as long as they’re sized for a 14mm rig. A good carb cap, a solid dabber, and maybe a nectar-style piece for on-the-go use—like the options in our nectar collectors section—can round out a very flexible concentrate lineup.

The 6.5" Cactus Rig hits that sweet spot between art piece and daily driver: small enough to keep on your desk, fun enough to show off, and functional enough that you’ll actually want to use it every day. If you like rigs with character that still deliver clean, smooth function, this cactus is ready to earn a permanent spot in your lineup.

The 9″ JUGZ Boobies Rig is a glass dab rig built for people who want real function with a playful, not-so-subtle silhouette. At 9 inches (229mm) tall, it’s compact enough for a desk or nightstand, but still has a roomy beaker-style base for proper water filtration. If you like your daily driver to hit smooth and also make your friends laugh the second you pull it out, this piece does both.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Rig

  • Hits stay smooth, not harsh — Beaker-style base gives you a generous water chamber so your dabs get cooled and washed before they hit your lungs.
  • Feels solid on the table — The wide beaker footprint helps keep it stable, so you’re not stressing every time someone bumps the coffee table.
  • Ready to dab out of the box — Comes with a 14mm 45° banger, so you don’t need to dig through a drawer of random glass to get going.
  • Conversation-piece design — Sculpted boobies body is unapologetically loud and funny, but still shaped to work like a real piece of glass, not just a novelty.
  • Dialed-in joint angle — The 45° joint keeps the banger at a natural angle over the base, so puddles stay where they should and not in your lap.
  • Good size for real sessions — 9 inches (229mm) is big enough for comfortable pulls but still easy to tuck away when you’re done.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who actually sesh, not just collect dust gatherers. If you like a daily driver that rips, but you also don’t take yourself too seriously, the boobies design hits that sweet spot. It’s a great centerpiece for people who already have a basic rig and want something more fun to add to their setup, especially if you’re pairing it with other colorful smoke shop products on your shelf.

How to Use It

Function-wise, this is a straightforward beaker-style oil rig with a 45° joint and included 14mm banger. Fill the base with enough water to cover the end of the downstem, keeping it low enough that you don’t get splashback when you pull. The beaker shape gives the vapor room to expand and cool before it reaches your mouth.

Drop the included 14mm 45° banger into the joint, heat and cool it to your usual comfort zone, then add your concentrate. The angle helps keep your concentrates pooling at the bottom instead of running out the neck, and it’s an easy setup to upgrade later if you want to swap to a different style banger or pair it with a directional cap from our carb caps collection.

For the best experience, park the rig on a sturdy surface like a good dab mat so the base grips while you’re moving the banger, spinning a cap, or passing it around. The beaker base plus a non-slip mat keeps spills and accidents to a minimum when you’re a few dabs deep.

Specs

Height 9 inches (229mm)
Material Glass
Rig Style Beaker-style oil rig
Joint Size 14mm
Joint Angle 45°
Included Accessory 14mm 45° banger

Fit & Compatibility

The 9″ JUGZ Boobies Rig uses a standard 14mm joint with a 45° angle, which plays nice with most 14mm bangers and dropdowns you already own. If you like to rotate different styles of quartz or swap in specialty nails, you can build out a little kit and keep your clean backups stored in proper rig accessories cases or organizers.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig and banger cool fully before you mess with them — hot glass and quick temperature changes don’t get along. Once it’s cool, you can rinse and lightly shake with a bit of isopropyl alcohol and salt if needed, then rinse with warm water and let it dry before the next sesh. For the banger, a quick wipe after use and an occasional soak in isopropyl alcohol keeps it from getting cloudy and preserves flavor.

FAQ

  • Does this rig come with everything I need to start dabbing?
    It comes with the rig itself and a 14mm 45° banger, so you’re set on the core pieces. To really dial it in, most people also grab a carb cap and dab tool; you can find a ton of options in our dab tools section that pair well with this setup.
  • Will this work with other 14mm bangers or nails I already have?
    Yes. As long as your banger or nail is 14mm and designed for a 45° joint, it should fit just fine. Straight or 90° bangers will technically insert, but the angle won’t line up as cleanly and may not function the way you prefer.
  • Is the 9″ size more of a travel rig or a home rig?
    It leans more toward a home rig but is still compact enough to pack up if you’re careful. The height gives better cooling and smoother pulls than a tiny micro-rig, while still being easy to stash away with your other gear or in a padded case alongside your favorite nectar collectors.
  • How much water should I put in the beaker base?
    Add just enough water to cover the bottom of the downstem inside the rig. You want it to bubble when you pull, but not so high that it reaches your mouthpiece or splashes up when you clear it.
  • How do I keep the boobies shape from being a pain to clean?
    Because it’s still a beaker-style body, it’s easier to clean than some crazy multi-chamber rigs. A bit of isopropyl alcohol and a warm water rinse usually does the trick. If resin starts building up in corners, a gentle shake with alcohol and salt will help scrub hard-to-reach spots.
  • Can I use this for flower, or is it only for concentrates?
    The JUGZ Boobies Rig is sold and set up as an oil rig with a banger included, but if you swap the banger for a 14mm bowl, you can absolutely run flower through it. Just note that heavy flower use will gunk it up faster, so you may want to keep a separate piece or grab an extra from our general silicone bongs & rigs collection if you switch between the two a lot.
  • What’s the best way to store it when I’m not using it?
    Keep it somewhere stable where it won’t get knocked over — a shelf, desk, or cabinet works great. If you like to keep everything neat, stash your concentrates nearby in proper concentrate jars so your whole setup is ready when it’s time for a sesh.

The 9.5″ Monark Big Tube Double Uptake Recycler is a heavy-duty glass dab rig built for dabbers who care about function as much as looks. If you’re into longer seshes, flavor, and smooth pulls, this recycler’s double uptake and up-fire perc combo is made to keep hits cool and controlled. At 9.5 inches (241mm) tall with a 14mm 90° joint, it’s that sweet spot between compact and “wow, that rips.”

Why It Hits Different

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — Double uptake recycler design keeps water and vapor moving so the hit has more time to cool before it reaches you.
  • Cleaner flavor from your concentrates — The up-fire perc breaks the vapor into fine bubbles, giving you better diffusion without totally scrubbing the terps.
  • Built like a tank — Thick glass and a beefy tube profile give it a solid, stable feel on the table and in your hand.
  • Balanced 90° joint — The 14mm 90° joint keeps your banger sitting level, so you’re not fighting awkward angles during your sesh.
  • Less splash, more function — Recycler design helps keep water in the rig where it belongs, not in your mouth.
  • Looks as good as it rips — Monark’s bold tubing and accent colors make this rig a legit centerpiece, not just another clear tube.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who are past the starter-kit stage and want something with real function and presence. If you’re running several dabs a day and like to post up at a clean station on a dedicated dab mat, this piece fits right in as a daily driver or showpiece.

It’s also a great pick if you like recyclers but don’t want a tiny, finicky rig — the 9.5″ height gives you room for good function and water volume without feeling oversized.

How to Use It

Fill the rig so the up-fire perc is just covered with water; too much and you’ll flood the recycler, too little and you’ll lose that smooth chug. When you pull, vapor is drawn through the perc, up the main chamber, and then cycled through the dual uptakes back down into the lower chamber.

That continuous loop is what gives recyclers their signature feel: the water and vapor are constantly moving, getting re-filtered and cooled before they ever hit your lips. Pair it with a solid banger and a good carb cap from our carb caps collection and you’ll really feel what this thing can do.

After your sesh, let everything cool off before handling. Then you can dump the water, give it a quick rinse, and you’re ready for your next round. If you like to keep your glass spotless, a dedicated tool from our dab tools lineup makes scraping and loading way less messy.

Specifications

Height 9.5 inches (241mm)
Joint Size & Angle 14mm, 90°
Joint Type Male
Material Glass
Perc Type Up-fire perc
Style Double uptake recycler dab rig
Brand Monark

What’s Included

  • 9.5″ Monark Big Tube Double Uptake Recycler (glass rig)
  • 14mm 90° banger (ready to use out of the box)

All you need to add is your concentrate, a torch, and a safe place to set everything down — a nonstick pad or tray from our broader smoke shop products lineup keeps your station dialed.

Fit & Compatibility

The rig comes with a standard 14mm male, 90° joint. That means it plays nicely with most common 14mm 90° quartz bangers, terp slurpers, and similar nails. If you’re already running other 14mm glass, chances are you can swap accessories between them with no issue.

The footprint and thick tubing give it a solid base, so it’s less likely to tip compared to skinny, top-heavy rigs — clutch when you’ve got tools, jars, and a torch all living on the same table. For people who like to swap between different flavors, having a few extra clean bangers stored in your storage & packaging setup makes rotating way easier.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig and banger fully cool before cleaning. For the glass body, a soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a good rinse with warm water and complete dry time will keep the recycler pathways clear. The banger can be wiped or soaked the same way to remove stubborn residue.

If you’re someone who likes spotless glass all the time, changing the water regularly and giving it quick rinses will keep buildup from forming in the uptakes and perc, so you don’t have to do deep cleans as often.

FAQs

  • Does this rig come with a banger?
    Yes. The 9.5″ Monark Big Tube Double Uptake Recycler includes a 14mm 90° banger so you can use it right away. You can always upgrade to a different style of 14mm 90° quartz if you have a favorite.
  • Will this fit my existing accessories?
    If your current gear uses a 14mm, 90° setup, you’re in good shape. Just make sure any banger or nail you swap in is also 14mm and designed for a 90° joint so it sits level and heats evenly.
  • How much water should I put in the recycler?
    You only need enough to cover the up-fire perc and allow the recycler function to engage. If you notice water splashing up into the neck, you’ve probably overfilled it — pour a little out and test again.
  • Is this a good rig for larger dabs?
    Yes, the thicker tubing, recycler function, and 9.5″ height handle denser hits well, as long as your banger is sized right. For heavy hitters who go back-to-back with bigger dabs, pairing this with a quality quartz banger and storing your concentrates in proper concentrate jars will help keep flavor on point.
  • What’s the advantage of a double uptake recycler vs a regular rig?
    Double uptakes help move water and vapor more efficiently, which can lead to smoother, cooler hits and less choppy function. Instead of vapor going straight from perc to mouthpiece, it’s being re-routed and mixed with water as it cycles.
  • Is it hard to clean a recycler like this?
    Not really, as long as you stay on top of it. Rinsing regularly and doing occasional iso soaks will keep the uptakes and chambers from getting clogged. If you’re pressing your own material, using clean parchment or liners from our parchment papers section helps cut down on impurities that gunk up glass.
  • Is this a good choice as my first “nice” rig?
    If you’ve used simpler rigs or small recyclers and want to step up into something with more function and presence, this is a solid pick. It’s not overly complicated, but the double uptake and up-fire perc give you that upgraded experience that makes a difference when you’re a few dabs deep and just want your setup to work flawlessly.

The 11″ Monark Color Accent Pillar Incycler is a high-end glass dab rig built for dabbers who care just as much about function as they do about flexing something pretty on the table. Standing 11 inches (279mm) tall with a pillar-style incycler body and bold color accents, it’s made for people who take multiple dabs a day and want those hits smooth, cooled, and splash-free. The one-hole perc and internal recycling action keep the draw tight and flavorful, not harsh or chuggy.

Why It Works

  • Smoother, cleaner pulls — The one-hole perc feeds directly into the incycler chamber, giving you controlled diffusion without over-chopping your terps.
  • Less splash, more flavor — Incycler design keeps water moving inside the pillar instead of your mouth, so you can pull harder without tasting the pool.
  • Dialed for concentrates — The included 14mm 90° banger lines up perfectly with the rig’s geometry, so airflow feels natural and easy when you’re mid-sesh.
  • Stable on the table — The pillar body and heavy glass give it a solid footprint, so you’re not stressing every time someone bumps the coffee table.
  • Eye candy that actually rips — Color accents and the sculpted recycler column make it look like a showpiece, but it’s still built to be a true daily driver.
  • Easy draw control — That single perc hole keeps the pull from feeling restricted, which you’ll notice when you’re stacking bubbles with minimal effort.

Best For

This piece is made for dabbers who run regular seshes and want something more interesting than a plain beaker, but still need reliable function every single time. It’s a great upgrade if you’re moving from a simple rig into the world of recyclers and incyclers and want something that won’t be a pain to clean or use daily. If you already have a lineup of smaller travel pieces or silicone rigs, this makes a perfect “stay-at-home” centerpiece that delivers your best-tasting dabs.

How to Use It

Fill the rig so the bottom chamber just covers the one-hole perc and the recycler pillar starts to engage when you pull. Too much water and you’ll choke the function; too little and you won’t get that satisfying internal spin.

Drop your concentrate into the included 14mm banger, cap it, and watch the incycler go to work as the water cycles up and back down through the pillar. The internal motion helps cool the vapor and keep it moving, so your hits feel lighter on the lungs even when you’re taking bigger dabs. Parking it on a non-slip dab mat is a nice move to keep your table clean and your glass safe.

When you’re done, let everything cool, empty the water, and give it a quick rinse so reclaim doesn’t build up inside the recycling pathways. For heavier use, deeper cleans with isopropyl alcohol will keep that glass shining and the function crisp.

Specifications

Height 11 inches (279mm)
Material Borosilicate glass
Rig Type Dab rig / oil rig
Joint Size 14mm male
Joint Angle 90°
Perc Type One-hole perc
Design Pillar incycler body with color accents

Fit & Compatibility

The Monark Pillar Incycler comes ready to run with its included 14mm banger, but swapping or upgrading hardware is easy. Any accessory made for a 14mm female joint and 90° angle will play nice with this rig, whether that’s a new banger style, an e-nail-ready bucket, or a different style of carb cap to fine-tune airflow. Just keep the 14mm sizing and 90° geometry in mind when you’re mixing and matching.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig and banger cool completely before you do anything. Empty the water after use to keep things from smelling stale, and give the rig a quick warm-water rinse to knock out loose residue. For deeper cleaning, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and let it dry before your next sesh. Keeping on top of maintenance means better flavor and smoother recycling function over time.

FAQ

  • Does this rig come with everything I need to start dabbing?

    It comes with the main rig and a 14mm male 90° banger, so you’ve got the core setup. You’ll still want a proper dab tool and maybe a carb cap to really dial in your hits; both are easy upgrades and make handling concentrates way less messy. If you’re building a full station, pairing this with a few solid dab tools is a smart move.

  • What kind of concentrates can I use with this incycler?

    Anything you’d normally run through a banger will work — wax, shatter, rosin, live resin, diamonds in sauce, etc. The incycler doesn’t care what texture you prefer; its job is to cool and smooth out whatever vapor you send through it. Just use a tool instead of trying to drop sticky product straight in.

  • How much water should I put in it?

    Fill just enough to cover the one-hole perc in the bottom chamber, then test pull and adjust until you see water cycling up through the pillar without splashing into your mouth. You don’t need to overfill it; recyclers and incyclers work best with a moderate water line that lets the water move freely.

  • Is an incycler better than a regular rig?

    “Better” depends on what you like. Incyclers like this shine if you enjoy smoother, cooled hits and like watching water motion while you dab. Compared to a simple single-chamber rig, you usually get less splashback and a slightly more refined, controlled draw. If you’re coming from a basic pipe or one-chamber rig in our broader smoke shop products line, this will feel like a noticeable upgrade.

  • How do I keep the recycling pathways from clogging?

    The easiest way is to not let reclaim sit in there for weeks. Empty the water after use, give it a quick rinse, and do a light alcohol clean when you start to see buildup. If any reclaim collects near the recycler tunnels, a little isopropyl soak and a good rinse usually clears it right up. Storing your concentrates in clean, sealed concentrate jars also helps keep dust and debris from finding their way into the rig.

  • Can I travel with this rig?

    You can move it around or take it to a friend’s place, but treat it like the high-end glass it is. Empty all water before packing it, wrap it in something padded, and keep the banger separate so it doesn’t knock around. If you need something truly toss-in-a-bag friendly, it’s worth grabbing a tougher option from our storage and packaging lineup to protect it when it’s not on display.

  • Is this rig overkill for someone new to dabbing?

    Not at all. If you know you’re going to be dabbing regularly, starting with a solid incycler just means you won’t feel the need to upgrade in a month. It’s easy to use, not overly complicated, and forgiving on the lungs. You can always start simple and grow into it, instead of buying a cheaper piece you’ll quickly outgrow and end up tossing in the clearance pile of your own collection.

The 10″ Monark Color Accent Dual Chamber Recycler is a premium glass dab rig built for dedicated concentrate heads who want smooth, flavorful pulls with serious function. Standing 10 inches (254mm) tall with a dual chamber recycler and dual showerhead perc, it’s made for people who take multiple dabs per sesh and don’t want their throat cooked. Color accents give it that “leave-me-out-on-the-table” look instead of another plain clear piece hiding in the corner.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Smoother, cooler hits — dual showerhead filtration and recycler action pull your vapor through water multiple times so it feels soft instead of sharp.
  • No more surprise splashback — the dual chamber recycler with double uptakes keeps the water cycling down where it belongs, not up in your mouth.
  • Ready to dab out of the box — includes a 14mm male 90° banger, so you’re not digging through old glass just to take the first rip.
  • Great flavor at daily-driver size — 10 inches (254mm) is tall enough for real cooling, but still compact enough that terps don’t get lost on a huge air path.
  • Looks as good as it rips — color accents highlight the recycler lines and chambers, so it actually stands out on your shelf.
  • Stable and comfortable to handle — the dual chamber layout balances the weight for easy passing around the circle.

Best For

This Monark recycler is made for dabbers who run 3–6 hits in a sesh and care more about function and flavor than giant clouds for the camera. It’s a perfect upgrade if you’ve been using a basic beaker or straight tube and want smoother pulls without jumping into a massive, complicated glass tower. If your main setup is already a compact rig or one of our unbreakable silicone bongs & rigs, this is the “nice glass” you break out when you want to treat yourself or impress friends.

The Basics: How to Use It

Fill the rig so the dual showerhead perc and inline section are just submerged — enough water for solid chug, not so much that it climbs into the neck. Once you start pulling, vapor drops into the lower chamber, percs through the water, then cycles up the recycler arms and falls back down repeatedly, cooling and smoothing things out every pass.

The double uptake design means water is constantly moving between chambers, which helps keep hits consistent, even on longer pulls. Set it on a solid dab mat to protect your table from heat, drips, or the occasional clumsy pass across the coffee table.

When you’re done, let everything cool off completely before you think about cleaning or swapping out the banger. Glass stays hot longer than it looks, especially around the joint and recycler arms.

The Monark Dual Chamber Recycler runs a 14mm joint at a 90° angle, which plays nice with most modern flat-top bangers and terp accessories made for rigs. Any standard 14mm male banger or nail is going to feel right at home here. If you like to swap between different styles of nails, pair it with sturdy dab tools so you’re not fumbling hot glass mid-sesh.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig and banger cool completely before cleaning to avoid thermal shock or burns. For regular upkeep, empty the water, then rinse with warm water to knock loose any loose residue. For deeper cleans, soak the rig in isopropyl alcohol (you can add a bit of salt if you like more abrasion), then rinse thoroughly with clean water and let it dry fully before using again.

To keep your dab station from turning into a sticky zone, keep cotton swabs and a small waste container nearby, or stash your used swabs in a dedicated jar from our storage & packaging lineup so they’re not scattered all over the table.
