The 5.5″ Triple Ratchet Donut Mouth Rig from What You Need is a compact glass dab rig built for concentrate lovers who want big function in a small footprint. At just 5.5 inches (140mm) tall with a triple ratchet perc and donut-style mouthpiece, it’s made for dabbers chasing smooth, flavorful hits without hauling around a giant piece. The 14mm male 90° banger means it’s ready to drop into your daily rotation right out of the box.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Smoother, less harsh pulls — The triple ratchet perc breaks your vapor into smaller bubbles so each hit feels softer on the throat.
  • Flavor without the drag — Short 5.5 inch (140mm) path keeps terps tasting fresh instead of washing them out with a tall tube.
  • Comfortable, grippy mouthpiece — Donut-style mouthpiece gives your lips a natural resting spot and makes the rig easy to grab and pass.
  • Compact but sturdy — Thick glass and a small form factor mean it feels solid in the hand and less awkward on crowded tables.
  • Ready to dab out of the box — Includes a 14mm male 90° banger, so you don’t have to hunt down a nail just to try it.
  • Great function at a friendly size — Triple ratchet diffusion in a small rig gives you that “big rig” smoothness without needing a whole shelf.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want real percolation in a piece that doesn’t dominate the coffee table. If you’re doing a few dabs in the evening or quick hits throughout the day and want smoother pulls than a basic mini rig, this fits right in. It makes a nice upgrade from basic starter glass and pairs well with a dedicated dab mat so your station stays clean when things get sticky.

How to Use It

Think of the Triple Ratchet Donut Mouth Rig as your compact flavor station. Your concentrates go into the included 14mm male banger, the vapor travels down through the joint, and the triple ratchet perc in the base does the heavy lifting by diffusing everything into smoother, cooler clouds before it hits the donut mouthpiece.

The 90° joint angle keeps your banger sitting level, which helps with even heating and makes it easy to cap and spin without awkward wrist angles. Grab your favorite tool from your lineup or from our selection of dedicated dab tools, drop in your concentrate, and let the perc and donut mouthpiece handle the rest.

After you’re done, let the rig and banger cool down fully, then rinse or wipe out any reclaim. For deeper cleans, you can soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with water, and let it dry before the next sesh. Keeping it clean not only looks better, it helps the triple ratchet perc function at its best.

Specifications

Category Dab rig / oil rig
Height 5.5 inches (140mm)
Joint Angle 90°
Joint Size 14mm (rig accepts 14mm male banger)
Included Banger 14mm male, 90° angle
Percolator Triple ratchet perc
Mouthpiece Donut-style mouthpiece
Material Glass

Fit & Compatibility

This rig is built around a 14mm joint, so it plays nicely with most standard 14mm male bangers and other 14mm accessories in your stash. The 90° angle is ideal for traditional bucket-style bangers, giving you a flat, level surface that works well with bubble caps, directional caps, and other airflow-focused tools. If you want a more rugged travel option to go alongside this piece, check out our lineup of unbreakable-style silicone pipes for on-the-go seshes.

What You Get

  • 1 × 5.5″ Triple Ratchet Donut Mouth Rig (glass)
  • 1 × 14mm male 90° glass banger

Tips to Get the Most From It

  • Mind your water level — Add enough water to cover the triple ratchet perc slits but not so much that it splashes into the donut mouthpiece when you pull.
  • Keep the donut clear — If reclaim builds up near the donut opening, a quick soak helps keep airflow wide open and comfortable.
  • Pair it right — A solid carb cap from our carb caps collection will help the triple ratchet perc really shine by controlling airflow and vapor density.
  • Protect your glass — When you’re not using it, stash it somewhere stable or inside a padded case so you’re not explaining broken glass to your roommate.

FAQ

Will this rig fit my existing bangers?

The rig is set up for 14mm accessories with a 90° angle, so any standard 14mm male 90° banger should fit just fine. If you’re coming from a different joint size or angle, you might need an adapter, but most modern bangers are a direct match.

How big of a hit can I get from a 5.5″ rig?

Even though it’s only 5.5 inches (140mm) tall, the triple ratchet perc moves a surprising amount of vapor. You can clear solid hits without the drag you’d get from taller, more complex pieces. It’s ideal for regular-size dabs rather than massive, competition-style clouds.

Is the triple ratchet perc hard to clean?

It’s more detailed than a basic downstem, but still easy to maintain if you stay on top of it. Let everything cool, rinse out loose residue, then soak the rig in isopropyl alcohol when it starts to look cloudy. A quick shake while it’s soaking helps keep the perc slits clear, and you’re good to go again.

Can I use this as a flower piece?

This rig is designed as an oil rig with a 14mm male banger included, but in theory you could swap the banger for a 14mm female bowl that matches the joint. Just remember the water level and perc are tuned for vapor, not big flower snaps, so most people keep it strictly for concentrates and use a separate piece from our general smoke shop products lineup for herb.

Is it stable enough for daily use on a desk or coffee table?

Yes. The short height and thick glass make it feel planted and secure, especially compared to tall, top-heavy towers. As with any glass, just give it a clear spot to live so it’s not competing with laptops, rolling trays, and snacks.

What kind of dab tools and accessories work best with this?

Any standard 14mm-focused setup works well: a solid dabber, a carb cap sized for your banger, and something to rest hot glass on after use. If you like keeping things organized, pair it with proper storage and packaging for your concentrates so you’re not juggling jars and tools mid-sesh.

How should I store it when I’m not using it?

Let everything cool fully, give it a quick rinse if needed, then park it somewhere stable where it can’t get knocked over. You can also keep your concentrates sealed up in dedicated concentrate jars nearby so your whole dab setup is ready to go when the next sesh calls.

The 6″ Full Color Cone Drain Recycler is a compact glass dab rig built for flavor chasers who want smooth, splash-free hits in a small footprint. Standing just 6 inches (152mm) tall with a 90° 14mm joint and showerhead perc, it’s made to be a comfy daily driver that still rips. If you like watching your water spin while your vapor stays cool and tasty, this little cone recycler earns its spot on the table.

The full-color design gives it a bold, heady look without going overboard, so it feels just as at home in a collection as it does as your go-to sesh piece. Between the bent neck, cone drain recycler function, and tight showerhead diffusion, it’s built to keep water out of your mouth and terps in your hit.

Key Benefits

  • Smoother, cooler hits — The built-in showerhead perc breaks the vapor into tons of tiny bubbles, giving it more time to cool before it reaches you.
  • No surprise splashback — The bent neck plus recycler design keeps the water cycling in the body of the rig instead of rushing up toward your mouth.
  • Flavor over harshness — The compact 6 inch (152mm) profile and close diffusion mean the vapor doesn’t have time to go stale, so you taste more of your concentrate and less hot air.
  • Efficient recycling action — The cone drain recycler pulls water up and drops it back down in a loop, which helps maintain consistent function hit after hit.
  • Comfortable 90° setup — The 90° joint lines up perfectly with most bangers, keeping the hot side away from your face and your rig balanced on the table.
  • Full-color style — Multiple color options let you match your rig to your favorite banger, carb cap, or tray instead of settling for plain clear glass.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want a compact recycler that can realistically be their daily driver, not just a shelf piece. If you already have a dedicated dab mat and a few bangers in rotation but want a smoother, more controlled hit than a basic mini rig, this fits that lane perfectly.

It’s especially nice for people who take multiple smaller dabs instead of one giant one — the recycler function and showerhead perc shine when you’re running flavorful, lower-volume pulls and actually paying attention to the function.

How to Use It

Set the 6″ Cone Drain Recycler on a stable surface, then add water through the mouthpiece or joint until the showerhead perc is fully covered and you can see it percolate evenly when you pull. You’re aiming for enough water to activate the perc and recycler without flooding the neck or splashing up toward the mouthpiece.

Attach your 14mm banger to the 90° joint and seat it snugly. Once everything is in place, you can heat your banger with your normal routine and watch how the recycler pulls water up and drains it back down while you pull. If you like to swap between rigs, it’s easy to keep this one in the rotation with your other silicone bongs and rigs thanks to the standard joint size and angle.

When you’re done, let the rig cool off before dumping and refreshing the water. Keeping fresh water in recyclers helps maintain flavor and keeps that satisfying vortex clear and visible.

Specifications

Height 6 inches (152mm)
Material Glass
Joint Size & Angle 14mm, 90°
Rig Type Cone drain recycler dab rig
Perc Type Showerhead perc
Neck Style Bent neck
Colors Multiple full-color options available
Included 14mm male banger

Fit & Compatibility

The 6″ Full Color Cone Drain Recycler uses a standard 14mm, 90° joint, so it plays nicely with most quartz bangers and dab nails in that size range. If you’ve already got a drawer full of 14mm accessories and a couple of dab tools, they should drop right into your setup without any weird adapters.

Because it’s a compact recycler, it’s best paired with standard or slightly smaller bucket-style bangers; oversized or super-heavy options can make small rigs feel tipped or front-heavy. The included banger gives you a clean starting point, and you can upgrade later if you want to dial in your perfect combo.

The Basics of Recycler Function

Recycler rigs like this cone drain are built to keep water and vapor moving in a loop. As you pull, water is drawn up through the internal recycler tubes, cools and filters your vapor, then drains back down into the base — over and over during your hit.

This does a couple of things you can actually feel: it helps prevent water from stacking too high in the main chamber, reduces splashback, and keeps the water fresh and moving instead of just sitting there. When you’ve got a good recycler paired with the right concentrates stored in proper concentrate jars, you’ll notice more flavor and less harsh edge, especially on back-to-back dabs.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig and banger cool completely before you mess with them. Once everything is at room temp, empty the old water, then add a bit of isopropyl alcohol to the rig, plug the openings, and gently shake to loosen residue. Rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry before your next sesh.

For the banger, let it cool, then wipe off any loose residue. When it needs a deeper reset, a quick soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a good rinse keeps it ready to go. Keeping your glass clean not only looks better, it helps your recycler function properly so the cone drain actually drains the way it’s supposed to.

FAQ

  • What size banger does this rig use?
    This recycler uses a 14mm, 90° joint and comes with a 14mm male banger. If you have other 14mm 90° bangers already, they should fit without any issues.
  • Is 6 inches too small for a recycler?
    Not at all. At 6 inches (152mm), this rig is compact but still has enough internal space for the showerhead perc and cone drain recycler to function properly. It’s more of a flavor and control piece than a huge cloud-chaser, which is exactly what many dabbers want in a daily driver.
  • Does this come with everything I need to start dabbing?
    You get the glass rig and a 14mm male banger. You’ll still want a carb cap and a proper dabber, which you can grab from our broader smoke shop products lineup to round out your setup.
  • What type of carb cap works best with this rig?
    Most standard caps will work as long as they match your banger style. Directional and bubble caps are popular choices for rigs this size, and you can explore different styles in our carb caps collection if you want to really dial in airflow and spin.
  • How do I fill the water to the right level?
    Add water slowly through the mouthpiece or joint until the showerhead perc is covered and you see good bubbling without water climbing too high. If water is reaching the neck or your mouth, just pour a little out and try again — small rigs are sensitive to overfilling, so a little adjustment goes a long way.
  • Is this a good rig for travel?
    The 6 inch height and sturdy recycler design make it pretty easy to pack and move around, as long as you empty the water first and protect it well. For truly tossable gear you can’t break, you might pair this glass piece with one of our more rugged accessories like cases or mats to keep it safer on the road.
  • How often should I change the water?
    For the best flavor and cleanest function, changing the water daily (or at least every few seshes) is ideal. Fresh water helps the showerhead perc fire correctly and keeps the recycler draining smoothly instead of getting bogged down with residue.

The 8.5″ Full Color Waffle Recycler is a compact glass dab rig built for concentrate lovers who want maximum flavor without a huge, clumsy setup. The waffle body and double uptake recycler keep water and vapor moving so hits stay cool, smooth, and clean-tasting. At 8.5 inches (215.9mm) tall with a 14mm 90° joint, it’s that sweet spot between table-friendly and easy to pass around.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The recycler design constantly moves water and vapor, cutting down on harshness and splashback.
  • Flavor stays true — Short vapor path plus steady water circulation helps preserve terps instead of cooking them out.
  • No weird drag — The 2-hole perc gives enough diffusion for comfort, without turning each pull into a lung workout.
  • Ready right out of the box — Comes with a matching 14mm 90° banger so you don’t have to hunt down a compatible piece.
  • Full color, full personality — The colored glass and waffle body shape make it look like a proper centerpiece, not just another clear tube.
  • Dialed size for real-world use — 8.5 inches (215.9mm) is big enough for function, small enough for desk or nightstand duty.

Best For

This waffle recycler is made for dabbers who run a few solid seshes a day and want a rig that stays smooth without constant micromanaging. If you like rigs with real function but don’t want a giant, multi-chamber science project on your table, this is a perfect daily driver. It also pairs nicely with unbreakable travel gear like our silicone bongs and rigs if you like to keep one piece at home and one in the bag.

How to Use It

Fill the waffle recycler just high enough to cover the 2-hole perc inside the bottom chamber. As you pull, vapor travels up from the banger, through the perc, and into the main chamber while water is pulled up the double uptakes and then drains back down. That continuous loop is what keeps your hits cool and the recycler action looking so clean.

The 90° 14mm joint lines up perfectly with a typical flat-top banger, so loading is straightforward and comfortable. A good carb cap helps you really control airflow and vapor density, so consider grabbing one from our carb caps collection if you don’t already have a favorite.

After your sesh, let everything cool off before you move or clean it. For a quick refresh between dabs, a dry or slightly damp cotton swab in the banger and a rinse of the rig go a long way toward keeping flavor fresh. Set it on a dedicated dab mat to catch any stray drips and keep your table from turning into a sticky mess.

Specifications

Height 8.5 inches (215.9mm)
Material Glass
Joint Angle 90°
Joint Size 14mm
Perc Style 2-hole perc
Recycler Type Double uptake waffle body

Fit & Compatibility

This rig uses a 14mm 90° joint, so it plays nicely with most standard 14mm quartz bangers, dropdowns, and reclaim setups that match that angle. The included banger gets you started, but if you like to swap between different quartz styles, just stick to 14mm at 90° and you’re good. For storing different strains or batches of concentrates you’re running through this rig, pair it with some dedicated concentrate jars to keep everything fresh and organized.

Cleaning & Care

When it’s time for a deeper clean, first let the rig and banger cool completely. Then you can use isopropyl alcohol and a bit of salt or just iso alone to soak and rinse out residue. Always rinse thoroughly with clean water and let it dry before you sesh again. Consistent light cleaning keeps the recycler action smooth and the glass looking clear instead of cloudy.

FAQs

  • What size banger or nail does this rig use?

    This rig uses a 14mm 90° joint, and it comes with a 14mm banger included. If you ever want to upgrade, just grab another 14mm 90° banger and it’ll fit. If you’re building out a full setup with tools, check out our selection of dab tools so you’re not digging for paperclips when it’s time to load.

  • Is the recycler action just for looks, or does it really make a difference?

    It’s not just for show. The double uptake recycler continuously pulls water up and sends it back down, keeping vapor moving and cooled while cutting splashback. You’ll notice smoother, more comfortable hits compared to a simple straight-tube rig, especially on back-to-back dabs.

  • How hard is this to clean with all those curves?

    It looks complicated, but cleaning is pretty simple: let it cool, add isopropyl alcohol, shake or soak, then rinse and dry. Because it’s not overly tall or packed with extra chambers, residue comes off easier than on some bigger, more intricate recyclers.

  • Can I use this as a small flower bong too?

    Technically you can attach a 14mm bowl and use it for flower, but it’s really designed as a dab rig. If you want a dedicated piece for bowls so you’re not mixing flavors, take a look at our broader smoke shop products lineup for pipes and bongs built for flower.

  • Is 8.5 inches big enough for heavy hitters?

    Yes. That height, plus the 2-hole perc and recycler loop, gives you plenty of cooling without wasting space. You’re not relying on sheer size for smoothness—the water movement and perc do the heavy lifting, so it still rips while staying manageable.

  • Will the full-color glass fade or peel?

    No peeling here—the color is in the glass itself, not painted on. As long as you avoid dropping it or smashing it against hard surfaces, the color will stay vibrant. Regular gentle cleaning keeps it looking fresh instead of foggy.

  • What else should I grab to complete my setup?

    Besides the rig and included banger, you’ll want a good carb cap, a solid dabber, and somewhere safe to stash your concentrates. If you’re also pressing or handling your own material, tools from our storage and packaging collection help keep your stash organized and protected.

If you want a compact, full-color rig that actually delivers on function instead of just looking cool, the 8.5″ Full Color Waffle Recycler hits that balance. It’s built for real-world daily use, smooth pulls, and clean flavor, without needing a whole shelf to itself.

The 6" Color Lip/Marble Peanut Rig is a compact glass dab rig made for concentrate fans who want real function in a small footprint. At just 6 inches (152mm) tall with a 14mm male joint and a chunky puck base, it’s a perfect little daily driver that doesn’t hog your table. The peanut-shaped body, color lip, and matching marble give it that "what rig is that?" look while the two-hole perc keeps hits smooth and flavorful.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Big flavor in a small rig — Short vapor path and a two-hole perc keep terps front and center instead of getting lost in a giant chamber.
  • Comfortable pulls — The bent neck and 90° joint angle keep the heat away from your face so you can focus on the hit, not dodging the torch.
  • Stays upright, even on crowded tables — The hollow puck base gives you a low, wide platform so you’re not stressing every time someone bumps the coffee table.
  • Easy pairing with your favorite banger — Standard 14mm male joint plays nice with most 14mm female quartz bangers and nails already in your stash.
  • Looks good in any lineup — Color lip and marble detail turn this from “just a rig” into a piece you actually like seeing on the shelf.
  • Great size for personal seshes — At 6 inches (152mm), it’s small enough to be a solo rig, but still big enough to pass around without feeling tiny.

Best For

This peanut rig is made for dabbers who want a compact, good-looking piece that can actually handle daily use. If your sesh station already has a dab mat, a couple tools, and a favorite banger, this fits right into that ecosystem without taking over the whole surface.

It’s also a solid pick if you like keeping a “home rig” that feels nicer than a travel beater, while still being small enough to tuck away when company comes over.

How to Use It

Set the rig on a stable surface and fill the chamber with just enough water to cover the two-hole perc at the end of the fixed downstem. You don’t need a ton of water here — just enough for bubbles to break up your vapor without splashing.

Attach your favorite 14mm female banger, bring the rig up to your normal dabbing angle, and you’re ready to go. As you pull, vapor moves from the banger, down the fixed downstem, and through the two-hole perc where it’s diffused and cooled inside the peanut-shaped body.

The bent neck keeps your face well above the action, so you can comfortably watch your puddle without feeling like you’re about to get toasted. If you like to keep your station clean, park this piece on a small glass tray or accessory pad to catch any stray drips.

After your sesh, let the rig cool before you move or clean it. A quick rinse goes a long way in keeping flavor fresh from one dab to the next.

Specifications

Category Dab Rig / Oil Rig
Height 6 inches (152mm)
Joint Size 14mm Male
Joint Angle 90°
Material Glass
Perc Style Fixed downstem with two-hole perc
Body Shape Peanut-style chamber with hollow puck base
Design Details Color lip and matching marble accent

Fit & Compatibility

This rig is built with a 14mm male joint at a 90° angle, which means it plays best with 14mm female bangers, nails, and dropdowns. If you already own a few standard quartz bangers, there’s a good chance they’ll drop right onto this piece with no adapters needed.

The compact chamber size pairs especially well with smaller bucket bangers and inserts when you want to keep temps and flavor dialed in. For anyone running multiple rigs, this makes a great "flavor rig" in the lineup alongside your larger daily drivers and silicone rigs.

Care & Cleaning

Keep it simple: let the rig cool completely before cleaning. Then empty the water, add a bit of isopropyl alcohol, plug the openings, and gently shake until the residue breaks up. Rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry before your next sesh.

For really stuck-on spots, a short soak in isopropyl alcohol, followed by a good rinse, will usually bring the glass back to clear. If you’re handling sticky tools nearby, consider using parchment or nonstick sheets on your table to keep reclaim off your glass and surfaces.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my existing bangers?
    If your bangers are 14mm female, they should fit this rig with no problem. Anything 10mm or 18mm, or male joints, would need an adapter to work.
  • Does it come with a banger or nail?
    Check the product options on the page — many rigs are sold without a banger so you can choose your own style and quality level. If you’re upgrading your setup, this pairs nicely with a quality quartz banger and a directional cap from our carb cap collection.
  • How much water should I use?
    Add just enough water to cover the two holes at the end of the perc. Too much water can cause splashback, while too little won’t give you that smooth diffusion this rig is designed for.
  • Is this okay as a travel rig?
    It’s small and easy to pack, but it’s still glass, so treat it with care. For road trips and rough environments, a lot of people keep this as their home piece and grab something from our general smoke shop lineup or silicone gear for true travel duty.
  • Can I use this for flower too?
    Technically, if you had a compatible 14mm female bowl, you could, but the design really shines with concentrates. Most people keep this as a dedicated oil rig and use a separate piece with a bowl or even one of our silicone pipes for flower.
  • How do I keep the marble and color lip from getting gross?
    Try not to overfill the rig with water so it doesn’t splash up onto the lip. A quick wipe with a soft cloth after rinsing, plus regular light cleaning instead of waiting until it’s totally caked, will keep the accents looking fresh.
  • What should I store my concentrates in to go with this rig?
    For a clean setup, keep your oils in proper nonstick or glass containers so you’re not scraping from random packaging. Matching this rig with some solid storage and packaging keeps your flavors locked in and your dab station organized.

The 7" Silicone Window Bottle w/ Cat Eye Rig is a compact dab rig built for clumsy hands, couch seshes, and anyone who wants glass function with silicone-level durability. A glass bottle sits inside a protective silicone shell, so you get clean flavor without stressing every time it tips over. The 14mm male joint with a 45° banger placement keeps your hits comfortable while that cat eye marble gives the whole piece a little personality.

Key Benefits

  • Way less stress about drops — The glass chamber is wrapped in a silicone body that helps soak up bumps and knocks so you’re not explaining broken glass to your roommate.
  • Clean glass flavor, travel-ready body — You still rip from glass on the inside, but the silicone armor makes it much more bag- and backpack-friendly.
  • Comfortable 45° angle — The 45° joint makes it easy to see what you’re doing with the banger and keeps the heat away from your face and hand.
  • Cat eye focal point — The cat eye marble isn’t just for looks; it gives the rig a trippy little centerpiece that stands out on a crowded coffee table.
  • Short, stable footprint — At 7 inches (178mm), it’s small enough for tight spaces but tall enough to clear without feeling cramped.
  • Grab the color that fits your vibe — Multiple color options let you build a setup that doesn’t look like everyone else’s.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want a tough daily driver they can actually toss in a bag without panic. If you already run a few small silicone bongs and rigs and want something with glass flavor but the same no-worries energy, this hits the sweet spot. It’s especially good for folks who sesh on the couch, by the bed, or outdoors and don’t want a fragile showpiece.

How to use it

Drop your 14mm banger into the male joint and make sure it’s snug and sitting naturally at that 45° tilt. Add a little water in the glass bottle until you get the pull and chug you like — start low and adjust so you’re not getting splashback.

From there, treat it like any other compact rig: keep the rig on a stable surface, rotate the banger so you’re comfortable, and use the angled joint to keep heat aimed away from your face. Parking it on a nonstick dab mat keeps your station clean and gives the rig a little extra grip so it’s not sliding around.

After your sesh, let everything cool. The silicone is easy to handle, and the glass inside can be cleaned with a basic isopropyl soak, then rinsed and dried before you put it back in rotation.

The basics

The magic of this piece is the glass + silicone combo. The inner glass bottle does the real work for flavor and function, while the outer silicone shell is there to protect, insulate, and add grip. That means you get the smoothness and taste you expect from glass, but with a body that doesn’t feel like a disaster waiting to happen.

The 45° joint is a nice middle ground too — it’s angled enough that you can get a clear view of your banger and use directional caps comfortably, but not so steep that it feels awkward to handle. Swapping to different 14mm attachments, like other bangers or a nail, is straightforward as long as they share the same joint size and angle-friendly style.

Specifications

Height 7 inches (178mm)
Body Material Protective silicone shell with inner glass bottle
Rig Type Dab rig / oil rig
Joint Size & Gender 14mm male
Joint Angle 45°
Design Details Window bottle style with cat eye marble accent

Fit & Compatibility

The 7" Silicone Window Bottle w/ Cat Eye Rig is built around a 14mm male joint at 45°, so it plays best with 14mm female bangers designed for angled joints. If you’re upgrading your setup, it pairs nicely with most standard quartz bangers and directional caps from our wider selection of dab tools and accessories.

Care & cleaning

Let the rig and banger cool before you touch anything. You can wipe residue from the silicone exterior with a cloth, and clean the glass bottle and banger by soaking in isopropyl alcohol, then rinsing with warm water and drying fully before you use it again. Keeping on top of light cleanings will help your terps taste the way they’re supposed to.

Level up your setup

Because this is a compact rig, pairing it with a good carb cap lets you get the most out of smaller dabs without wasting anything. If you don’t already have one you love, check out our selection of carb caps that work great with 14mm bangers.

FAQ

    There isn’t a specific fill line — start with a small amount, test your pull, and add or remove water until you get smooth diffusion without water splashing up the neck. Since the chamber is compact, you won’t need much to get solid function.
  • Is it hard to clean with the silicone around the glass?
    Not at all. Let everything cool, then you can carefully access the glass for a soak in isopropyl alcohol. The silicone exterior wipes down easily. For people who like tidy stations, pairing this rig with a good set of parchment papers or liners can help keep sticky tools off your table.
  • Can I travel with this rig?
    Within legal limits and local laws, this is a solid travel piece thanks to the silicone shell and compact 7" (178mm) height. Just make sure it’s empty, clean, and well-padded in your bag, and keep your concentrates in sealed containers or storage & packaging that won’t leak.
  • Is this a good choice for a first dab rig?
    Yes. The size, protection, and simple joint setup make it beginner-friendly. It’s a nice entry piece for someone stepping up from carts or trying dabs at home without investing in a big glass showpiece right away.

The 7″ Encore Clear Footed Fixie Rig is a compact glass dab rig built for dabbers who want clean function without babying their piece. At 7 inches (178mm) tall with a 14mm 90° joint and fixed slit downstem, it’s that simple, dependable daily driver you can park on the table and forget about—until it’s time for another dab.

Why It Works

  • Stays put on the table — Footed can-style base spreads the weight out so you’re not stressing every time someone bumps the coffee table.
  • Smoother, less harsh pulls — Fixed downstem with slit perc breaks the vapor into smaller bubbles for better diffusion and cooler hits.
  • No surprise splashback — Bent neck keeps water in the rig and away from your lips, even if you pull a little harder than planned.
  • Easy, no-fuss setup — 14mm 90° joint plays nicely with standard bangers and attachments, so you can run your usual gear.
  • Clean, clear aesthetics — All-clear glass shows off the function and makes it easier to see when it’s time for a clean.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want a straightforward, glass-only setup with solid function—nothing overcomplicated, just reliable hits. It’s a sweet spot piece for people who sesh a few times a day and want something more stable than a tiny micro rig but still compact enough to live on a shelf with the rest of their smoke shop gear.

How to Use It

Fill the chamber so the water line sits just over the slits in the fixed downstem—enough to cover the perc without flooding it. That’s where you’ll feel the sweet balance of diffusion and draw resistance. From there, attach your favorite 14mm banger or nail and you’re ready to go.

The bent neck is designed so you can sit back and keep your face a little farther from the heat without worrying about water coming up the tube. Set the rig on a dab mat or pad to catch any stray drips and keep your sesh area from getting sticky.

When you’re done, let the rig cool off before you move it or clean it. For day-to-day upkeep, a quick rinse and water change goes a long way; for deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with warm water, and let it dry before your next sesh.

Height 7 inches (178mm)
Joint Size & Angle 14mm, 90°
Material Glass
Rig Style Footed can body with bent neck
Downstem Fixed downstem
Percolator Slit perc (slitted downstem)

Fit & Compatibility

The 7″ Encore Clear Footed Fixie Rig uses a 14mm 90° joint, which is the standard for a ton of bangers, dropdowns, and other dab accessories. If you already have a 14mm setup, odds are high your current quartz banger or nail will drop right in without any adapters. For people building a new kit from scratch, it pairs nicely with simple 14mm quartz buckets and directional caps from our wider selection of dab tools and accessories.

What You Get

  • 1 × 7″ Encore Clear Footed Fixie Rig (glass, fixed downstem with slit perc)

Note: Banger/nail and carb cap are not included, so you can choose the exact style you like.

FAQ

  • Does this rig come with a banger or nail?
    No, this rig ships by itself so you can choose your preferred style of quartz or other nail. Any standard 14mm male or female banger that matches the joint gender on the rig will work—if you’re still building out your kit, you can round it out with storage like heavy-bottom concentrate jars to keep your extracts fresh between dabs.
  • Is 7 inches big enough for smooth dabs?
    Yes—7 inches (178mm) is a solid “daily driver” height for a dab rig. You get enough space for the vapor to cool and for the slit perc to actually work, without the drag and bulk of a tall water pipe.
  • What joint size does it use?
    This rig has a 14mm 90° joint, which is one of the most common sizes out there. If your current dab setup uses 14mm accessories, this rig will slot into your lineup easily. For traveling or backup seshes, some people pair rigs like this with more rugged options from our silicone bongs & rigs collection.
  • How do I clean the fixed downstem and perc?
    Let the piece cool completely, empty the water, then soak the rig in isopropyl alcohol until residue loosens up. Rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry before using again. A quick rinse after each sesh helps keep the perc from clogging up so you don’t have to deep clean as often.
  • Is the footed base really more stable than a regular beaker or straight tube?
    The footed can-style base gives you a wider contact area with the table, so it’s less likely to tip compared to skinny or tall pieces. It’s especially handy if your sesh space is crowded with tools, jars, or storage and packaging gear.
  • Can I use this as a small flower bong?
    Technically, you can if you use an appropriate 14mm bowl instead of a banger. Just remember it’s designed as a dab rig, so the chamber and perc are tuned for concentrates—if flower is your main thing, you might want a piece that’s specifically built for that.
  • Is this a good option for a first dab rig?
    Absolutely. The size, simple slit perc, and 14mm 90° joint make it beginner-friendly without feeling cheap or disposable. Pair it with a basic quartz banger and a simple carb cap, and you’ve got a clean, functional starter setup that still plays nicely with more advanced gear like presses and parchment papers if you ever get into your own rosin.

  • Compact but stable — The 7" (177mm) height keeps it low-profile while still giving enough volume for comfortable function.

This mushroom rig is made for dabbers who care about both function and aesthetics: the people who like a clean, flavorful rip but still want something that actually looks cool on the coffee table. It’s a great choice if you want a smaller, easy-to-manage rig that still feels like a “real” piece of glass and not a toy. If you’re building a compact dab station, it pairs perfectly with a nonstick dab pad or mat so your banger and tools aren’t beating up the table.

How to Use It

Setup is simple: the rig has a fixed downstem with internal 3-hole perc and a recessed 14mm joint, so all you do is seat the included 14mm male 45° banger in the joint and you’re ready to go. The recessed joint helps keep the banger snug, so you’re not worrying about wobble when you’re three dabs deep and just want things to work.

The 45° angle makes it comfortable whether you’re hitting it at a desk, on the couch, or at a coffee table. The mushroom body gives a nice grip point, so it feels secure in your hand even when things are a little… “energetic” during the sesh. For concentrates, it plays really well with small, organized stashes in heavy-bottom concentrate jars so you can keep flavors separate and fresh.

Cleaning is straightforward: let everything cool, remove the banger, then rinse and shake with warm water. For deeper cleans, a soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a good rinse and full dry will keep the perc and fume work looking fresh. If you’re using this as your main rig, keeping a couple of backup bangers or tools from our broader dab tools collection nearby makes it easy to swap when one gets dirty.

FAQ

    Yes. The 3-hole perc in the fixed downstem does a solid job of breaking things up without needing a giant chamber. You get that smaller-rig flavor with enough diffusion to keep the hit comfortable.

  • What type of banger or nail can I use if I want to upgrade?

    Any standard 14mm banger in a 45° configuration will work. Just avoid anything extremely oversized or heavy, since this is a 7" (177mm) rig and it’s balanced for normal buckets rather than huge, novelty setups. If you want to round out your kit, you can match it with a directional or bubble cap from our carb caps lineup to really control airflow.

  • Is the recessed joint actually better than a regular one?

    Functionally, a recessed joint keeps the banger more protected and closer to the body of the rig. That means less leverage if it gets bumped and a cleaner look overall. It’s also nice for people who are tired of joints sticking way out and getting smacked on tight tables or crowded trays.

  • How do I clean the perc and keep the fume work looking good?

    Let the rig and banger cool fully, dump any water, then rinse with warm water. For deeper cleans, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and let it dry before using again. Avoid scraping inside the joint or perc with hard tools so you don’t scratch the glass; instead, keep the mess on your tools and accessories, which are easier to swap and clean.

  • Is this a good choice for a first "nice" rig?

    Definitely. It’s small enough to be easy to handle and store, but the made-in-USA build, fume work, and recessed joint give it that upgraded feel over entry-level imports. If you’re moving up from a super basic setup and want something you’ll be happy to keep in the rotation for a long time, this fits that lane nicely.

  • Can I travel with this rig?

Some people keep a tougher daily driver from our broader smoke shop products selection for rough travel and save this mushroom rig for home and more controlled environments.

  • Do I need anything else to get started?

    The rig and banger get you most of the way there. You’ll still want a torch, a dab tool, and something to put in the banger. Many dabbers also like to use nonstick parchment or liners from our parchment paper collection when handling sticky concentrates so less gets wasted and your table stays cleaner.

The 7.5″ Clear Single Uptake Dewar Kickback Recycler is a compact glass dab rig built for dabbers who care more about flavor and function than flashy colors. At 7.5 inches (190.5mm) tall with a 14mm 90° joint and included Dewar-style banger, it’s sized perfectly as a daily driver that still recycles hard enough to keep hits smooth and splash-free. If you want a clear piece that lets you actually watch your function instead of guessing, this is it.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The single uptake recycler pulls water up and around the rig, constantly re-filtering vapor so your throat doesn’t get cooked.
  • Way less splashback — Kickback design and carefully placed recycler loop keep water low and vapor high, so you’re not kissing the reservoir every hit.
  • Ready to rip out of the box — Comes with a 14mm 90° Dewar banger, so you don’t have to dig through your drawer for something that fits.
  • Great balance of size and function — At 7.5 inches (190.5mm), it’s big enough to cool the hit, small enough to stay flavorful and easy to store.
  • Clear glass = easy read on your hit — Watch your bubbles, see your water level, and know exactly how hard you’re pulling.
  • Comfortable “kickback” angle — The laid-back mouthpiece lets you sesh in chill positions without craning your neck over the table.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want recycler function without dealing with a huge, fragile shelf piece. It’s ideal as a daily driver for people running a few dabs a day and who like to keep their station tight and organized on a dedicated dab mat. If you’re upgrading from a basic straight-tube rig and want better cooling and less splash, this is a very natural step up.

How to Use It

The basics: fill the rig so the bottom chamber just covers the perc and a bit of the recycler pathways, then test draw to make sure you’re getting good recycling without water climbing into the neck. Less water is usually better in recyclers, since the loop will keep it moving.

Drop the included 14mm 90° Dewar banger into the joint, heat and cool it to your preferred style, then introduce your concentrate and pull steadily. As you inhale, water is pulled up the single uptake, then drains back down into the base, giving you that endless swirl and keeping vapor in contact with fresh water each time. When you’re done, park your tool and any leftover material in proper concentrate jars instead of leaving sticky stuff on the table.

If you like to switch between rigs, this one’s easy to keep in rotation: the clear glass lets you see when it’s time for a rinse, and the simple recycler pathway is way easier to keep clean than those crazy multi-arm designs.

Specifications

Height 7.5 inches (190.5mm)
Joint Size 14mm
Joint Angle 90°
Rig Type Glass dab rig / oil rig, single uptake recycler
Material Glass
Included 14mm 90° Dewar banger

Fit & Function

The 14mm 90° joint plays nice with most modern quartz bangers and accessories, so if you’ve already got a collection of 14mm quartz, you’re good to go. Just make sure any add-ons you use (like reclaim catchers or beads) are also built around a 14mm joint so you don’t have to juggle adapters. If you prefer to keep your rig safer on the couch or coffee table, pairing it with one of our tougher silicone bongs & rigs for travel and keeping this one as the at-home flavor rig is a smart move.

Cleaning & Care

Let the banger and rig cool down before you touch anything. Wipe off fresh residue from the banger while it’s still slightly warm if possible. For deeper cleans, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let everything dry completely before your next sesh. Keeping up on quick rinses will make those deep cleans way less of a chore.

FAQ

  • Does this rig come with everything I need to start dabbing?
    It comes with the glass rig itself and a 14mm 90° Dewar banger, so you just need your concentrates, a torch or heater, and a dab tool. If you don’t already have a tool you like, check out our dedicated dab tools to round out your setup.
  • Will this fit my existing quartz banger?
    If your banger is 14mm male and designed for a 90° joint, it should plug right in. Anything 10mm, 18mm, or 45° angled will either not fit or sit wrong and throw off the function.
  • Is 7.5 inches big enough for smooth hits?
    Yes — the recycler function does a lot of the cooling work here. Because the vapor is getting passed through moving water multiple times, you get smoother hits than you’d expect from a rig this compact.
  • Can I use this for flower too?
    It’s built as a dab rig, but if you have a 14mm bowl made for flower it will technically fit. Just know that recyclers are really designed with concentrates in mind, and a straightforward water pipe from our broader smoke shop products lineup will usually be better focused for flower.
  • How do I keep water from splashing into my mouth?
    Start with less water than you think, then take a test pull. You want the perc covered and the recycler loop active, but if water is climbing high into the neck, pour a little out. The kickback mouthpiece is designed to help keep water down, so once it’s dialed in, splashback should be minimal.
  • What’s the difference between this and a non-recycler rig?
    A standard rig sends vapor through water once and then straight to your mouth. This recycler keeps water and vapor moving in a loop, which can help maintain flavor, smoothness, and reduce harshness. It’s especially noticeable on slightly larger dabs or back-to-back pulls.
  • How should I store this when I’m not using it?
    Keep it somewhere stable where it won’t get knocked over — a shelf, cabinet, or padded tray works best. If you’re packing it away with other gear or extra storage & packaging supplies, make sure it’s not pressed against heavy items that could stress the glass or the recycler arm.

As you hit it, water and vapor cycle in a loop, repeatedly passing through water instead of going straight from banger to mouthpiece.

That extra circulation helps knock down heat and smooth out the pull, so even decent-sized dabs feel more controlled and less punishing. The 9″ Color Lip/Foot Double Uptake Matrix Recycler is a compact glass dab rig built for concentrate lovers who care about flavor, function, and looks in one piece. At 9 inches (229mm) tall with a 14mm, 90-degree joint, it’s an easy upgrade for anyone already running modern bangers. The double uptake recycler and matrix perc combo keeps your hits smooth, splash-free, and tasty while the colored lip and foot give it that “favorite rig” energy on the shelf.

Why It Works

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The internal matrix perc breaks up vapor into tons of tiny bubbles so the water can actually cool things down before it hits your lungs.
  • Splash-free recycling — Double uptake arms constantly pull and return water, so the rig churns without sending water up the mouthpiece.
  • Flavor over drag — Matrix diffusion is balanced, giving you clean function without turning each hit into a lung workout.
  • Stable, low-tipping design — The footed base keeps this recycler planted, even when you’re passing it around or swapping hot glass.
  • Easy to pair — Standard 14mm, 90-degree joint plays nice with most modern bangers and dropdowns you already own.
  • Compact but capable — 9 inches (229mm) is tall enough for real diffusion, but still small enough for a desk, tray, or bedside sesh station.
  • Color that actually pops — The color lip and matching foot frame the clear glass so you can watch the recycler function while it still looks intentional on display.

Best For

This double uptake matrix recycler is made for dabbers who want more function than a basic straight tube but don’t want some giant, over-complicated science project. It shines as a daily driver for people who hit concentrates regularly and care about flavor, stability, and easy pairing with 14mm bangers. If you already have a solid dab mat and like to keep a clean, dialed-in sesh station, this rig slots in perfectly.

How to Use It

Set the rig on a flat surface and fill from the mouthpiece or joint until the matrix perc is just covered and the recycler arms have enough water to cycle without spitting. Too much water and you’ll get gurgle and drag; too little and the recycler won’t really “spin” during your pull.

Attach your favorite 14mm banger to the 90-degree joint and heat as you normally would. Once things have cooled to your preferred temp, load your dab and pull steadily — you’ll see the matrix perc fire first, then water and vapor will travel up through the double uptake arms and drain back down as you hit it. For flavor-heavy dabs, pair it with a good carb cap from our carb caps collection so you can control airflow and keep vapor moving through the matrix instead of just straight up the neck.

When you’re done, let the rig and banger cool before you move anything. For day-to-day upkeep, swap the water regularly and give the rig a quick rinse so reclaim doesn’t build up in the perc and recycler arms. If you like running multiple flavors, keeping a clean recycler like this helps you actually taste the difference instead of just “hot and harsh.” Stash your concentrates in proper concentrate jars between seshes to keep that terp profile fresh.

The Function Breakdown

The heart of this rig is the matrix perc: a cylindrical grid of slits/holes that takes incoming vapor and smashes it through tons of tiny openings. That turbulence is what creates those stacks of small bubbles you see, which means more surface contact with water and smoother pulls for you.

From there, the double uptake recycler takes over. As you pull, water is drawn up through twin arms, carrying vapor with it in a looping path before it returns back down into the main chamber. That constant motion keeps everything cooler, reduces hot spots, and helps trap any little splash so it doesn’t tag you in the mouth mid-hit. It’s a noticeable difference from a basic beaker or straight tube — especially when you’re a few dabs deep and just want everything to hit clean and predictable.

The stable footed base gives you a good landing zone for hot accessories, but if you’re the type to spread tools, pearls, and caps everywhere, a small tray or some extra accessories like tool stands and holders will help keep chaos to a minimum.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig cool completely before you do anything with it. Dump the old water, give it a warm rinse, and for deeper cleans, add isopropyl alcohol, plug the openings, shake gently, then rinse with clean water and let it dry before reuse. Keeping the matrix perc and recycler arms clear makes a big difference in both function and flavor.

If you’re in heavy rotation and cleaning often, pairing this rig with durable, easy-wash pieces like our silicone bongs & rigs as backups can help you rotate gear instead of rushing a deep clean right before a sesh.

  • Q: How much water should I put in the recycler?

    Fill until the matrix perc is covered and you see water cycling through the double uptake arms when you pull, but not so high that it runs up into the neck. You can fine-tune by adding or removing a little water until it feels right for your pull strength.
  • Q: What’s the advantage of a double uptake recycler vs a regular rig?

    The double uptake keeps water and vapor moving in a loop instead of just bubbling in place. That extra circulation helps with cooling, reduces splash, and can make hits feel smoother and more consistent across back-to-back dabs compared to a simple perc-only piece.
  • Q: How do I clean the matrix perc and recycler arms?

    Empty the rig, add isopropyl alcohol (and a bit of coarse salt if you like), plug the openings, and gently shake so the solution can move through the perc and arms. Rinse well with warm water afterward and let it dry completely before using it again.
  • Q: What accessories do you recommend with this rig?

  • Q: Can I use this with flower or is it only for dabs?

Just know that heavy flower use will gunk up the perc faster and can mute flavor for concentrates, so most people keep a recycler like this dedicated to oils and use another piece or even silicone pipes for dry herb.

  • Works with your existing setup — The 14mm female joint plays nice with most standard bangers and dropdowns you probably already own.
  • Built to be used, not just stared at — Thick glass gives it some real-world durability when it’s living on a busy coffee table.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who care as much about function as they do about the look of their glass. If you’re running a couple seshes a night and want something that stacks bubbles, cools things down, and still looks like a centerpiece, this fits right in. It pairs especially well with a dedicated dab mat so your new showpiece isn’t sitting in puddles of reclaim and tools.

How to Use It

Day to day, this rig works like any solid Fab-style dab rig: add a bit of water to cover the perc, keep it below the neck, and let the lighthouse chamber do the rest. As you pull, the vapor and water cycle through the internal passages and Fab cutouts, creating that choppy stack of bubbles that does the heavy lifting on cooling and smoothing.

The 14mm female joint is ready for your favorite quartz banger or nail setup. For more control, pair it with a good carb cap so you can really feel the airflow dance through the lighthouse and Fab sections instead of just flooding the chamber. If you like to swap between different banger styles, this piece is a nice “hub” for your collection because that standard joint size gives you a ton of flexibility.

When you’re done, let everything cool off before you move or clean it. If you’re pressing or handling your own rosin, you’ll get the best flavor out of this rig when you’re loading clean, fresh dabs straight from proper parchment paper or liners rather than scraping old material.

Joint Size 14mm female
Material Glass
Design Style Fab Lighthouse, two-tone coloration

Fit & Compatibility

The 9" Encore Two-Tone Fab Lighthouse Rig uses a 14mm female joint, which is one of the most common sizes in the dab world. That means it plays well with most standard quartz bangers, dropdowns, reclaim catchers, and adapters you see in typical smoke shop setups. Just match it with a 14mm male banger and you’re set.

Care & Cleaning

To keep that two-tone glass popping and the rig tasting right, give it regular quick rinses with warm water and change the water often. When it starts to look hazy or reclaim builds up inside the Fab cutouts, let it cool completely, then soak or rinse with isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let it dry before the next sesh. A clean lighthouse chamber not only looks way better, it also helps the bubbles stack higher and smoother.

FAQ

  • What size banger do I need for this rig?
    You’ll want a 14mm male banger to match the 14mm female joint on the rig. As long as the banger joint is 14mm male, it should fit right in and seal properly.
  • Is 9 inches big enough to use as a main dab rig?
    Yes. 9 inches (229mm) is a sweet spot for a daily driver dab rig — big enough for good cooling and comfortable pulls, but still compact and easy to handle. If you’re already using small recyclers or mini rigs, this will feel very natural.
  • Does the Fab lighthouse design really change the hit?
    It does. The Fab-style cutouts and lighthouse chamber add extra pathways for vapor and water to move through, which increases surface contact and cooling. You’ll notice smoother hits and a different bubble pattern compared to a plain straight-tube or beaker.
  • How do I keep the Fab sections from clogging with reclaim?
    Frequent water changes and light rinses go a long way. When it starts to gunk up, let everything cool, then use isopropyl alcohol to loosen the buildup, rinse it out, and let it dry. Storing your concentrates properly in sealed concentrate jars can also help cut down on random debris and residue getting into the rig.
  • Will this fit into my current dab station setup?
    Most likely. The footprint is compact, and that 9" height works well on desks, trays, and shelves. If you’re already running other rigs or nectar collectors, this slots in as a more “showpiece” option without demanding a ton of space.
  • Can I travel with this rig?
    You can, but treat it like any nice glass. Empty all the water, pack it in padding or a case, and keep it away from loose heavy items. If you want something more tossable for on-the-go, you might grab a backup from our more rugged silicone pipes lineup and save the lighthouse rig for home.
  • How often should I deep clean it?
    That depends how hard you’re running it, but a quick rule: if the water looks cloudy, the glass is hazy, or the flavor drops off, it’s time. A simple alcohol soak, rinse, and dry will usually bring the clarity and function back without much effort.

At 9 inches (229mm) tall with a 14mm 90° female joint and included banger, it’s tuned for smooth, flavorful dabs right out of the box. If you love watching water whirl around while still getting dense, cooled hits, this Monark piece is the kind of rig that can easily become your daily driver.

What You Get Out of It

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — Double uptake recycler and 3-hole puck perc work together to break up vapor and keep it from feeling harsh.
  • Less splash, more flavor — The single drain tube and wormhole-style barrel keep water cycling where it should be, not in your mouth.
  • Built to be ripped, not babied — A bridged joint reinforces the connection so it’s less likely to snap if it gets bumped during a late-night sesh.
  • Eye-catching half-color style — Colored lips, inner barrel, uptakes, and more give it that “what rig is that?” look on the table.
  • Ready to dab out of the box — Ships with a 14mm 90° banger, so you don’t have to hunt for a nail just to take your first rip.
  • Efficient diffusion without drag — The 3-hole puck perc and dual downstems stack bubbles quickly without turning your pull into a workout.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers running a few solid seshes a day who want recycler function without going into giant, overly complex lab-glass territory. If you like to sit at a clean, dialed-in station with a solid dab mat and a couple of favorite tools instead of a cluttered spread of random pieces, this Monark fits right in. It also hits the sweet spot for anyone upgrading from a basic beaker or tiny rig and wanting their first “nice” recycler that actually delivers on function, not just looks.

How to Use It

Fill the recycler so the 3-hole puck perc and the bottom of the barrel are just covered in water; you want enough for active chug without sending it up the neck. Because of the double uptake design, a modest water level is usually all it takes to get that satisfying whirl in the upper chamber.

Drop your concentrates into the included 14mm banger, start your pull, and watch the recycler do its thing: water and vapor move up the dual uptakes, roll through the barrel section, then drain smoothly back down the return. Running it on a stable surface or next to a padded surface like a silicone bong or rig helps protect it when you’re passing it around or setting it down between dabs.

When you’re done, let the banger cool before you handle it. Regular quick rinses keep the recycler pathways from clogging so the function stays snappy and the drain stays crisp instead of sluggish.

Height 9 inches (229mm)
Material Glass
Rig Type Dab rig / recycler
Joint Size 14mm female
Joint Angle 90°

Function & Design Details

The heart of this piece is the 3-hole puck perc sitting at the base. Those three holes kick off tight, stacked bubbles that start cooling and diffusing your vapor before it heads into the recycler section. From there, dual downstems and a double uptake system send water and vapor up into the barrel, where you get that classic recycler “waterfall” effect that people love to watch.

The wormhole-style barrel isn’t just for show — it adds a bit more path length and churn to the vapor, which helps with cooling and gives you that smoother feel on the lungs. Meanwhile, the single drain is tuned to clear water quickly back to the base, so hits feel continuous and rhythmic instead of choppy or chuggy.

Monark’s half-color touches on the lip, barrel, and uptakes make it easy to match to your other glass or to a favorite set of dab tools. It’s the kind of rig that looks intentional on your desk or coffee table instead of just “some random piece.”

Care & Maintenance

For day-to-day upkeep, empty the water after your sesh and give it a quick warm-water rinse. Let the rig cool before cleaning the banger or moving it around too much. For a deeper clean, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with warm water, and let it dry fully before you reset your station.

If you’re rotating a few different strains or textures, keeping your different concentrates in labeled concentrate jars can help keep flavor sharp and prevent extra reclaim buildup in the rig.

FAQ

  • Does this rig come with everything I need to start dabbing?

    It comes with the rig itself and a 14mm 90° banger, so you’re set on the main hardware. You’ll still want your own carb cap, dab tool, and a heat source. A lot of people keep everything together on a single, easy-to-clean work surface by pairing it with one of our dab-friendly accessories.

  • Will it work with my existing quartz bangers?

    As long as your banger is a 14mm male with a 90° angle, it will plug right in. If you’re currently using 45° or 10mm/18mm joints on other rigs, you’ll need a properly sized 14mm 90° banger to match this Monark recycler.

  • Can I use it for flower with a bowl instead of dabs?

    Technically, yes — any 14mm male flower slide will fit the joint — but the design is really tuned for concentrates. If you mostly smoke flower, you might want to grab a piece that’s built for bowls from our broader smoke shop products collection and keep this one as your dedicated oil rig.

  • What’s the easiest way to keep the recycler from getting clogged?

    Swap the water often, avoid overfilling it, and give it a warm-water rinse once you’re done for the day. If the uptakes or drain start to slow down, a quick isopropyl alcohol soak followed by a good rinse will usually bring the function back to like-new.

  • Is the bridged joint really that important?

    For recyclers, yes. That extra glass support takes stress off the joint when you’re moving the rig or adjusting the banger. It’s one of those details that matters when you’re three dabs deep and not trying to explain a broken joint to your roommate — especially if you’re storing the piece alongside other glass and storage gear.

  • How does this compare to a simple straight-tube rig?

    A straight tube will usually give you a more direct, snappy hit with less water movement. This Monark recycler is all about smoothness and flavor — more water action, more cooling, and a longer vapor path. If you’re sensitive to harsh hits or just love watching function, the recycler design will feel like a serious upgrade.

  • Is 9 inches big enough for a main rig, or is this more of a travel piece?

    At 9 inches (229mm), it’s right in the sweet spot for a main home rig — stable, easy to hold, and big enough for solid pulls without taking over your table. It’s not tiny, but it’s still compact enough to tuck away in a case or padded bag next to things like mylar bags or other storage when you need to be discreet.

This tool is designed to be that one piece you always reach for instead of the random freebies in the drawer.   • How should I clean and care for the stainless steel?
    Let the tool fully cool, then wipe off any residue with a cloth or paper towel. For deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with water, and dry completely before your next sesh so it stays looking clean and shiny.
  • Will this rust or wear out over time?
    Stainless steel is built for regular use and cleaning. As long as you dry it after soaking or rinsing and don’t leave it sitting in harsh chemicals for long stretches, it should stay solid for years.
  • Is this overkill if I only dab occasionally?
    Not at all. If anything, a solid stainless tool is even better for occasional dabbers because you don’t have to baby it. Toss it in your kit with a rig or even a simple nectar collector, and it’ll be ready whenever you are.
  • How is this different from glass or ceramic dab tools?
    Compared to glass or ceramic dabbers, this stainless tool is way harder to break, more forgiving when you drop it, and easier to clean aggressively. If “whoops” moments happen a lot in your seshes, metal is the safer bet.

The 5" Cactus Nectar Straw is a compact glass nectar collector built for dabbers who want fun, functional gear that actually hits. The sculpted cactus body keeps things grippy and eye-catching, while the 14mm stainless steel tip gives you sturdy, consistent contact with your concentrates. At just 5 inches (127mm), it’s a perfect grab-and-go straw that still feels solid in the hand.

Why You’ll Like It

  • Easy, one-hand control — The 5-inch (127mm) length and cactus bumps give you a comfortable grip, even when your hands aren’t perfectly steady.
  • Ready out of the box — Comes with a 14mm stainless steel tip, so you don’t have to hunt for a separate nail to get started.
  • Less chance of losing parts — The included plastic clip helps keep the tip and body locked together when you’re not using it.
  • Stands out from the crowd — Sculpted cactus design makes this more than just another straight tube in the drawer.
  • Small but sturdy — Glass body with a metal tip gives you durability without turning it into a heavy brick.

Best For

This piece is made for dabbers who like to keep it simple but still want their gear to have personality. If you’re the person who brings their own straw to a friend’s place, or you want something more compact than a full rig but nicer than a disposable, this cactus fits right in. It also plays well as a backup or travel-friendly sidekick to your main setup, especially if you already rock other fun designs in your smoke shop gear collection.

How to Use It

The Cactus Nectar Straw works like any classic nectar collector: glass body to pull through, metal tip on one end, you on the other. Warm the stainless steel end, tap into your concentrate, and you’re off — no big water piece, no complicated setup, just you and your favorite extracts.

For best results and fewer messes, keep your concentrates in a low, open container so the tip can make clean contact rather than digging. A sturdy nonstick surface like a dab mat underneath your jars or containers helps catch any stray drips and protects your table from heat.

When you’re done and everything has cooled, detach the tip if you like, pop the clip back on, and stash it somewhere safe. Pair it with a few small concentrate jars and you’ve basically got a full micro dab station that fits in a backpack pocket.

Specifications

Category Nectar collector / nectar straw
Design Sculpted cactus glass body
Overall Length 5 inches (127mm)
Body Material Glass
Tip Material Stainless steel
Tip Size 14mm
Included Accessory Plastic retaining clip

Fit & Compatibility

The 14mm stainless steel tip is a straightforward, no-drama setup for most concentrates. You don’t need a matching joint or adapter on a rig — just a heat source and a stable dish, pad, or jar. If you already use other compact options like nectar collectors and straws, this cactus will feel instantly familiar in terms of function.

Care & Cleaning

Let the stainless tip fully cool before you touch or clean it. Once it’s at room temp, wipe off any obvious residue. For a deeper refresh, you can soak the glass body and metal tip in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let everything dry completely before clipping it back together. Keeping it clean not only looks better, it also helps your terps taste like they should.

FAQ

  • How big is the Cactus Nectar Straw really?
    It measures about 5 inches (127mm) from end to end. That’s long enough to keep your face comfortably away from the hot tip, but still compact enough to toss in a small case or stash box.
  • Is the stainless steel tip removable?
    Yes, the 14mm stainless steel tip can be removed from the glass body. The included plastic clip helps lock everything together, especially when you’re storing or moving it around, so you’re not chasing loose parts across the table.
  • Do I need a rig or water pipe to use this?
    No rig required — this is a standalone nectar straw. All you need is a heat source and your concentrates in a stable dish or on a nonstick surface. If you prefer a full water piece for some seshes and a straw for others, you can always rotate it with your favorite silicone bongs and rigs.
  • How should I store it when I’m not using it?
    Let the tip cool completely, clip it in place, and keep the whole straw in a padded case, drawer, or stash box where it won’t roll off or get crushed. If you keep your concentrates in dedicated storage and packaging containers, it’s smart to store the straw right alongside them so your whole dab setup is easy to grab.
  • What’s the best way to keep it tasting clean?
    Regular light cleaning goes a long way. Wipe down the tip after use once it’s cooled, and give the glass body and steel tip an occasional soak in isopropyl alcohol when you notice buildup. Rinse thoroughly and let dry before using again so your next dab tastes fresh instead of reheated.
  • Will this work with different types of concentrates?
    Yes, the stainless steel tip and simple contact-style design work well with most common concentrate consistencies. Just make sure your material is in a stable, heat-safe container — pairing it with quality parchment or liners under your jars or dishes can help keep your work surface clean.
  • Is this a good daily driver or more of a fun side piece?
    It can absolutely be a daily driver if you like nectar straws for most of your dabs. The cactus design just adds some personality. A lot of people keep something like this as a quick-hit option next to their main rig, so they can choose between full water-filtered pulls and fast, direct hits depending on the mood.

Why it works

They’re a clean match for both glass and silicone nectar bodies, and they make a solid backup option if you’re already running other 14mm tips from our broader smoke shop products lineup.

FAQ

    If your collector has a 14mm joint designed for interchangeable tips, you’re good to go. Just slide the titanium tip into the joint and secure it with one of the included clips. If your setup is a different size or a fixed tip design, these won’t be compatible.
  • Do the clips really hold the tip tight enough?
    Yes. The carved maria rings on the titanium give the plastic clips a place to “bite,” so once you snap them on, the joint feels solid. That extra grip is what keeps the tip from loosening when things heat up.
  • How should I clean these titanium tips?
    Let the tip cool completely, then wipe off any visible residue. When it needs a deeper clean, soak the metal portion in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with water, and dry fully before using again. Keep the plastic clips out of harsh solvents and just wipe or rinse them as needed.

    As long as the silicone body has a 14mm joint for a removable tip, these will work fine. Just be sure the tip is fully seated and clipped before you heat it, and set your collector down on a safe surface like a heat-safe accessory or pad when it’s hot.
  • Why choose titanium over glass tips?
    Titanium handles drops, heat cycles, and travel a lot better than glass. It’s tougher, less likely to crack, and ideal if you’re clumsy, on the go, or just tired of replacing fragile tips. Many dabbers keep titanium as their reliable daily driver and save glass for when they’re feeling fancy.

An electric nectar collector (electric dab straw) combines the benefits of a dab pen and a nectar collector. It comprises a heating element, usually a ceramic or quartz tip, a battery, and a mouthpiece.

The battery heats the tip to a specific temperature, which will reach a high in a few seconds. Thus, you can vaporize your concentrates and inhale the vapor almost instantly.

Why You’ll Actually Use This

The twisted design on the tip helps you land right where you want on your concentrates instead of slipping around the dish.

Set your piece down on a dab mat or pad between hits to keep sticky residue off your table and to give the tip a safe place to cool. When you’re done, a quick wipe while it’s cool keeps buildup from turning into a scrub job later.

The Basics

This is a straightforward glass nectar straw: one continuous piece, no removable parts, no water section — just clean, simple function. That makes it ideal for dabbers who want a grab-and-go option that doesn’t need a whole ritual.

If you keep different flavors or consistencies of concentrates around, tossing them into proper concentrate jars makes it easier to tap the twisted tip into the dish without wasting product or chasing it around parchment.

  • Can I travel with this nectar collector?

    It’s definitely travel-friendly in size, but remember it’s still glass, so treat it like any other glass piece — use a padded pouch or case, and keep it separate from heavy items so it doesn’t get crushed alongside the rest of your smoke shop gear.

  • What’s the point of the twisted tip?

    The twisted tip gives you a bit of extra feel and control when you’re touching down on your concentrates. It helps keep the contact point precise instead of sliding around on a totally smooth edge.

  • Does it work with thick or runny concentrates?

    It handles both — just make sure your material is in a stable dish or container so you can touch the tip where you want. Using proper parchment or liners from our parchment paper lineup under your dish can help keep sticky messes off your table.

  • How do I keep the flavor fresh over time?

    Keep the tip clean, avoid letting residue build up inside the straw, and store your concentrates in sealed glass like our heavy-bottom glass jars & extract packaging. Clean glass plus tight storage goes a long way toward keeping terps happy.

  • Is this better than using a full dab rig?

    It’s different, not necessarily better or worse. Rigs shine when you want water filtration and longer seshes; a nectar collector like this wins for speed, portability, and minimal setup. A lot of dabbers keep both and pick based on the kind of sesh they’re in the mood for.
