The 6.5″ Clear One Piece Honeycomb Nectar Straw is a compact, no-nonsense glass dab straw built for people who want quick, flavorful hits without hauling around a whole rig. At 6.5 inches (165mm), it’s long enough to stay comfortable away from the heat, but still small enough to stash easily. The built-in honeycomb disc acts like a splash guard, keeping hot oil where it belongs so you just get clean, tasty vapor.

Why You’ll Actually Use This All the Time

  • Way less splashback — The honeycomb disc acts as a barrier so you’re not catching hot concentrate in your mouth mid-sesh.
  • Grab-and-go dabs — One solid piece of glass means no joints, no clips, no water, just heat the tip and you’re on.
  • Smoother pulls — The flared mouthpiece feels better on your lips and helps you get a solid draw without fighting for airflow.
  • Travel-friendly size — At 6.5 inches (165mm), it fits easily in most cases or smell-proof pouches without feeling tiny in the hand.
  • Simple to keep clean — Straight, one-piece design makes it easy to soak, rinse, and get back to clear glass again.
  • Affordable daily driver — Priced at $13.99, it’s a solid upgrade from cheap throwaway straws without feeling like a museum piece.

Best For

This piece is made for dabbers who like the nectar collector style but don’t want to mess with multiple parts, water chambers, or fragile add-ons. It’s especially clutch if you’re running small to medium dabs straight from your dish, or if you want a dedicated travel straw you’re not scared to toss in a bag. Pair it with a nonstick dab mat and you’ve basically got a full mobile dab station.

How to use it

The beauty of a one-piece nectar straw is how straightforward it is. You heat the tip, touch it to your concentrate, and pull through the mouthpiece — there’s no water to fill, no awkward angles to line up. The honeycomb disc sits between the tip and the mouthpiece, acting as a splash guard so any hot oil that pops stays on the business end instead of shooting toward your face.

For comfort, hold it like a thick pen, keeping your fingers well away from the heated tip. Set your concentrates in a small glass or silicone container so you can gently touch the hot end to the material without scraping or digging. If you like to keep your flavors organized, using separate containers or concentrate jars for different strains makes this style of dabbing feel really clean and intentional.

When you’re done, let the straw cool before handling the tip. Once it’s back to room temp, wipe off any visible residue. For deeper cleaning, soak the straw in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry completely before your next sesh.

The basics

This is a straight, clear glass nectar straw with a honeycomb-style disc built right into the neck. That disc doesn’t just look cool — the multiple small holes break up any splash and help keep your pulls more controlled. Because it’s all one piece, there’s nothing to misplace, and no metal joints or silicone seals to wear out over time.

At 6.5 inches (165mm), it hits a sweet spot between control and comfort. Shorter straws can feel a little too close to the heat, while really long ones get awkward to aim. This length is easy to maneuver over your concentrates without feeling like you’re wielding a wand across the table. If you’re the type who likes to keep things minimal but still functional, it’s exactly that energy.

Specifications

Product Type Nectar collector straw
Length 6.5 inches (165mm)
Material Glass
Design One-piece glass body with integrated honeycomb disc splash guard
Mouthpiece Flared for comfort
Color Clear
Price $13.99

Fit & Compatibility

Because this is a standalone nectar straw, there’s nothing you need to “fit” in terms of joints or adapters — it plays nice with whatever small glass or silicone dish you already use for your concentrates. If you like to keep your dab space tidy and your gear protected, tossing it in with your other travel-ready smoke shop accessories makes it easy to grab in a rush.

Care & Cleaning Tips

To keep flavor clean and glass clear, don’t let residue build up forever. Let the straw cool after use, then wipe the tip and inside edge with a cotton swab or cloth to catch fresh reclaim before it hardens up. When it’s time for a reset, soak the whole straw in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry before putting it back into your case or using it again.

If you like to keep sticky messes off the table altogether, parking this straw on a dedicated accessory stand or tray between hits helps avoid rolling, clinking, or surprise tip burns on the coffee table.

FAQ

  • Is 6.5 inches long enough, or will I feel too close to the heat?

    6.5 inches (165mm) is a comfortable length for most dabbers — your hand stays well behind the heated tip, and the flared mouthpiece gives you a good grip point. As long as you’re only heating the very end of the straw, you won’t feel like you’re getting cooked during normal use.

  • Does the honeycomb disc actually make a difference?

    Yes. The honeycomb disc acts as a physical barrier between the hot tip and your mouth, so if your concentrate bubbles or pops, that splash gets broken up and slowed down. You still get direct, flavorful hits, just with less risk of hot oil making it all the way through.

  • Can I use this with any type of concentrate?

    You can run pretty much any standard dab-able concentrate with this style of straw — shatter, wax, crumble, rosin, etc. Just place your material in a heat-safe dish, like a small glass tray or one of your glass concentrate jars, and work from there.

  • How do I travel with it without breaking it?

    Because it’s glass, you’ll want a bit of protection. A padded pouch, hard case, or even wrapping it in a soft cloth and tucking it into a small bag works well. For people who are rough on gear, pairing it with tougher pieces like silicone rigs and bongs can help build a travel kit that can actually survive the trip.

  • How often should I clean it?

    That depends how picky you are about flavor. If you’re dabbing daily, a quick wipe after each sesh and a deeper soak every few days keeps it clear and tasting fresh. If you ever notice airflow getting restricted, that’s your sign to give it a proper soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and dry.

  • Is this better than using a full dab rig?

    They’re just different tools. A full rig with a banger and carb cap gives you water filtration and more dialing-in options, while this straw wins on speed, simplicity, and portability. A lot of people keep both — a rig at home, and a nectar straw like this for quick hits or travel. If you end up wanting a more traditional setup later, you can always add on a dedicated nectar collector kit or full rig to your lineup.

  • Can I use this on a workbench or press station?

    Definitely. If you’re pressing or handling rosin, it’s an easy way to taste-test small amounts without bringing out your whole glass collection. Just keep it parked on a heat-safe surface or rosin work area and make sure it’s cooled before you set it near any tools or materials.

The 3.5″ Color Reclaim Nectar Straw is a super-compact glass dab straw built for people who like simple, no-fuss hits with minimal waste. At just 3.5 inches (89mm), it’s small enough to pocket but still has a real quartz tip for clean flavor and a built-in reclaim section to catch leftovers. If you’re the type who likes quick dabs without hauling a full rig, this is the kind of piece that actually gets used every day.

Why You’ll Reach For It

  • Save your leftovers — Internal reclaim chamber catches extra oil so it doesn’t run all over your table or get wasted.
  • Flavor that isn’t cooked — Solid quartz tip keeps the taste clean and neutral instead of adding that hot-metal funk.
  • Tiny but tough — Thick, full-color glass body is compact enough for a travel kit but built to handle real-world use.
  • No surprise disconnects — Included clip locks the quartz tip to the body so it doesn’t wiggle loose mid-sesh.
  • Built-in staging spot — Silicone puck gives you a nonstick place to park your concentrates between pulls.
  • Pocket-friendly — 3.5 inches (89mm) means it fits in small cases, smell-proof pouches, or even that random hoodie pocket.

Best For

This little reclaim straw is made for dabbers who want the feel of a direct hit without committing to a whole rig and banger every time. It’s a great backup to keep next to your main silicone bongs and rigs, or as a dedicated on-the-go piece when you don’t want to risk traveling with your expensive glass.

How to Use It

The 3.5″ Color Reclaim Nectar Straw works like any classic dab straw, just with a reclaim section and a quartz tip upgrade. Attach the quartz tip to the body, secure it with the clip, and you’re ready to heat and go once everything is seated firmly.

Set your piece down on a nonstick surface like a dab mat so your tip and reclaim chamber aren’t picking up dirt or ash from the table. Load your concentrate into the included silicone puck (or your favorite dish), warm the quartz tip with your torch, let it cool briefly, then tap into your concentrate while pulling from the mouthpiece. The reclaim area will catch any extra oil that runs back instead of letting it drip out the front or back into your dish.

When you’re done, let the tip fully cool before handling or packing it away. The reclaim chamber will slowly build up with use, which you can clean out when it gets gunked up, or save depending on how you like to run your setup.

Specifications

Overall Length 3.5 inches (89mm)
Body Material Full-color glass
Tip Material Quartz

Included Accessories Quartz tip, clip, silicone puck

Fit, Flow & Real-World Use

Because it’s short and stiff, this straw is easy to control over your dish without feeling like you’re waving a wand around. The quartz tip gives you a tighter, more focused contact point, which is great when you’re working with smaller amounts and want to be precise.

It also plays nice with most standard dab tool setups, so you can use the silicone puck alongside your favorite dab tools and dabbers instead of digging straight out of jars. The reclaim function makes it especially solid as a daily driver for people who hate seeing oil go to waste on the table or in random cotton swabs.

Care & Cleaning

Keep it simple: let the straw and tip cool all the way down, then wipe off any visible residue from the quartz tip and mouthpiece. For a deeper reset, disassemble the tip from the body, soak the glass and quartz parts in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and allow everything to dry fully before putting it back together.

If you’re saving reclaim, you can carefully warm the body just enough to loosen it and collect it with a tool, then store it in one of your preferred concentrate jars for later.

What’s Included

  • 1 × Quartz tip

FAQ

How big is this compared to a normal nectar collector?

At 3.5 inches (89mm), this straw is shorter than most full-sized nectar collectors, which usually run closer to a small rig in length. It’s more of a pocket piece than a tabletop setup, but still has a full reclaim section and quartz tip, so you’re not sacrificing function — just saving space in your kit.

Can I use this with the same concentrates I’d put in a rig?

Yes. Anything you’d normally dab out of a banger will work with this straw — just stage it in the silicone puck or a small dish, then tap the heated quartz tip to the concentrate. If you’re handling stickier or more delicate textures, consider pairing it with proper parchment paper or liners to keep your surfaces clean and your product easy to scoop.

Does the reclaim chamber really make a difference?

It does. Without a reclaim area, anything that runs back from the hot tip either winds up in your mouthpiece or all over your table. Here, the extra oil settles in the chamber instead. You can clean it out regularly for a fresh feel, or carefully collect reclaim if that’s part of your routine.

How should I store this when I’m not using it?

Let the piece cool down completely, wipe it off, and keep it in a padded case, pouch, or drawer where it won’t get knocked around. Many people store it with their other storage and packaging gear so all their concentrate tools live in one place instead of getting lost.

What torch works with this straw?

Any standard dab torch or refillable butane torch that you’re comfortable with will work to heat the quartz tip. Just make sure you’re heating evenly and allowing it to cool slightly before touching concentrate so you’re not burning product or shocking the glass.

How often do I need to clean it?

It depends how hard you run it. If you’re dabbing all day, you’ll probably want to give the tip and mouthpiece a quick wipe every day or two, and do a full soak clean when the reclaim chamber starts looking cloudy or sticky. Light dabbers can stretch that out longer, but regular cleaning keeps the airflow smooth and the flavor fresh.

Is this better than a full nectar collector kit with a water chamber?

They’re just different tools. A full water-filtered nectar collector can offer cooler, smoother hits, but it’s bulkier and has more parts to clean and pack. This 3.5″ Color Reclaim Nectar Straw is all about quick, compact function with less to carry and fewer pieces to knock over, which makes it ideal as a travel piece or backup alongside your bigger rigs and other smoke shop essentials.

The EO VAPE (The Baker) is an electronic nectar collector built for dabbers who want rig-level hits without hauling a whole setup. It’s made for people who like quick, clean concentrate pulls straight from the jar, in the car, or between errands. With a compact 6.5 inch (165mm) body and fast electronic heating, you get on-demand vapor without a torch or messy loading.

Why It Works

  • On-demand dabs anywhere — Electronic heating means no torch, no butane, and no hunting for a lighter when you’re already in dab mode.
  • Use every last drop — Designed to sip directly from your concentrates so you can chase the corners of the jar and not waste the good stuff.
  • Pocket-sized but real power — At 6.5 inches (165mm), it’s small enough for a jacket pocket but long enough to keep heat away from your face.
  • Quick heat-up — Heats in under 10 seconds so you’re not sitting around waiting for it to catch up to you.
  • Travel-friendly charging — USB-C charging keeps it simple, so you can plug into the same cords you use for most modern devices.
  • Less gear to carry — Skip the rig, torch, and banger; this takes their place when you just want straightforward hits without a full station.

Best For

The Baker is made for dabbers who live more out of their backpack or car than at a coffee table. If you’re always dipping into jars and want something more efficient (and less sketchy) than a glass straw and a torch, this will feel like an instant upgrade. It also pairs nicely with a good nonstick dab mat if you still keep a small home base sesh setup.

How to Use It

The Baker keeps things simple: power it on, let the tip reach temp, then bring your concentrates up to the heated tip for a controlled pull. You’re tasting what’s in the jar, not what picked up dust off the table, and you don’t have to juggle a red-hot nail or spinning cap.

For the smoothest experience, keep your concentrates in proper concentrate jars so the tip has a clean surface to contact. Soft or saucy textures tend to work really well with this style of device since you can easily guide the hot tip through the material without digging or scraping.

When you’re done, let the tip cool before pocketing it or tossing it back in your bag. Treat it like any other hot dab tool — give it a little time and a quick wipe so it’s ready for the next sesh.

Product Type Electronic nectar collector
Length 6.5 inches (165mm)

Heating Time Under 10 seconds

Cleaning & Care

Let the device cool before you even think about cleaning. Once it’s cool, wipe the tip to remove any leftover residue. For a deeper reset, you can soak the removable tip in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry thoroughly before you put it back on and use it again.

Fit & Compatibility

The Baker is built to work with most common concentrate consistencies — think wax, crumble, sugar, and sauces — as long as they’re in a dish or jar with enough room for the tip. It’s especially handy with low-profile glass containers and heavier-bottom glass jars that you can hold steady while you tap around the corners.

If you like having different textures on hand, you can organize everything together with dedicated storage and packaging options, then just grab one jar and the Baker when you’re walking out the door. It behaves like any other nectar collector: the main thing is just giving it enough space to contact the material without smashing the tip into the glass.

FAQ

  • What kind of concentrates work best with The Baker?

    Most dab-ready concentrates work well — wax, budder, sugar, crumble, and similar textures. Super hard shatter can be trickier if it’s in a big chunk, but once it’s broken up or softened a bit, it’s still usable. Keeping your different strains split into labeled mylar bags or jars makes it easy to grab what works best with a nectar collector.

  • Can I dab straight from any jar?

    As long as the container opening gives the tip enough room to get in and move around without smashing into the sides, you’re good. Short, wide jars are usually the easiest, and heavy-bottom styles help you avoid tipping while you’re pulling a dab.

  • How portable is it really?

    At 6.5 inches (165mm), it’s genuinely pocketable but still big enough to feel solid in your hand. It’s a lot easier to toss this in a bag than a full rig and torch, and it makes a solid on-the-go backup even if you already have a bigger setup at home.

  • How long does the battery last?

    Battery life depends on how often and how long you’re hitting it, but it’s built to last through multiple seshes before you need to recharge. Since it uses USB-C, you can usually share chargers with your other electronics or grab one from our general smoke shop products lineup that fits your setup.

  • Do I still need a torch or rig with this?

    No torch needed — that’s the whole point of going electronic here. Some people still keep a traditional rig at home and use The Baker as their travel piece, but it can definitely stand alone as your main way to hit concentrates if you like the nectar collector style.

  • How do I keep the tip from getting gunked up?

    Try not to bury the hot tip too deep into your concentrates; just touch and pull what you need. Wipe it down after use so buildup doesn’t bake on between seshes. If you let it go too long, a quick soak and rinse brings it back.

  • Is this a good option for someone new to nectar collectors?

    Yes — it removes the whole torch and open flame part of the equation, which is what usually puts people off. If you already use glass nectar collectors and want something easier and more portable, this feels like a natural upgrade.

The 1″ Quartz Control Tower Hollow Insert is a quartz dab insert built for flavor chasers who love dialed-in, low-temp hits. Drop it into a compatible banger or slurper and the hollow tower design helps spread and hold heat more evenly, so your concentrates melt smoothly instead of flash-frying. At 1 inch (25mm), it’s sized to play nicely with typical 25mm-style setups while staying easy to handle and clean.

Why It Works

  • Stretches out your terp window — The hollow tower shape helps stabilize heat, so flavors stay rich instead of getting scorched in the first pull.
  • Smoother, more controlled vapor — Even heat distribution means concentrates melt consistently, which translates into fewer harsh, surprise rips.
  • Lets your rig do more with less — By managing how heat moves in the banger, you get more out of each dab without needing to change your whole setup.
  • Daily-driver durability — Solid quartz construction handles regular heating and cooling cycles when you’re running multiple seshes a day.
  • Easy in, easy out — The compact 1″ size and shaped profile make it simple to place, adjust, and pull for cleaning without chasing it around a hot bucket.

Best For

This insert is made for dabbers who already have a solid rig but want more control over flavor and consistency. If you’re the type who actually notices when terps fall off halfway through a dab, or you’ve been experimenting with different inserts and want something simple that just helps your setup function better, this piece belongs in your rotation. It’s also a nice upgrade if you’re building out a dedicated low-temp station alongside a reliable dab pad or mat to keep things clean.

How to Use It

Using the 1″ Quartz Control Tower Hollow Insert is straightforward: it sits inside your compatible banger or slurper and acts as a heat management piece. You heat your setup as you normally would, and the insert works in the background to smooth out how heat moves through the bucket.

Once it’s up to temp and cooled to your preferred range, load your concentrate so it contacts the heated surfaces and lets the insert do its thing, helping your material melt and vaporize steadily instead of in one aggressive burst. When you’re done, let everything cool fully before handling the insert for cleaning or storage, just like you would with your other quartz accessories or dab tools.

Specs

Material Quartz
Type Control tower hollow insert
Size 1 inch (25mm)

Fit & Compatibility

The 1″ (25mm) size is intended for use with properly sized bangers or slurpers that can physically accommodate a 25mm insert. In practice, that usually means 25mm buckets, but always double-check your gear so you’re not forcing glass-on-quartz or creating pressure points. If your setup is on the smaller side, or has a unique internal shape, this insert may not seat correctly.

Because it’s quartz, it plays well with most standard carb caps, especially styles that are designed for directional airflow or slurper-style function. Pair it with a cap that gives you good control over airflow and you’ll notice how much more consistent your pulls are. For rigs that see a lot of action, keeping everything staged near your favorite smoke shop essentials makes switching inserts in and out feel seamless.

Care & Cleaning

Let the insert cool completely before you mess with it—hot quartz and cold tools never mix well. For light cleanup, a quick wipe or swab after each sesh helps keep buildup under control.

For deeper cleans, soak the cooled insert in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and dry fully before tossing it back into your banger. If you’re rotating multiple inserts or storing flavor-specific pieces, keeping them in clean, sealed concentrate jars or similar containers can help keep dust and residue off between uses.

FAQ

  • Can I travel with this banger?

If you’re into higher-end material, you’ll notice the difference.

Why it works

  • Even spins, no effort — Two angled airflow holes and a beveled rim team up with the micro pearls to auto-spin as you pull, so your concentrate actually moves instead of pooling in one hot spot.
  • Built to take heat — Full-weld quartz construction means no weak joints or sketchy seams, just solid thermal performance you can rely on sesh after sesh.
  • Flavor-focused function — The hourglass shape keeps vapor moving and your oil in the hot zone, so you get consistent, tasty hits instead of scorched leftovers.
  • Dialed-in size — A 25mm bucket gives you room for pearls and marbles without feeling oversized or wasteful for regular-sized dabs.
  • Clean fit for caps — The beveled top helps your cap sit snug, improving seal and airflow so your pearls actually do their job.

Best for

This banger is made for dabbers who are past the basic buckets and want spinner-style function without going full science project. Slide the ONLY QUARTZ Hourglass Auto Spinner Banger into your rig’s joint and make sure the weld seats fully and cleanly — that solid, full-weld joint is designed to feel stable, not wobbly. Once it’s cooled back down after a sesh, pop off any carb or marble you’re using and wipe out leftover residue while it’s still soft. For heavier buildup, a quick soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and a full dry keeps the quartz crystal clear.     The pillar is there to move heat and concentrates around inside the banger.   7. How should I store my concentrates when using a high-end banger like this?
    For gear in this league, it makes sense to store your concentrates in clean, sealed containers that won’t add dust or mystery flavors. A lot of people pair setups like this with lab-grade packaging, such as glass from our glass jars & extract packaging, so everything from storage to the dab itself stays dialed in.

Set your rig and banger on a clean, heat-safe station like a solid dab mat so you’re not cooking your table or chasing sticky tools around. Between hits, let the banger cool down enough to safely wipe out residue so the quartz stays clear and your next dab doesn’t taste like the last one.

The 14M 90° 240MM Competition Banger is a high-performance quartz banger built for serious dabbers chasing clean flavor and dense clouds. Designed for 14mm female rigs with a 90° joint, it uses a whistle pillar, three airflow slits, and an included marble to push airflow and efficiency way past your average bucket. If you’re running long, intentional seshes and want consistent heat and terp retention from a 9.5 inch (240mm) banger, this is the upgrade piece.

Key Benefits

  • Bigger, smoother clouds — The whistle pillar and three precision slits move air through the banger instead of just across it, helping your concentrates vaporize more evenly.
  • Terps stay front and center — Quartz construction keeps flavors clean and true to the strain, with no weird aftertaste.
  • Competition-level control — The included marble and pillar combo create vortex-style airflow, so you’re not leaving puddles behind.
  • Built for heavy rotation — Pure quartz handles repeated heating and cooling during back-to-back seshes without warping or giving up.
  • Dialed for modern rigs — 14mm male joint at 90° works with most current daily-driver rigs without awkward angles or lean.
  • Looks as good as it rips — Etched design and the marble setup give it that “serious dabber” look on the table, not just basic glass.

Best For

This banger is made for dabbers who already have their setup mostly dialed and are now upgrading the last critical piece: the quartz. If you’re running multiple dabs a day, swapping flavors, and actually paying attention to how your rig functions, this is the lane you’re in. It also plays especially well with durable silicone rigs and bongs when you want a travel-friendly but still high-performance setup.

If you’re more of a “one dab every few days” person or rough on glass, this is probably overkill. But if you’re chasing consistency and you notice the difference between mid and top-tier quartz, this Competition Banger makes sense.

How to use it

Drop the 14mm male joint into any rig or water pipe with a 14mm female, 90° joint. Make sure the banger sits level so concentrates stay centered in the base instead of running to one side.

Use a proper dabber from our dab tools collection so you can keep your hands away from the hot quartz and place concentrates exactly where you want them. The marble is designed to cap the top and work with the whistle pillar and slits to push airflow; just set it in place and let the design do its thing.

Set your rig on a nonstick surface like a dab mat if you’re the type to multitask or pass the rig around the room—nobody likes reclaim all over the table. After your sesh, let the banger cool down before you touch or clean it.

For regular upkeep, a quick wipe after use goes a long way. When you want it looking fresh again, let it cool, then use a short soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with water, and dry fully before the next run.

Specifications

Material Quartz
Joint Size 14mm Male
Joint Angle 90°
Total Length 9.5 inches (240mm)
Airflow Features Three airflow slits with whistle pillar and marble

Fit & Compatibility

This banger is designed for rigs with a 14mm female joint at a 90° angle. If your piece is 14mm female and the joint sticks straight out horizontally, you’re good. If you’re on an older 45° joint or 10mm/18mm sizing, this won’t be a direct fit without an adapter.

The extended 240mm length gives you more space away from the body of the rig, which helps with heat control and keeps torches and hot quartz a little further from your face and glass. Just make sure your rig has enough clearance so the end of the banger doesn’t bump into the base or table.

What You Get

  • 1 × 14M 90° 240MM Competition Banger (quartz)
  • Integrated whistle pillar design
  • Marble included for airflow and function

Why quartz for competition-style dabs?

Quartz is the go-to for dabbers who actually care about flavor and repeatability. It heats predictably, cools in a consistent curve, and won’t add taste or color to your concentrates. That’s why serious dabbers and many comp-style setups lean heavily toward high-quality quartz instead of generic glass or mystery materials.

If you’re dialing in for rosin or premium hydrocarbon extracts, pairing good quartz with quality concentrates and proper handling tools from our rosin extraction gear helps keep your terps and textures where they should be—on your tongue, not stuck in the equipment.

Care & Cleaning

Let the banger cool down fully before touching, wiping, or soaking it—thermal shock is how pieces crack. Once it’s back to room temp, you can wipe away fresh residue with a cotton swab or cloth.

For deeper refreshes, soak the banger in isopropyl alcohol for a bit, rinse with warm water, and dry completely before reheating. Avoid scraping aggressively with metal tools, especially around the slits and pillar, so you don’t scratch or stress the quartz.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my rig?
    If your rig has a 14mm female joint at 90°, this banger will drop right in. If you’re not sure, pull the bowl or current banger and check the joint type and angle compared to other smoke shop pieces you may have for reference.

    The marble is included as part of the Competition Banger setup. It’s designed to work with the whistle pillar and slits, so keep them together for best performance.
  • Can I use any type of concentrate with this?
    Yes. It’ll handle rosin, live resin, sugar, wax, and pretty much anything you’d normally dab. Just use a proper tool and, if needed, stash the rest of your product in quality concentrate jars to keep it clean between seshes.
  • How do I clean the slits and pillar without damaging them?
    Let the banger cool, then soak in isopropyl alcohol to loosen residue. Rinse with warm water and use soft swabs or cloths—no scraping or prying—so you don’t chip the edges or scratch the quartz.
  • Is this overkill for a beginner?
    If you’re totally new to dabbing, this might be more than you need starting out, but it’s not hard to use. Think of it as buying once and not having to upgrade later. Pairing it with sturdy pieces from our accessories collection can make your whole setup feel more put-together.
  • How fragile is it compared to a standard banger?
    Quartz is tough for glass, especially at this quality level, but it’s still glass. It’ll handle heat cycling very well, but drops onto hard floors or banging it against other pieces can still crack or chip it, especially around the joint and slits.
  • What’s the benefit of the 240mm length?
    The extra length gives you a more spread-out heat zone and keeps the hot end of the banger further from your rig, hands, and face. It also creates more room to work when you’re loading dabs or using directional caps and marbles, similar to the way longer nectar collectors offer more control.

  • Good for regular upkeep, not just emergency cleans — makes it easy to keep a consistent cleaning routine instead of waiting until everything is crusted over.

Best For

This cleaner is made for:

  • Daily drivers who are tired of cloudy glass and dull flavor
  • Collectors with multiple water pipes, rigs, and bowls that need regular love
  • People who hate scrubbing down intricate percs and tight corners by hand
  • Anyone who uses their glass on a dab mat and wants the whole setup looking fresh, not just the pad
  • Smokers who like their pieces looking “new glass” clean when friends come over

How to Use It

Think of GRUNGE OFF as a soak-and-forget cleaner. You’re letting chemistry do the heavy lifting instead of your wrists. Pour enough solution into your piece to cover the dirty areas, or place smaller items in a container and fully submerge them.

Let your glass sit in the solution so it can break down the built-up residue. The dirtier the piece, the longer you’ll want to leave it soaking. When the grime has lifted, rinse everything thoroughly with warm water and let it dry completely before you load it back up. Setting your freshly cleaned piece on a clean smoke shop accessory stand or tray helps keep it spotless between seshes.

For routine care, you can use smaller amounts of solution more frequently instead of waiting for your glass to get completely wrecked. That way your percs, downstems, and mouthpieces stay clear, and you’re not embarrassed to hand your piece to a friend.

Care & Cleaning Tips

Let your glass cool down fully before adding any cleaner or liquid. After soaking with GRUNGE OFF and seeing the residue lift, rinse thoroughly with warm water until no cleaner remains, then let your piece air dry completely before using again. If you’re cleaning multiple small parts like slides or dropdowns, keep them together in a small container so you’re not chasing pieces around your sink.

Between deep cleans, storing cleaned rigs and bowls near your storage and packaging setup makes it easier to keep everything organized and ready for the next sesh.

FAQ

Is GRUNGE OFF safe for colored or worked glass?

Yes, it’s designed for glass of all types, including colored, fumed, and worked pieces. It works by soaking and loosening residue rather than scratching or scouring the surface. Just make sure you rinse thoroughly with warm water after cleaning.

Can I use this on silicone or acrylic pieces?

This cleaner is intended for glass only. For non-glass gear, check out our lineup of silicone bongs and rigs that are easy to clean with more basic methods like warm water and mild soap.

How often should I clean my glass?

If you’re a heavy smoker or dabber, cleaning every few uses keeps flavor and function on point. Light smokers can stretch it out a bit more, but once you see visible buildup in your perc or your hits start tasting stale, it’s time to give everything a soak. Keeping a consistent routine makes each clean much easier than waiting until the piece is totally caked.

Will this remove really old, baked-on buildup?

Yes, that’s what it’s made for. Extra-dirty pieces might need a longer soak or a couple of rounds with fresh solution, especially if you haven’t cleaned them in months. Pairing the soak with a simple rinse and shake after can help get any last bits out of tight corners and percs. For pieces that have been neglected for a long time, you might want to protect your work area with a sheet of parchment paper or towel while you dump and rinse.

Do I need to heat it up or mix it with anything?

No mixing, no heating, no nonsense. GRUNGE OFF comes ready to use straight from the bottle. Just pour it into or over your glass and let it soak. Heating or altering the solution isn’t recommended.

Can I reuse the cleaner after soaking a piece?

Many people do reuse it a few times, especially for lighter cleanings. Once the solution looks heavily discolored or full of debris, it’s time to replace it with fresh cleaner. If you’re bouncing between rigs, bowls, and dab gear, consider keeping your cleaner bottle next to your dab tools so you remember to give everything a quick refresh on the same day.

Is it okay for small pieces like bowls, slides, and banger attachments?

Yes, it works great on smaller glass parts. Pop them into a small glass or container, cover with GRUNGE OFF, and let them soak. This is especially nice for pieces with tight airpaths where brushes and swabs can’t reach. Afterward, rinse well and let them dry on a clean surface like one of our glass jar lids or a drying rack so they don’t pick up dust before your next sesh.

The Alpha+ Gradient Torch Display comes ready to drop on a counter, showcase shelf, or near your register as an easy add-on for anyone picking up rigs, papers, or glass jars & extract packaging. Maven branding and the color gradients do most of the selling for you—people see the finish, pick one up, click it, and it usually goes home with them.

Because they’re refillable and not throwaway torches, they fit right in at shops that carry quality accessories instead of cheap disposables. They’re also a nice upsell for anyone grabbing storage & packaging for concentrates or flower and still needs a proper heat source for their setup.

Care & basics

Let the torch cool before handling it heavily or putting it away after extended use. If the exterior picks up residue or fingerprints, just wipe it down with a soft cloth; avoid harsh abrasives that could scratch the gradient finish.

For refills, use standard butane cans with a proper torch tip. If performance ever feels weak, make sure the torch is properly filled and stored upright between uses. When it’s riding in a bag, treat it the same way you’d treat a nice piece or a pack of mylar bags—don’t crush it under a pile of heavy stuff if you want it to look fresh.

FAQ

  • Is butane included with the torches?

  • How do I refill the Maven Alpha+ safely?
    Make sure the torch is cool, turn the flame setting down, then invert it and press the butane nozzle straight into the refill valve until full. Let it rest a few minutes so any excess gas dissipates before using again. Keep open flames and sparks away while refilling.
  • Are these good for daily dabbing or just casual use?
    They’re absolutely fine as a daily driver torch for most dabbers, especially if you’re running standard rigs and bangers. If you’re doing back-to-back heavy seshes for long stretches, you might eventually want to pair them with a bigger desktop-style torch, but for normal use they’re dialed.
  • Will the head stay in place at 45° or 90°?
    Yes, the rotatable 8-point head is designed to click and hold at set positions, so you’re not fighting it mid-heat. Just make sure it’s fully clicked into place before you ignite.
  • Can I use this for things other than dabs?
    Definitely. People use these for bowls, cigars, candles, and general "I need a strong flame" situations. It’s a solid all-purpose torch to keep near your rigs, concentrate jars, or rolling tray without looking out of place.
  • Do the gradient colors in the 15-pack vary?
    Yes, the display comes with assorted gradient finishes, so your customers (or friends) can pick the colorway they vibe with instead of every torch looking identical.
  • Any tips to keep these torches working longer?
    Use decent-quality butane, don’t leave them roasting on max flame for long stretches, and let them cool between heavy use. Store them with the safety lock on and avoid dropping them on hard surfaces—same energy you’d give your favorite smoking accessories if you want them to last.

How To Use the Mini Dragon Egg?

Step 1: Unscrew the bottom bubbler and fill it about one-third full with water. Then screw the upper part back on.

Step 2: Open the magnetic flip cap, Use a dab tool to place a small amount of wax into the center of the 910 quartz dish coil. Close the flip cap.

Step 3:  Press the power button 5 times quickly to turn on the Mini Dragon Egg. The gear ligh will flash white three times and the device will vibrate once.

Step 4:  Press the power button 2 times quickly to select or cycle through the temp setting.

The gear light will show different color to Indicate the current temp setting.

Green LED:  518°F (9W)

Blue LED: 572°F (11W)

White LED: 626°F (13W)

Step 5:  Press and hold the button, while inhaling from the glass mouthpiece.

Step 6:  Press the button three times quickly to enter a 15s preheat mode.

Upon completion, the device will vibrate twice and enter the auomatic mode – you can just inhale without pressing the button.

The auomatic session lasts for 25s, and the current gear ligh will stay on.

After the timeout, The gear ligh and power light will turn off. the device will auomatically shut down after one motor vibration.

Step 7: when you have finished, press the button  five times quickly to turn off the device.

How to Clean the Lookah Mini Dragon Egg?

After each session, use a Q-tip dipped in isopropyl alcohol to wipe the 910 quartz dish coil to remove any excess wax.

After multiple uses, you need to give it a deep cleaing. Here are steps:

Step 1: Remove the 910 dish coil, bubbler, rib-shaped percolator, and glass mouthpiece from the device.

Step 2: Get a sealable container like Ziplock plastic bag, place the 910 dish coil or glass mouthpiece in it separately.

Step 3:  Fill the container with isopropyl alcohol to cover the object.  Let it Soak for 30 minutes or even more.

Step 4: Rinse each piece  thoroughly with clean water to ensure that all the  alcohol and residue is removed.

Step 5: Let all components to air dry completely before assembly.

Pro Tip: The bubbler and rib-shaped percolator is made of perspex, so don’t soak them in isopropyl alcohol as this can break down the material. You can use dish soap, warm water and a small bottle brush to clean them Instead.

The Best Electric Dab Rig Under $100

The LOOKAH Dragon Egg is a dab e-rig, with a unique design, portable size, stylish appearance, powerful functions, easy cleaning, and suitable price, making it stand out from other electric dab rigs.

LOOKAH Dragon Egg portable dab e-rigs are the next-level electric rig for dabs

Different bubbler

Dragon Egg has the rig bubbler at the bottom, this sets it apart from other products on the market which have the bubbler at the top. This genius idea not only makes it look more personal, but more importantly, is brings many advantages:

1-It makes the product compact and portable, making it easy to take on the go. It measures just 3.5 inches tall and 1.5 inches wide, making it small enough to fit in your pocket or purse.

2-It makes the water far enough away from the tip. It can hold more water without water entering your mouth. This is a big problem with other e rigs and it dramatically affects comfort, even though their bubblers are bigger, you can only fill a small amount of water because of splash back.

3-It allows the coils to be opened independently, so you don’t have to take off the bulky bubbler every time and risk breaking it.

4-It makes the airway straight, which not only makes the airflow smoother but also reduces the waste of wax and makes cleaning easier. If you’ve ever cleaned an enail dab rig with a tortuous airway you know how important ease of cleaning is, it was a nightmare.

Unique Shape

The most distinctive feature of the LOOKAH Dragon Egg dab E rig is its unique shape. As the name suggests, it is designed to resemble a dragon egg, with a rounded body and a Cool skeleton stem. This not only makes it visually appealing but also adds to its portability as it can easily fit in the palm of your hand.

Another purpose of designing the stem into a skeleton shape is to allow the device to stand up when the water cup is removed. To solve the problems of use and aesthetics at the same time, it took me several months to finally find an exciting solution for the skeleton. This is also the reason why the last product was named Dragon Egg. I swear, I like this name so much and hope you do too.

It was not my original intention to use a non-glass material for the skeleton. You know LOOKAH is good at making glass products. This is because I found that when installing it, the glass skeleton is very easy to break, which can easily scratch the user’s hands. In the end, I had no choice but to use other materials. But please rest assured, the materials we use are very safe.

Special Wax Quartz Coils

One of the most important components of any vape device is its coils. LOOKAH Dragon Egg is equipped with replaceable #C of the 710 series of quartz coils. These coils are specially developed and designed for wax, integrating LOOKAH ‘s highest technology.

710-C is a specially designed coil for products that vapor downwards. Its airway is located on one side of the coil, separate from the heating area. Compared with other cores whose airways are in the heating area, this can save more wax, because the airflow will not take away wax that is not completely atomized.

The body of 710-C is made of Nanoceramics, and its bottom heating area uses LOOKAH black technology “porous quartz”. This material has many advantages:

1-This kind of quartz hole material can absorb wax better than dense quartz and stably transfer the liquefied wax to the heating wire, getting a very good taste while producing large vapour.

2—It heats up quickly, you don’t have to wait or preheat, and it’s more convenient and easier to use. This also means the product consumes less power and will not be particularly hot during use, making it greener, energy-saving, and safe.

3- The airway can be made inside the coil. There is no need to make the airway outside the coil like other products, which leads to tortuosity of the airway, large pollution area, waste of wax, and difficulty in cleaning. Ours is smoother, more wax-efficient, and requires little to no cleanup.

4-Although the technical difficulty is much higher than that of conventional quartz and ceramics, the cost is lower, making the replacement coils cost less. It is worth mentioning that we sinter the “porous quartz” at the bottom with the ” Nanoceramics ” at the body, which is a more complex technology. So, you know, LOOKAH is not only a design company, a brand company, but also a technology company.

5-It should be noted that compared with “porous ceramics” or other porous materials, “porous quartz” will not shed powder, will not deteriorate, and is very safe for your health.

In general, the “porous quartz” material is the best technical solution we have found so far for wax atomization.

  10. As the device is heating the atomizer, you can inhale from the glass straw mouthpiece of the vape. As required, you can adjust the airflow by covering the carb on the flip cap.

The JUST THE TIP Dab Swabs 6-pack is an essentials bundle for dabbers who actually clean their gear. You get six screw-top tubs, each with 300 tightly woven cotton swabs (1,800 total), built for hitting every corner of your banger, rig, or insert so residue doesn’t have a chance to build up. One pointed tip on each swab gives you the control to chase gunk out of tight spaces instead of just smearing it around.

Why You’ll Actually Use These

  • Keep your banger tasting fresh — Pointed tips reach the edges and corners of your bucket, so yesterday’s reclaim isn’t ruining today’s flavor.
  • Less effort, more cleanup — Tightly woven cotton has better absorbency, so a couple swabs do the job instead of burning through a whole handful.
  • No fluff left behind — Firm, tight fibers mean way fewer stray threads getting stuck to hot quartz, glass, or metal.
  • Perfect for tight spaces — The slim, tapered tip gets into small joints, recycler arms, terp slurpers, and those annoying little elbows.
  • Session-friendly storage — Each tub stays closed and clean in your kit or backpack, so you’re not grabbing dusty bathroom cotton swabs mid-sesh.
  • Heavy-use ready — 1,800 total pieces means daily dabbers can stay on top of cleaning without constantly reordering.

Best For

These dab swabs are made for people who actually care about taste and function, not just clouds. If you’re running a couple dabs most nights, or sharing a rig at the homie’s house every weekend, keeping a container of these next to your rig and dab mat will make cleanup almost automatic.

They’re also clutch for anyone with more intricate setups—recyclers, multi-chamber rigs, or detailed glass pieces—where normal cotton swabs just don’t reach right.

How to Use Them

After a dab, let your banger or nail cool down until it’s warm but safe to touch. That’s the sweet spot where residue is still soft enough to wipe, but you’re not cooking the cotton. Use the pointed end of the swab to trace the inside edge of the bucket, around the bottom, and into any corners or lips where oil loves to hide.

For tough, baked-on spots, lightly dip the tip in a small amount of isopropyl alcohol before you swab, then wipe and toss when it’s saturated. Keep a little cleaning cup or tray next to your dab tools so everything you need to clean between hits is in one place.

They work just as well on glass, quartz, ceramic, silicone, and metal—so you can hit your rig joint, carb cap air holes, inserts, and even the outer walls of your piece where splashback sometimes lands. When you’re done, bag or toss your dirty swabs so you’re not leaving sticky cotton all over your table.

Specifications

Product JUST THE TIP Dab Swabs
Category Essentials & Accessories
Total Quantity 1,800 swabs (6 containers × 300 pieces)
Packaging Six individual storage containers
Tip Style Single pointed tip
Material Tightly woven cotton swabs

Fit, Surfaces & Compatibility

The pointed tips are sized for typical dab gear: they’ll fit inside most standard bangers, slurpers, and inserts, and can be angled into rig joints, recycler arms, and carb cap openings. They’re safe to use on glass, quartz, ceramic, metal, and silicone pieces, so they’re a solid match with everything from classic glass rigs to unbreakable silicone bongs and rigs.

Because the cotton is tightly woven, the tips hold together better than cheap pharmacy swabs, especially when you’re working around warm surfaces. Still, always let your gear cool to a safe temperature before cleaning and swap swabs as soon as they’re saturated.

Care & Storage Tips

Keep the containers sealed when not in use so your swabs stay clean and dry. Store them somewhere cool and away from splash or spray—ideally in the same drawer or kit as your storage and packaging so all your maintenance gear stays together.

Used swabs should be thrown away after one pass; they’re not meant to be reused. If you’re using alcohol with them, let your gear fully dry before the next use so you’re not heating any leftover liquid.

FAQ

  • Are these different from regular cotton swabs?
    Yes. The pointed tip and tighter weave make these way better for dabbing gear. Regular bathroom swabs tend to be too fluffy and round, so they smear oil around and can leave little fibers behind in your banger or rig.
  • Will the tips fit inside smaller bangers and terp slurpers?
    The tapered design works well in most standard buckets, slurpers, and small inner chambers. If your setup has extremely tiny or specialty openings, you may need to angle the swab or only use the very point of the tip to reach inside.
  • Can I use these with isopropyl alcohol?
    Definitely. A light dip in ISO helps break down tough residue and is especially handy for cleaning after hotter runs. Just avoid oversoaking the swab and let your quartz or glass dry fully before your next dab. For long-term storage after cleaning, keep your favorite concentrates in proper concentrate jars so the fresh, clean banger actually makes a difference in flavor.
  • Are they safe for silicone pieces?
    Yes, they’re safe on silicone, glass, quartz, ceramic, and metal. The cotton is soft enough that it won’t scratch your gear, making them great for detail work around joints, percs, and mouthpieces on more flexible pieces.
  • How long will 1,800 swabs last?
    It depends how often you dab and how picky you are about cleaning. Heavy daily dabbers who wipe after every use can still get months out of a bundle like this. Occasional dabbers will probably forget when they even bought them before they run out.
  • Do these come loose or in sealed containers?
    They come pre-packed in six containers with screw-on or snap-style lids, so the swabs stay clean until you need them. You can keep one container at home by your rig, toss one in your travel kit with your nectar collector, and stash the rest as backup.
  • Can I use them for anything besides dabs?
    For sure. They’re great for cleaning carb caps, vape chambers, tight corners on grinders, and even little spill spots on your desk or smoke shop gear. Anywhere you’ve got small, sticky messes, these pointed swabs are handy.

Why These Hit Different

  • Real-world impressions, not junk swag — People actually keep and use matchbooks, so your logo lives on coffee tables and in glove boxes instead of the trash.
  • Bold black-and-white branding — High-contrast black background with a white logo makes your design readable in dim rooms, bars, and lounges.

These CUSTOM MATCHES are dialed in for shops and brands that already care about presentation and want all their touchpoints to feel intentional. If you’re the type to use heavy-bottom jars or neat glass packaging instead of whatever’s cheapest, these matchbooks fit that same energy. They’re also perfect for event planners, hospitality venues, or anyone building out a cohesive brand kit for special occasions.

How to Use Them (Beyond Just Striking)

Day to day, these live best right where people are reaching for flame: next to your register, at the bar, on the coffee table, or in your lounge area. For concentrate or dab-focused spots, they still earn their keep as part of your accessory spread alongside your torches, tools, and dab pads and mats—they’re a low-cost way to keep your logo in the mix even when people are mostly torching instead of sparking.

For events, stack them in small bowls on tables or bar tops so guests can grab them naturally, the same way they’d grab a business card—but with way more staying power. What You Get Out of These

These aren’t just about having something with your name on it—they’re about building habits. Every time someone lights a candle, pre-roll, or bowl with your matchbook instead of a random lighter, your brand gets another little moment. If you’re already curating a nice lineup of smoke shop products, these matches help tie your physical space, your packaging, and your promos together into one consistent visual story.

Care, Storage & Safety Basics

Keep the sealed cases in a cool, dry place away from open flame or direct heat sources. Once they’re out on counters or tables, treat them like any other ignition source—keep them out of reach of kids, don’t leave them sitting right on top of hot equipment, and avoid tossing them in places where they might get crushed and accidentally struck.

FAQ

  5. How should I store extra cases of matches at my business?
    Keep unopened cases in a dry, room-temperature area away from direct sunlight, heat sources, or open flame. A back room, storage closet, or shelving away from your hot glass and torches is ideal.

This pendant is made for people who already geek out over glass function pieces and want something they can wear when they’re not posted up by the rig. If you’re the friend who points out heady details on everyone’s tube, this is your lane. It also pairs nicely with anyone building out a themed turtle or ocean-life collection on their shelf or alongside their favorite pieces from our broader smoke shop products lineup.

How to wear & care

The turtle comes ready to be strung on whatever you like—leather cord, chain, hemp, paracord, you name it. Just make sure the cord or chain fits comfortably through the pendant loop and you’re good to go.

Day to day, you can treat it like any solid glass pendant: avoid dropping it on hard surfaces, don’t toss it loose in a bag with keys, and you’ll be fine. When it needs a refresh, a quick wipe with a soft cloth usually brings the shine back. For deeper cleaning, use mild soap and water, then dry thoroughly before wearing again—similar to how you’d keep your favorite accessories looking fresh.

The basics

Dichroic glass is where the magic happens here. It’s a special glass that reflects and transmits different colors at the same time, so when light hits the turtle’s shell and body, you get layers of sparkle and shifting tones. In a sesh room or under sunlight, it really comes alive.

The turtle sculpt gives it more than just color: raised details catch highlights, and the curves of the shell throw little reflections that change with every angle. It looks clean from a distance and gets more interesting the closer you get—just like a good heady rig on your favorite dab mat.

Fit & style tips

At around 3 inches, this pendant sits in the “large but wearable” range. On a shorter chain it will sit high and centered as a statement piece; on a longer cord it becomes more laid-back and layered. Because it’s all glass, it has enough weight to lie flat without feeling like a brick on your neck.

If you’re building a full heady look, it plays nicely with simple tees and hoodies so the dichro can do the talking—just like how a clean tube lets a really nice banger or heady carb cap shine. If you’re curating a tray or display, it looks right at home next to your favorite concentrate jars and pocket pieces.

Why collectors like this piece

  • Artist-forward — clear Peaselburg Glass style instead of generic import vibes
  • One-of-a-kind feel — dichro layers and hand shaping mean no two turtles will ever be identical
  • Theme-friendly — perfect for ocean, animal, or nature-themed glass collections
  • Display or daily — looks just as good hanging on a wall hook or peg board as it does around your neck
  • Stacks with your other gear — it’s the kind of pendant that looks right sitting next to your favorite silicone bongs & rigs when everything’s laid out for the night

FAQs

  • Is the 3″ turtle pendant heavy to wear all day?
    It has some weight because it’s solid glass, but at about 3 inches (76mm) it’s still very wearable as a daily pendant. Most people find it feels substantial but not neck-straining; using a wider, comfortable cord or chain helps distribute the weight.
  • What kind of chain or cord should I use with it?
    Use something sturdy enough to handle a glass pendant—think leather, braided cord, or a solid metal chain. Just make sure the clasp and thickness fit through the pendant loop. If you’re already rocking lanyards or cords for tools or dab tools, anything in that range usually works well around the neck too.
  • Will the dichro colors fade or wash out over time?
    No—dichroic glass isn’t a surface paint or cheap coating. It’s part of the glass itself, so under normal wear it stays vibrant. Just avoid harsh abrasives or anything that could scratch the glass, and clean it gently when needed.
  • How should I clean the pendant safely?
    Wipe it with a soft, non-abrasive cloth to remove fingerprints and oils. For a deeper clean, use mild soap and lukewarm water, then rinse and dry completely. Treat it like you would a nice piece of glassware you keep alongside your rosin tools or parchment papers—gentle is best.
  • Can I wear this every day, or is it more of a special-occasion piece?
    You can absolutely wear it daily if you’re reasonably careful with your jewelry. Lots of people use heady pendants as their everyday piece. Just be mindful about high-impact situations—take it off before anything rough where you wouldn’t want to risk a glass piece.
  • Is each turtle exactly the same as the photos?
    Because these are handcrafted in the USA, expect small variations in color placement, dichro pattern, and sculpted details. That’s part of the appeal—each one has its own personality, like having a unique, signed piece sitting next to your favorite jars in your storage & packaging setup.
  • Is this a good gift for someone who’s into glass but not super deep into the scene?
    Yes. The turtle design is approachable and easy to love, and the dichro sparkle hits even for people who don’t know every artist’s name. For someone who’s just starting to appreciate glass, it’s a cool “first real piece of art” without needing to explain function or joint sizes like you would with a rig or nectar collector.

The 2″ Red Spiral Pendant is a hand-crafted glass pendant for people who like their accessories loud, trippy, and a little bit heady. At about 2 inches (50.8mm) tall, it’s big enough to catch light from across the room without feeling heavy on your chest. The tight red spiral pulls your eye right into the center, making it one of those pieces people keep staring at while you talk.

Why You’ll Actually Wear This

  • Instant focal point — The bold red spiral design naturally draws attention without needing a stacked chain setup.
  • Heady-glass vibes — Made from quality glass with clean lines, it feels more like a piece of art than basic jewelry.
  • Comfortable all-day — At 2 inches (50.8mm), it has presence but stays lightweight enough for daily wear.
  • Works with what you already own — The bail opening plays nice with most cords, chains, and lanyards, so you don’t need to buy a whole new setup.
  • Dresses up or down — Looks just as good with a hoodie at the sesh as it does with a button-up at a show.
  • Easy to keep clean — Glass wipes back to brand-new shine, even after living in the bottom of a bag for a bit.

Best For

This pendant is made for people who treat glass like part of their identity, not just something they smoke out of. If you’re the type who picks pieces with intention, likes a little psychedelic flavor in your look, or just wants one solid pendant that can be your daily driver, this is that piece. It also pairs nicely with low-key fits when you want one pop of color instead of a whole loud outfit.

How to Use It

Slide the 2" Red Spiral Pendant onto your favorite chain or cord — leather, metal, hemp, whatever you vibe with. The opening is sized to work with most standard necklace chains, so chances are something in your drawer will fit right through without tools or extra hardware.

If you’re the type to keep everything organized at your sesh area, you can hang or stage it alongside your rig setup on a dedicated dab mat so it doesn’t end up under a pile of tools and jars. When you’re heading out, just grab the chain, throw it on, and you’re done.

Because it’s glass, treat it like you would a nice slide or carb cap: avoid dropping it on hard floors or tossing it loose into a backpack with heavy gear. When you’re not wearing it, setting it near your other go-to smoke shop products keeps everything in one place and harder to forget on the way out the door.

Specifications

Category Pendant / Glass jewelry
Height 2 inches (50.8mm)
Primary Color Red
Design Spiral motif
Material High-quality glass

Care & Cleaning

Wipe the pendant with a soft cloth to remove fingerprints and dust. For a deeper clean, gently rinse with water or a mild soap, then dry completely before wearing again.

FAQ

  • Will this pendant fit my existing chain?
    Most likely, yes. The pendant is designed to work with typical necklace chains and cords; just slide the chain through the top opening. If your current setup is extra thick or uses big hardware, you can always swap to a simpler cord from your stash of accessories.
  • Is the glass heavy?
    It has enough weight to feel solid and high-quality in your hand, but it’s still comfortable for all-day wear around your neck. Most people forget it’s on until someone compliments it.
  • Can I wear this every day?
    Yes. As long as you’re not smashing it against hard surfaces or dropping it regularly, daily wear is totally fine. Treat it like any other nice piece of glass art and you’ll be good.
  • Is this more for casual or dressy outfits?
    Both. The clean spiral design and bright red color work with laid-back streetwear, but it also pops against a plain black tee or button-up for a slightly more dressed look. If you already like showing off custom glass or silicone pipes when people come over, this is just the wearable version of that energy.
  • How do I clean it without scratching it?
    Use a soft microfiber or t-shirt material to wipe it down. For more stubborn smudges, a quick rinse with water, then dry fully. Avoid abrasive pads or gritty cleaners so the surface stays smooth and shiny.
  • Is this a good gift piece?
    Definitely. It’s bold without being huge, and the spiral design is neutral enough to work for a lot of different styles. If you’re already grabbing some glass-safe glass jars and packaging for someone, this pendant makes an easy add-on that feels personal.
  • Can I travel with it?
    Yes, just pack it like you would any small glass item. A padded pocket, soft pouch, or even tucking it between clothes works. If you’re already organizing your gear and extras in storage and packaging, tossing the pendant into a soft section is an easy way to keep it safe.
